```tsx
import { CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS, DISPOSITION_LABELS, ORDER_RULES, type ContactMessage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { createStaffApi } from "../src/api";
import { ORDER_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { ContactView } from "../src/screens/Contact";
import { AuthoritiesLines } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { bothTimes } from "../src/ui";
import { overview } from "./case-fixtures";
import { CONSOLE_PATHS, fakeFetch, HOSTILE, HOSTILE_ESCAPED, hrefs } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * The console's screens of the contact point (3f design, sections 8.1 to 8.3, 8.9 and 18): the home screen's block
 * "Authorities" and the Contact point screen, rendered on the server, each sentence held to the design's words and every
 * number to ORDER_RULES or the answer. A handle is a person's text, shown as text.
 */

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
/** The rendered text without its markup, its entities read back, as a person reads it. */
const text = (out: string) =>
  out
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
    .replaceAll("&quot;", '"')
    .replaceAll("&#x27;", "'")
    .replaceAll("&lt;", "<")
    .replaceAll("&gt;", ">")
    .replaceAll("&amp;", "&");
const noop = () => undefined;

const AT = "2026-10-16T02:00:00.000Z";
const message = (over: Partial<ContactMessage> = {}): ContactMessage => ({
  id: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a",
  folder: "inbox",
  receivedAt: AT,
  seenAt: AT,
  stale: false,
  disposition: null,
  handledAt: null,
  handledBy: null,
  orders: [],
  ...over,
});

describe("the times of 3f", () => {
  test("bothTimes prints UTC first and the browser's own time in brackets", () => {
    const local = new Date(AT);
    const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
    const clock = `${two(local.getHours())}:${two(local.getMinutes())}`;
    expect(bothTimes(AT)).toMatch(new RegExp(`^2026-10-16 02:00 UTC [(](2026-10-1[56] )?${clock} your time[)]$`));
  });
});

describe("the home screen's block Authorities (8.2)", () => {
  test("nothing at the contact point and a working channel: no block at all", () => {
    expect(html(<AuthoritiesLines overview={overview()} onNavigate={noop} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("[home.contact]: the messages nobody handled since the oldest, a link to Contact point inside the sentence, and the hour", () => {
    const out = html(<AuthoritiesLines overview={overview({ contact: { open: 2, oldestAt: AT, dueAt: AT }, alerts: { channel: "ok", since: null } })} onNavigate={noop} />);
    expect(text(out)).toContain(
      `Authorities` + `Mail at the authorities' contact point since ${bothTimes(AT)}: 2 messages nobody has handled. Read it in the mail host's app, then open Contact point. A removal order is due one hour after it arrived.`,
    );
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(["/contact"]);
    for (const href of hrefs(out)) expect(CONSOLE_PATHS).toContain(href);
    expect(ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes).toBe(60);
  });

  test("[home.channel], [home.mailbox] and [home.off], each while the channel is in its state; the console names no setting", () => {
    const channel = text(html(<AuthoritiesLines overview={overview({ alerts: { channel: "down", since: AT } })} />));
    expect(channel).toContain(
      `Phone alerts are down since ${bothTimes(AT)}. Alerts arrive by mail only: keep the mail host's app open on the contact-point mailbox until this line is gone. An order you find there that Contact point does not list is opened under Orders, with "The message is not listed".`,
    );
    const mailbox = text(html(<AuthoritiesLines overview={overview({ alerts: { channel: "mailbox", since: AT } })} />));
    expect(mailbox).toContain(`korbat has not been able to read the contact-point mailbox since ${bothTimes(AT)}. Check it in the mail host's app until this line is gone. An order you find there is opened under Orders, with "The message is not listed".`);
    const off = text(html(<AuthoritiesLines overview={overview({ alerts: { channel: "off", since: null } })} />));
    expect(off).toContain("Phone alerts and the contact point's watcher are switched off on this server. Nothing watches the contact-point mailbox: the operator switches them on.");
    expect(off).not.toMatch(/NOTIFY|API_/);
  });
});

describe("the Contact point screen (8.3)", () => {
  const ready = (items: ContactMessage[], nextCursor: string | null = null) => ({ state: "ready" as const, value: { items, nextCursor } });
  const view = (items: ContactMessage[], over: Partial<Parameters<typeof ContactView>[0]> = {}) =>
    html(<ContactView page={ready(items)} choices={{}} busy={null} notice={null} error={null} loadingOlder={false} onChoose={noop} onClose={noop} onCloseStale={noop} onLoadOlder={noop} {...over} />);

  test("opens with [contact.what] and [contact.reply], every number from ORDER_RULES", () => {
    const out = text(view([]));
    expect(out).toContain(
      `korbat records that a message arrived and when. It never reads who sent it or what it says: read the message in the mail host's app. Every message here may be a removal order until a person has read it. The junk folder is watched too: an order filed as junk has still arrived. While one message's alarm is less than ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes old, further mail is listed here and raises no new alarm of its own: read every message listed, not only the first. A message that is in the mailbox and not listed here (the watcher was down, or the mail host filed it in another folder) is opened as an order all the same: Orders, "Open an order", "The message is not listed".`,
    );
    expect(out).toContain("Never answer an authority from korbat, and never open an attachment on a device that holds a staff key before you have checked the sender against the register.");
    expect(out).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.contact.empty);
  });

  test("a message's block: received, its folder, stale, not handled, and the six choices of Close as with their hints and [contact.close]", () => {
    const out = text(view([message({ folder: "junk", stale: true })]));
    expect(out).toContain(`Received ${bothTimes(AT)}`);
    expect(out).toContain("Junk folder");
    expect(out).toContain(`korbat first saw this message more than ${ORDER_RULES.staleHours} hours after it arrived (after an outage or a restore). It raised no phone alert.`);
    expect(out).toContain("Not handled");
    expect(out).toContain("Close as");
    for (const word of CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS) {
      expect(out, word).toContain(DISPOSITION_LABELS[word]);
      expect(out, word).toContain(ORDER_WORDS.contact.hints[word]);
    }
    expect(out).toContain("Closing ends this message's alerts and cannot be changed. Close it only after you have read it in the mail host's app.");
    // No button opens an order: that form is a later task's.
    expect(out).not.toContain("Open an order from this message");
    // Close is greyed until a choice is made.
    expect(view([message()])).toMatch(/<button type="button" disabled=""[^>]*>Close<[/]button>/);
    expect(view([message()], { choices: { [message().id]: "not_an_order" } })).toMatch(/<button type="button"( aria-busy="false")?>Close<[/]button>/);
  });

  test("a handled message says how, by whom as text, and when; an order's says it was handled as an order; no choice is offered for either", () => {
    const by = text(view([message({ disposition: "referral", handledAt: AT, handledBy: HOSTILE.script })]));
    expect(by).toContain(`Handled as Referral by @${HOSTILE.script} on ${bothTimes(AT)}`);
    expect(view([message({ disposition: "referral", handledAt: AT, handledBy: HOSTILE.script })])).toContain(HOSTILE_ESCAPED.script);
    expect(by).not.toContain("Close as");
    expect(text(view([message({ disposition: "order", handledAt: AT })]))).toContain("Handled as an order");
  });

  test("more than one stale message nobody handled: close them together, with [contact.staleAll]; one stale message alone gets no such group", () => {
    const stale = [message({ stale: true }), message({ id: "4a2d3c2f-9e5b-4d2f-8c3b-7a1f6e5d4c3b", stale: true }), message({ id: "5b3e4d3a-0f6c-4e3a-9d4c-8b2a7f6e5d4c", stale: false })];
    const out = text(view(stale));
    expect(out).toContain("Close the 2 stale messages as");
    expect(out).toContain(
      `These 2 messages reached korbat's record more than ${ORDER_RULES.staleHours} hours after they arrived and raised no alert. Look at each in the mail host's app before you close them: one of them may be an order, and it is then opened, not closed. Closing cannot be changed.`,
    );
    expect(out).toContain("Close them");
    expect(text(view([message({ stale: true })]))).not.toContain("stale messages as");
  });

  test("Load older while the answer names a next page", () => {
    expect(html(<ContactView page={ready([message()], "next")} choices={{}} busy={null} notice={null} error={null} loadingOlder={false} onChoose={noop} onClose={noop} onCloseStale={noop} onLoadOlder={noop} />)).toContain(">Load older</button>");
    expect(view([message()])).not.toContain("Load older");
  });

  test("message_handled is worded for the console, and the API client sends the close to the message's own address only when its id is a lower-case uuid", async () => {
    const fake = fakeFetch({ "POST /api/staff/contact/3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a/close": { status: 204 } });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    await api.closeContact("3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", { disposition: "not_an_order" }, { activity: true });
    await expect(api.closeContact("3F1C2B1E-8D4A-4C1E-9B2A-6F0E5D4C3B2A", { disposition: "not_an_order" })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_request" });
    const { messageFor } = await import("../src/messages");
    expect(messageFor("message_handled")).toBe("That message was already handled. Read Contact point again.");
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/alerts-grants.test.ts`

```ts
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KIND_LIST, CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS, CONTACT_FOLDERS, NOTIFY_ERRORS, ORDER_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, notifyDb, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { pgError, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

/**
 * The roles hold what section 6.1 grants (3f design, sections 6.1 and 6.7; invariant 12): korbat_notify has USAGE on the
 * schema public, which only the superuser can give and the first migration checks, the grants of its four tables and
 * EXECUTE on order_rules(), and nothing else anywhere; the API role holds exactly its columns; each closed list's CHECK is
 * the contracts' constant; order_rules() is ORDER_RULES, name by name; and the migration's first statement stops a run
 * without the role or without the schema's privilege.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the grants of the contact point and the alert channel", () => {
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];
  const profileIds: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    apiDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_API!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, made);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, profileIds);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(apiDb)]);
  });

  const privileges = async (role: string, table: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ p: string }>(sql`
      select p from unnest(array['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER']) p
       where has_table_privilege(${role}, ${`public.${table}`}, p) order by p`)).map((r) => r.p);
  const columnPrivileges = async (role: string, table: string, privilege: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ column_name: string }>(sql`
      select column_name from information_schema.columns
       where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = ${table} and has_column_privilege(${role}, ${`public.${table}`}, column_name, ${privilege})
       order by ordinal_position`)).map((r) => r.column_name);

  test("korbat_notify holds USAGE on the schema public, the superuser's grant that the migration checks and cannot make", async () => {
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ usage: boolean; auth: boolean; create: boolean }>(
      sql`select has_schema_privilege('korbat_notify', 'public', 'USAGE') as usage, has_schema_privilege('korbat_notify', 'auth', 'USAGE') as auth, has_schema_privilege('korbat_notify', 'public', 'CREATE') as create`,
    );
    expect(row).toEqual({ usage: true, auth: false, create: false });
  });

  test("korbat_notify: exactly the table grants of section 6.1", async () => {
    expect(await privileges("korbat_notify", "contact_messages")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_notify", "contact_messages", "INSERT")).toEqual(["folder", "uidvalidity", "uid", "received_at"]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_notify", "contact_messages", "UPDATE")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await privileges("korbat_notify", "alert_outbox")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_notify", "alert_outbox", "UPDATE")).toEqual(["pushed_at", "push_attempts"]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_notify", "alert_outbox", "INSERT")).toEqual([]);
    for (const table of ["notify_state", "notify_folders"]) expect(await privileges("korbat_notify", table), table).toEqual(["INSERT", "SELECT", "UPDATE"]);
  });

  test("korbat_notify: nothing on any other table, view, sequence or function, but EXECUTE on order_rules()", async () => {
    const tables = await migrateDb.execute<{ name: string }>(sql`
      select n.nspname || '.' || c.relname as name from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
       where n.nspname in ('public', 'auth') and c.relkind in ('r', 'v', 'm', 'p', 'S')
         and c.relname not in ('contact_messages', 'alert_outbox', 'notify_state', 'notify_folders')
         and (has_table_privilege('korbat_notify', c.oid, 'SELECT') or has_table_privilege('korbat_notify', c.oid, 'INSERT') or has_table_privilege('korbat_notify', c.oid, 'UPDATE') or has_table_privilege('korbat_notify', c.oid, 'DELETE')
              or (c.relkind = 'S' and has_sequence_privilege('korbat_notify', c.oid, 'USAGE')))`);
    expect(tables.map((r) => r.name)).toEqual([]);
    const functions = await migrateDb.execute<{ name: string }>(sql`
      select p.proname as name from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
       where n.nspname in ('public', 'auth') and pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) = 'korbat_migrate' and has_function_privilege('korbat_notify', p.oid, 'EXECUTE')
       order by 1`);
    expect(functions.map((r) => r.name)).toEqual(["order_rules"]);
  });

  test("as korbat_notify, every statement outside its grants is refused", async () => {
    const db = notifyDb();
    for (const statement of [
      sql`select 1 from public.decisions limit 1`,
      sql`select public.alert_steps()`,
      sql`select public.alert_time(now())`,
      sql`update public.alert_outbox set mailed_at = now() where false`,
      sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'referral' where false`,
      sql`delete from public.notify_state where false`,
    ]) {
      expect((await pgError(db.execute(statement)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    }
  });

  test("the API role: reads every table, updates a message's disposition and who set it, writes an alert and its mail's mark, and nothing else", async () => {
    expect(await privileges("korbat_api", "contact_messages")).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_api", "contact_messages", "UPDATE")).toEqual(["disposition", "handled_by"]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_api", "contact_messages", "INSERT")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await privileges("korbat_api", "alert_outbox")).toEqual(["INSERT", "SELECT"]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_api", "alert_outbox", "UPDATE")).toEqual(["mailed_at"]);
    for (const table of ["notify_state", "notify_folders"]) expect(await privileges("korbat_api", table), table).toEqual(["SELECT"]);
    const [execute] = await migrateDb.execute<{ steps: boolean; rules: boolean; time: boolean; alert: boolean }>(sql`
      select has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.alert_steps()', 'EXECUTE') as steps, has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.order_rules()', 'EXECUTE') as rules,
             has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.alert_time(timestamptz)', 'EXECUTE') as time, has_function_privilege('korbat_api', 'public.contact_messages_alert()', 'EXECUTE') as alert`);
    expect(execute).toEqual({ steps: true, rules: true, time: false, alert: false });
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at) values ('inbox', 1, 1, now())`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where false`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`update public.notify_state set beat_at = now() where false`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
  });

  test("a disposition is set once, with who set it, and stamped by the database; it never changes (message_handled)", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    const staff = await newProfile(apiDb);
    profileIds.push(staff.id);
    // Without who set it, a disposition is refused.
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'referral' where id = ${id}::uuid`)))?.message).toBe("invalid_request");
    await apiDb.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'referral', handled_by = ${staff.id}::uuid where id = ${id}::uuid`);
    const [handled] = await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string; handled_at: string | null }>(sql`select disposition, handled_at from public.contact_messages where id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect(handled!.disposition).toBe("referral");
    expect(handled!.handled_at).not.toBeNull();
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'not_an_order' where id = ${id}::uuid`)))?.message).toBe("message_handled");
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set handled_by = null where id = ${id}::uuid`)))?.message).toBe("message_handled");
  });

  test("an alert's facts are counts and times only: the CHECK refuses a string that is no time, a list, an object, and more than six members", async () => {
    const tryFacts = async (facts: unknown) =>
      (await pgError(rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, facts) values ('alert_test', 3, 'all', ${JSON.stringify(facts)}::jsonb)`);
      })))?.code ?? null;
    expect(await tryFacts({ at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z", count: 3 })).toBeNull();
    expect(await tryFacts({ at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.123456Z" })).toBeNull();
    expect(await tryFacts({ handle: "mod_anna" })).toBe("23514");
    expect(await tryFacts({ at: "2026-10-16 08:00" })).toBe("23514");
    expect(await tryFacts({ list: [1, 2] })).toBe("23514");
    expect(await tryFacts({ nested: { count: 1 } })).toBe("23514");
    expect(await tryFacts({ flag: true })).toBe("23514");
    expect(await tryFacts({ a: 1, b: 2, c: 3, d: 4, e: 5, f: 6, g: 7 })).toBe("23514");
    expect(await tryFacts([1])).toBe("23514");
  });

  test("each closed list's CHECK is the contracts' constant, in one spelling", async () => {
    const definition = async (table: string, name: string) =>
      (await migrateDb.execute<{ def: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid) as def from pg_constraint c where c.conrelid = ${`public.${table}`}::regclass and c.conname = ${name}`))[0]!.def;
    const listed = (def: string) => [...def.matchAll(/'([a-z_]+)'/g)].map((m) => m[1]);
    expect(listed(await definition("contact_messages", "contact_messages_disposition"))).toEqual([...CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS]);
    expect(listed(await definition("contact_messages", "contact_messages_folder"))).toEqual([...CONTACT_FOLDERS]);
    expect(listed(await definition("notify_folders", "notify_folders_folder"))).toEqual([...CONTACT_FOLDERS]);
    expect(listed(await definition("alert_outbox", "alert_outbox_kind"))).toEqual([...ALERT_KIND_LIST]);
    expect(listed(await definition("notify_state", "notify_state_error"))).toEqual([...NOTIFY_ERRORS]);
  });

  test("order_rules() holds the contracts' ORDER_RULES, name by name", async () => {
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.order_rules()`);
    const camel = (name: string) => name.replace(/_([a-z])/g, (_m, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
    expect(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row!).map(([name, value]) => [camel(name), value === null ? null : Number(value)]))).toEqual({ ...ORDER_RULES });
  });

  test("row level security is on for the four tables, with an allow-all policy for each role granted anything", async () => {
    const rows = await migrateDb.execute<{ table: string; rls: boolean; policies: string[] }>(sql`
      select c.relname as table, c.relrowsecurity as rls, array(select p.policyname || ':' || array_to_string(p.roles, ',') from pg_policies p where p.schemaname = 'public' and p.tablename = c.relname order by 1) as policies
        from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
       where n.nspname = 'public' and c.relname in ('contact_messages', 'alert_outbox', 'notify_state', 'notify_folders') order by 1`);
    expect(rows.map((r) => ({ ...r }))).toEqual(
      ["alert_outbox", "contact_messages", "notify_folders", "notify_state"].map((table) => ({ table, rls: true, policies: [`${table}_api_all:korbat_api`, `${table}_notify_all:korbat_notify`] })),
    );
  });

  test("the migration's first statement stops a run without the role or without the schema's USAGE, with one sentence", async () => {
    const file = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../../packages/db/migrations/0026_messages_alerts.sql", import.meta.url));
    const first = readFileSync(file, "utf8").split("--> statement-breakpoint")[0]!;
    expect(first).toContain("create the role korbat_notify first");
    const run = async (role: string) => (await pgError(rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => void (await tx.execute(sql.raw(first.replaceAll("'korbat_notify'", `'${role}'`)))))))?.message ?? null;
    // The role as it stands: nothing is refused.
    expect(await run("korbat_notify")).toBeNull();
    // A role that does not exist, and one that exists without USAGE on public (the auth role holds none there).
    expect(await run("korbat_notify_missing")).toBe("create the role korbat_notify first");
    expect(await run("korbat_auth")).toBe("create the role korbat_notify first");
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, profileIds.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/alerts-steps.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KINDS, ORDER_RULES, renderAlert, type AlertFacts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import type { StaffMessage } from "../../src/auth";
import { alertTick, channelHealth, staffAlert } from "../../src/moderation/alerts";
import { overview } from "../../src/moderation/cases";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { noticesWorld, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { ageMessageForTest, closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, nextValidity, outboxOf, outboxSince, removeMessages, type OutboxRow } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { newStaffKey, newStaffSession, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

const MIN = 60_000;

/**
 * The alert channel's time-driven alerts and its two legs (3f design, sections 6.1, 7.2 and 12.1; invariants 14 and 15):
 * alert_steps() writes an escalation at escalate_minutes and the deadline's two reminders, each once, and stops them when
 * the message is handled; a person already at work in the console is not absent; the daily test is written once a day.
 * The alert tick mails every row whose mail is its sentence once, never one of 3c's or 3e's kinds, and with NOTIFY on
 * judges the channel's health with its own alarms, once in 24 hours. staffAlert writes the row of every kind of 3c and
 * 3e and marks it mailed either way.
 *
 * The steps run inside transactions of the migrator that end in a rollback: there the test sets the times it needs and
 * pushes every staff session back a day, so that the sessions earlier files of the run opened do not count as someone at
 * work. The tick commits, as the server's does; its rows and messages are removed by id, and the file's last test holds
 * it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the alert steps and the alert tick", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let staffEmail: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES);
    // A live staff account with a key and a session: the address the staff mails of this file go to, and a session a
    // test can mark as used.
    const staff = await newStaffKey(w.authDb, w.migrateDb, w.repo, "moderator");
    staffEmail = staff.user.email;
    await newStaffSession(w.authDb, staff.user.id, staff.key.id);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
  }, 60_000);
  afterEach(async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  /** A message inside the migrator's transaction, received `minutes` ago: the migrator keeps the time it supplies. */
  const messageIn = async (tx: DbTx, minutes: number, extra: { stale?: boolean } = {}) => {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at, seen_at, stale)
      values ('inbox', ${nextValidity()}, 1, now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), ${extra.stale ?? false}) returning id`);
    return row!.id;
  };
  /** Every staff session pushed a day back, its lifetime with it: nobody is at work in the console. */
  const nobodyAtWork = (tx: DbTx) =>
    tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day', last_used_at = last_used_at - interval '1 day', idle_expires_at = idle_expires_at - interval '1 day', absolute_expires_at = absolute_expires_at - interval '1 day'`);
  const steps = async (tx: DbTx) => Number((await tx.execute<{ written: number }>(sql`select public.alert_steps() as written`))[0]!.written);
  const kinds = (rows: OutboxRow[]) => rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.step]);

  test("an unanswered message is escalated to every phone once, escalate_minutes after it arrived, and not before", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes - 1);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(kinds((await outboxOf(tx, early)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated"))).toEqual([]);
      const escalated = (await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated");
      expect(kinds(escalated)).toEqual([["contact_mail_escalated", 0]]);
      expect([escalated[0]!.priority, escalated[0]!.scope]).toEqual([5, "all"]);
      expect(Object.keys(escalated[0]!.facts).sort()).toEqual(["dueAt", "receivedAt"]);
      // Once a message: a second call writes nothing for it.
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toHaveLength(1);
    });
  });

  test("a person already signed in who acts in the console is not absent: a staff session created or used since the message arrived stops the escalation", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const [session] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from auth.staff_sessions limit 1`);
      expect(session, "a staff session of this run").toBeDefined();
      await tx.execute(sql`update auth.staff_sessions set last_used_at = now() where id = ${session!.id}`);
      const due = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.escalateMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, due)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail_escalated")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("order_due for a message: one row at remind_minutes and one at the deadline, each once, with the deadline and the minutes left", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const early = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      const reminded = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = async (id: string) => (await outboxOf(tx, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due");
      expect(await due(early)).toEqual([]);
      const [first] = await due(reminded);
      expect([first!.step, first!.priority, first!.scope]).toEqual([0, 5, "all"]);
      expect(first!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1);
      expect(renderAlert("order_due", first!.facts, new Date()).title).toBe(`${first!.facts.minutesLeft} minutes left`);
      // Past the deadline only the deadline's row: the later of the two that has passed.
      expect((await due(late)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([[0, 0]]);
      // Each once: a second call writes nothing; the deadline's row comes when the deadline passes.
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await due(reminded)).toHaveLength(1);
      await ageMessageForTest(tx, reminded, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await due(reminded)).map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.minutesLeft])).toEqual([
        [0, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes - ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes - 1],
        [1, 0],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("handling a message ends its steps, and a stale message never has any", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await nobodyAtWork(tx);
      const handled = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'referral', handled_at = now() where id = ${handled}::uuid`);
      const stale = await messageIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { stale: true });
      await steps(tx);
      // The handled message keeps the first push its insert wrote, and gets nothing more.
      expect(kinds(await outboxOf(tx, handled))).toEqual([["contact_mail", 0]]);
      expect(await outboxOf(tx, stale)).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("the daily test is written once in 24 hours, pushed only", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
      await steps(tx);
      const [test] = await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at);
      expect([test!.priority, test!.scope, test!.step, Object.keys(test!.facts)]).toEqual([3, "all", 0, ["at"]]);
      expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_test.legs).toEqual(["push"]);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "alert_test", at)).toHaveLength(1);
      // A day later the next one, with the next step.
      // The transaction's own clock stands still: the row moves back a day and a minute.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'alert_test'`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await tx.execute<{ step: number }>(sql`select step from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'alert_test' order by step`)).map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
    });
  });

  test("two calls at once write a step once: the unique key drops the second", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    await ageMessageForTest(w.migrateDb, id, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
    await Promise.all([w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`), w.apiDb.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`)]);
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id)).filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due")).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the tick

  const tickDeps = (notify: "on" | "off") => ({ ...w.deps, config: { ...w.deps.config, NOTIFY: notify } });
  const mailsOf = (template: string) => w.mailer.to(staffEmail, template);

  test("the tick's mail leg mails a row whose mail is its sentence once, to every staff account, and marks it", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    const sent = mailsOf("contact_mail").length;
    const report = await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect(report.channel).toBeNull();
    const [row] = await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id);
    expect(row!.mailed_at).not.toBeNull();
    const mails = mailsOf("contact_mail").slice(sent);
    expect(mails).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(mails[0]!.data).toMatchObject({ receivedAt: row!.facts.receivedAt, dueAt: row!.facts.dueAt });
    // Mailed once: the next round finds nothing owed.

    expect(mailsOf("contact_mail").slice(sent)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("a row whose mail no address took is tried again next round", async () => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    w.mailer.mode = "fail";
    try {
      await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    } finally {
      w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
    }
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id))[0]!.mailed_at).toBeNull();
    await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect((await outboxOf(w.migrateDb, id))[0]!.mailed_at).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("staffAlert writes the row of each kind of 3c and 3e, with its counts and times, and marks it mailed whether or not an address took the mail; the tick never mails it again", async () => {
    const at = new Date();
    const messages: StaffMessage[] = [
      { template: "moderation_urgent", count: 2, oldest: at },
      { template: "moderation_waiting", lanes: [{ lane: 1, count: 3, oldest: at }], interim: 0 },
      { template: "moderation_burst", handle: "mod_anna", count: 20 },
      { template: "moderation_reads", handle: "mod_anna", limit: 200 },
      { template: "moderation_reveal", handle: "mod_anna", at, count: 1, limit: 10 },
      { template: "moderation_csam_lifted", handle: "mod_anna", at, what: "unsealed" },
    ];
    const since = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    for (const [index, message] of messages.entries()) {
      // Every other one finds no address that takes its mail.
      w.mailer.mode = index % 2 === 0 ? "deliver" : "fail";
      try {
        expect(await staffAlert(w.deps, `alerts-steps-${randomUUID()}`, MIN, message), message.template).toBe("sent");
      } finally {
        w.mailer.mode = "deliver";
      }
    }
    for (const message of messages) {
      const rows = await outboxSince(w.migrateDb, message.template, since);
      expect(rows, message.template).toHaveLength(1);
      const [row] = rows;
      expect([row!.priority, row!.scope, row!.step, row!.mailed_at !== null], message.template).toEqual([ALERT_KINDS[message.template].priority, ALERT_KINDS[message.template].scope, null, true]);
      // The push names nobody: the handle of the staff mail is not among its facts.
      expect(JSON.stringify(row!.facts), message.template).not.toContain("mod_anna");
    }
    const mailed = messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length);
    await alertTick(tickDeps("off"));
    expect(messages.map((m) => w.mailer.attempts.filter((a) => a.template === m.template).length)).toEqual(mailed);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind like 'moderation_%' and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz`);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the channel's health

  const beat = (beatMinutesAgo: number | null, mailboxMinutesAgo: number | null) =>
    w.migrateDb.execute(sql`
      insert into public.notify_state (id, beat_at, mailbox_ok_at, push_ok_at)
      values (1, case when ${beatMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${beatMinutesAgo}::int) end,
                 case when ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int is null then null else now() - make_interval(mins => ${mailboxMinutesAgo}::int) end, now())
      on conflict (id) do update set beat_at = excluded.beat_at, mailbox_ok_at = excluded.mailbox_ok_at`);
  const alarms = (since: Date) => w.migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; facts: AlertFacts; mailed: boolean }>(sql`select kind, facts, mailed_at is not null as mailed from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable') and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz order by id`);
  const clearAlarms = () => w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind in ('alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable')`);

  test("with NOTIFY off the channel is off, its check is skipped, and the tick still writes and mails the steps", async () => {
    await beat(null, null);
    expect(await channelHealth(tickDeps("off"))).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
    const at = new Date();
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("off"))).raised).toEqual([]);
    expect(await alarms(at)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a beat older than channel_down_minutes is down: alert_channel_down once in 24 hours, mailed by the next round, and the home screen says so", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1, 0);
    const health = await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"));
    expect(health.channel).toBe("down");
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual(["alert_channel_down"]);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual([]);
    const rows = await alarms(at);
    expect(rows.map((r) => [r.kind, r.mailed])).toEqual([["alert_channel_down", true]]);
    expect(Date.parse(String(rows[0]!.facts.since))).toBe(health.since!.getTime());
    expect(mailsOf("alert_channel_down").length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    // Mailed only: the watcher publishes no row of this kind.
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.alert_channel_down.legs).toEqual(["mail"]);
    const home = await overview(tickDeps("on"), { userId: randomUUID() } as Parameters<typeof overview>[1]);
    expect(home.alerts.channel).toBe("down");
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  test("a push still owed for longer than channel_down_minutes reads as down, and a row past push_owed_minutes no longer counts", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(0, 0);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(new Date());
    made.push(id);
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    // Every other row still owed is pushed meanwhile, as a working watcher would have: this file judges its own row.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where pushed_at is null and message_id is distinct from ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("down");
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.pushOwedMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("ok");
    await clearAlarms();
  });

  test("a fresh beat with a mailbox not read for channel_down_minutes is mailbox_unreachable, pushed and mailed, once in 24 hours", async () => {
    await clearAlarms();
    await beat(0, ORDER_RULES.channelDownMinutes + 1);
    expect((await channelHealth(tickDeps("on"))).channel).toBe("mailbox");
    const at = new Date(Date.now() - 1000);
    expect((await alertTick(tickDeps("on"))).raised).toEqual(["mailbox_unreachable"]);
    await alertTick(tickDeps("on"));
    expect((await alarms(at)).map((r) => [r.kind, r.mailed])).toEqual([["mailbox_unreachable", true]]);
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.mailbox_unreachable.legs).toEqual(["push", "mail"]);
    await clearAlarms();
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
  });

  test("the home screen counts the messages nobody handled, stale ones included, with the oldest and the earliest deadline", async () => {
    const first = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 60 * MIN));
    const second = await contactMessageForTest(new Date(Date.now() - 2 * MIN));
    made.push(first, second);
    const home = await overview(tickDeps("off"), { userId: randomUUID() } as Parameters<typeof overview>[1]);
    expect(home.contact.open).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    const [stored] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ received_at: string }>(sql`select received_at from public.contact_messages where id = ${first}::uuid`);
    expect(home.contact.oldestAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(Date.parse(home.contact.oldestAt!)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.parse(stored!.received_at));
    expect(Date.parse(home.contact.dueAt!)).toBe(Date.parse(home.contact.oldestAt!) + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * MIN);
    expect(home.alerts).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    // The tick's own daily test, which no message names, and the rows of this file's kinds of 3f.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where created_at >= ${started.toISOString()}::timestamptz and kind in ('alert_test', 'alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable')`);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/http-staff-contact.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE, ContactPage, ErrorEnvelope, StaffOverview } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth, type Auth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig, type Config } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration } from "../../src/moderation";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { createStaff } from "../../src/staff";
import { SoftAuthenticator } from "../auth/soft-authenticator";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, casesMedia, removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, outboxOf, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { enrolKey } from "./staff-enrolment";
import { DEVICE_BOUND, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, issueEnrolment, newStaffAccount, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

const STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE = "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf";
const MARKED = { "x-staff-activity": "1" };

/**
 * The contact point's routes through the real app (3f design, sections 7.3, 8.3 and 10.2): GET /api/staff/contact, the
 * messages newest first with no sender and no subject, a page at a time, and only the open ones with open=1; and POST
 * /api/staff/contact/:message/close, which sets a disposition other than order once, without a key, with its audit row
 * contact_closed, and answers 409 message_handled for a message that has one and 404 for an id no message has. The home
 * screen's overview counts the messages nobody handled. The file's last test holds it to leaving no row behind but the
 * audit rows, which stay as audit-verify reads them.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the contact point's routes over HTTP", () => {
  let config: Config;
  let authDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let auth: Auth;
  let app: ReturnType<typeof createApp>;
  let moderator: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof staffBrowser>>;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const profileIds: string[] = [];
  const made: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    config = loadConfig({ ...process.env, CONSOLE_ORIGIN: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, CONSOLE_RP_ID: "" });
    const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES);
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    auth = createAuth({ config, logger, authDb, kv: new MemoryKv(), mailer: new MemoryMailer(), profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb) });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), rateLimitStore, config, logger });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, staff: createStaff({ apiDb, auth: auth.forStaff, moderation: moderation.forStaff }), moderation });
    moderator = await staffBrowser();
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, profileIds);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const consoleBrowser = () => new Browser(app, TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, { base: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, csrfCookie: STAFF_CSRF_COOKIE, csrfHeader: "x-staff-csrf" });
  const answered = async (res: Response): Promise<[number, string]> => [res.status, ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code];
  /** An answer held to its contract: what the schema reads from the raw JSON is all the JSON holds. */
  async function held<T>(schema: { parse(raw: unknown): T }, res: Response): Promise<T> {
    const raw = await res.json();
    const read = schema.parse(raw);
    expect(raw).toStrictEqual(read);
    return read;
  }

  /** A moderator with a profile and one key enrolled through the flow, signed in from the console's browser. */
  async function staffBrowser() {
    const { user } = await newStaffAccount(authDb, repo, "moderator");
    const handle = `c_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    await apiDb.insert(profiles).values({ id: user.id, handle, displayName: "Staff" });
    profileIds.push(user.id);
    const soft = new SoftAuthenticator();
    const link = await issueEnrolment(migrateDb, user.id);
    const enrolled = await enrolKey({ deps: auth.deps, ctx: { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: undefined } }, soft, link.token);
    const b = consoleBrowser();
    const options = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/options", { method: "POST" });
    const { challenge } = ((await options.json()) as { options: { challenge: string } }).options;
    const signedIn = await b.fetch("/api/staff/signin/verify", {
      json: { response: soft.get({ credentialId: enrolled.credentialId, rpId: TEST_CONSOLE_RP_ID, challenge, origin: TEST_CONSOLE_ORIGIN, flags: DEVICE_BOUND, counter: 1 }) },
    });
    expect(signedIn.status, await signedIn.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return { id: user.id, handle, b };
  }
  const message = async (receivedAt: Date, folder: "inbox" | "junk" = "inbox") => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(receivedAt, folder);
    made.push(id);
    return id;
  };
  const list = async (query = "") => held(ContactPage, await moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/contact${query}`, { headers: MARKED }));
  const close = (id: string, disposition: unknown) => moderator.b.fetch(`/api/staff/contact/${id}/close`, { json: { disposition }, headers: MARKED });

  test("both routes need a staff session", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date());
    const b = consoleBrowser();
    expect(await answered(await b.fetch("/api/staff/contact"))).toEqual([401, "staff_session_required"]);
    expect(await answered(await b.fetch(`/api/staff/contact/${id}/close`, { json: { disposition: "not_an_order" } }))).toEqual([401, "staff_session_required"]);
  });

  test("the list: newest first by the time of receipt, each with its folder, its times and whether it is stale; no sender, no subject", async () => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const older = await message(new Date(now - 3 * 60 * 60_000), "junk");
    const newer = await message(new Date(now - 60_000));
    const page = await list();
    const ours = page.items.filter((m) => m.id === older || m.id === newer);
    expect(ours.map((m) => [m.id, m.folder, m.stale, m.disposition, m.handledBy, m.orders])).toEqual([
      [newer, "inbox", false, null, null, []],
      [older, "junk", true, null, null, []],
    ]);
    const received = page.items.map((m) => Date.parse(m.receivedAt));
    expect([...received].sort((a, b) => b - a)).toEqual(received);
  });

  test("a page holds CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE messages, and the cursor reads on without a gap or a repeat; a cursor the API did not write is refused", async () => {
    const base = Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60_000;
    for (let i = 0; i < CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE + 3; i++) await message(new Date(base - i * 1_000));
    const seen: string[] = [];
    let cursor: string | null = null;
    do {
      const page: ContactPage = await list(cursor === null ? "" : `?cursor=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`);
      expect(page.items.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE);
      seen.push(...page.items.map((m) => m.id));
      cursor = page.nextCursor;
    } while (cursor !== null);
    expect(new Set(seen).size).toBe(seen.length);
    for (const id of made) expect(seen).toContain(id);
    expect(await answered(await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/contact?cursor=bm90LWEtY3Vyc29y", { headers: MARKED }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect(await answered(await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/contact?open=0", { headers: MARKED }))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
  });

  test("closing: a disposition other than order, once, without a key, with its audit row; the message then lists as handled by its staff handle", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 60_000));
    const res = await close(id, "not_an_order");
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(204);
    const [audit] = await migrateDb.execute<{ actor_id: string; target_type: string; target_id: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown>; key_id: string | null }>(
      sql`select actor_id, target_type, target_id, metadata, key_id from public.audit_log where action = 'contact_closed' and target_id = ${id} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    );
    const [stored] = await migrateDb.execute<{ received_at: string; handled_by: string; handled_at: string | null }>(sql`select received_at, handled_by, handled_at from public.contact_messages where id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect(audit).toEqual({ actor_id: moderator.id, target_type: "contact_message", target_id: id, metadata: { disposition: "not_an_order", receivedAt: new Date(stored!.received_at).toISOString(), folder: "inbox" }, key_id: null });
    expect(stored!.handled_by).toBe(moderator.id);
    expect(stored!.handled_at).not.toBeNull();
    const listed = (await list()).items.find((m) => m.id === id)!;
    expect([listed.disposition, listed.handledBy]).toEqual(["not_an_order", moderator.handle]);
    expect(listed.handledAt).not.toBeNull();
    // Only the open ones with open=1.
    expect((await list("?open=1")).items.map((m) => m.id)).not.toContain(id);
  });

  test("a message that has a disposition is 409 message_handled, an unknown id 404, order and any other word 400, an id not in lower case 400", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date());
    expect((await close(id, "referral")).status).toBe(204);
    expect(await answered(await close(id, "not_an_order"))).toEqual([409, "message_handled"]);
    expect(await answered(await close(randomUUID(), "referral"))).toEqual([404, "not_found"]);
    const open = await message(new Date());
    expect(await answered(await close(open, "order"))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect(await answered(await close(open, "spam"))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect(await answered(await close(open.toUpperCase(), "referral"))).toEqual([400, "invalid_request"]);
    expect((await migrateDb.execute<{ disposition: string | null }>(sql`select disposition from public.contact_messages where id = ${open}::uuid`))[0]!.disposition).toBeNull();
  });

  test("closing ends the message's alerts: the steps write nothing for it any more", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date());
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set received_at = received_at - interval '61 minutes' where id = ${id}::uuid`);
    expect((await close(id, "clarification")).status).toBe(204);
    // In a transaction that is rolled back: the steps would also write the day's test, which this file must not leave.
    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`select public.alert_steps()`);
      expect((await outboxOf(tx, id)).filter((r) => r.kind !== "contact_mail")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("the home screen counts the messages nobody handled", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date(Date.now() - 10 * 60_000));
    const overview = await held(StaffOverview, await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/overview", { headers: MARKED }));
    expect(overview.contact.open).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(overview.contact.dueAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(overview.alerts.channel).toBe(config.NOTIFY === "off" ? "off" : overview.alerts.channel);
    expect((await close(id, "not_an_order")).status).toBe(204);
    const after = await held(StaffOverview, await moderator.b.fetch("/api/staff/overview", { headers: MARKED }));
    expect(after.contact.open).toBe(overview.contact.open - 1);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, profileIds.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/notify-fixtures.ts`

```ts
import { randomInt } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";

/**
 * Fixtures of the contact point and the alert channel (3f design, section 12): `contactMessageForTest` inserts a message on
 * korbat_notify's role, as the watcher would, through the test environment's fourth URL (DATABASE_URL_NOTIFY, which
 * assertTestTargets holds to a _test database). Every message a test makes has a validity number of its own, so no two
 * files' messages meet on the unique key; alert_outbox has no foreign keys, so a test finds its rows by its messages' ids
 * or by time, and removes both when it ends.
 */

let pool: Db | null = null;

/** The watcher's role's pool, made on first use; closeNotifyFixtures ends it. */
export function notifyDb(): Db {
  pool ??= createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_NOTIFY!, { max: 2 });
  return pool;
}

export async function closeNotifyFixtures(): Promise<void> {
  if (pool) await closeDb(pool);
  pool = null;
}

/** A validity number no other message of the run has: a random base, then counted. */
let validity = randomInt(1_000_000, 2_000_000_000);
export const nextValidity = () => ++validity;

/** A message as the watcher inserts it: its folder, its two numbers and its time of receipt; answers its id. */
export async function contactMessageForTest(receivedAt: Date, folder: "inbox" | "junk" = "inbox", numbers: { uidvalidity?: number; uid?: number } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await notifyDb().execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at) values (${folder}, ${numbers.uidvalidity ?? nextValidity()}, ${numbers.uid ?? 1}, ${receivedAt.toISOString()}) returning id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/** One row of alert_outbox as a test reads it, as the migrator. */
export type OutboxRow = {
  id: number;
  kind: string;
  priority: number;
  scope: string;
  step: number | null;
  facts: Record<string, number | string>;
  message_id: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  pushed_at: string | null;
  mailed_at: string | null;
  push_attempts: number;
};
/** The same as the driver answers it: a bigint id as text. */
type OutboxRaw = Omit<OutboxRow, "id"> & { id: string };

/** A message's rows of alert_outbox, oldest first. */
export async function outboxOf(db: Db | DbTx, messageId: string): Promise<OutboxRow[]> {
  const rows = await db.execute<OutboxRaw>(sql`select * from public.alert_outbox where message_id = ${messageId}::uuid order by id`);
  return rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, id: Number(row.id) }));
}

/** The rows of a kind created at or after a time, oldest first. */
export async function outboxSince(db: Db | DbTx, kind: string, since: Date): Promise<OutboxRow[]> {
  const rows = await db.execute<OutboxRaw>(sql`select * from public.alert_outbox where kind = ${kind} and created_at >= ${since.toISOString()}::timestamptz order by id`);
  return rows.map((row) => ({ ...row, id: Number(row.id) }));
}

/**
 * Moves a message back in time, as the migrator: its time of receipt, the time it was seen and its outbox rows' times, by
 * whole minutes. It is how a test meets an escalation or a deadline: every time is forced by a trigger, and no setting
 * shortens a number of order_rules().
 */
export async function ageMessageForTest(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, messageId: string, minutes: number): Promise<void> {
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set received_at = received_at - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), seen_at = seen_at - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}) where id = ${messageId}::uuid`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}) where message_id = ${messageId}::uuid`);
}

/** Removes messages and every outbox row that names them, as the migrator. */
export async function removeMessages(migrateDb: Db, ids: readonly string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (ids.length === 0) return;
  const list = sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where message_id = any(${list})`);
  await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.contact_messages where id = any(${list})`);
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/notify-loop.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KINDS, ORDER_RULES, renderAlert } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createStore, createWatcher } from "../../src/notify/main";
import { fakeImap, makeCertificate, type FakeImap, type ScriptFolder } from "../notify/fake-imap";
import { fakeNtfy, type FakeNtfy } from "../notify/fake-ntfy";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { ageMessageForTest, closeNotifyFixtures, contactMessageForTest, nextValidity, notifyDb, outboxOf, removeMessages } from "./notify-fixtures";
import { pgError } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

/**
 * The watcher's side of the database (3f design, sections 6.1 and 7.1; invariants 12 to 14): as korbat_notify, a message's
 * insert with the columns the triggers force, the first push's row the insert writes, the bound on a flood, and the
 * loop's own statements run by the real watcher against fakeImap and fakeNtfy: the messages and the folders' marks, the
 * publish of every row still owed its push and of none past its bound, and the beat. The client's own rules are the unit
 * file test/notify/imap.test.ts. Each test removes its messages and their rows; the watcher's state rows are removed when
 * the file ends, and its last test holds it to leaving no row behind.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the watcher's role and its statements", () => {
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let apiDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];
  const pair = makeCertificate();
  const servers: { close(): Promise<void> }[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    apiDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_API!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES);
  });
  afterEach(async () => {
    await Promise.all(servers.splice(0).map((s) => s.close()));
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_folders`);
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(apiDb)]);
  });

  const message = async (receivedAt: Date, folder: "inbox" | "junk" = "inbox") => {
    const id = await contactMessageForTest(receivedAt, folder);
    made.push(id);
    return id;
  };
  const row = async (id: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ received_at: string; seen_at: string; stale: boolean; disposition: string | null; handled_at: string | null; clock: string }>(
      sql`select received_at, seen_at, stale, disposition, handled_at, clock_timestamp() as clock from public.contact_messages where id = ${id}::uuid`,
    ))[0]!;

  test("as korbat_notify a message is its four columns, and the database forces the rest: seen now, not stale, nobody's yet", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date(Date.now() - 60_000), "junk");
    const r = await row(id);
    expect(r.stale).toBe(false);
    expect([r.disposition, r.handled_at]).toEqual([null, null]);
    expect(Date.parse(r.seen_at)).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now() - 60_000);
    // A column the watcher may not write is refused, and so is any update and any read beyond its four tables.
    expect((await pgError(notifyDb().execute(sql`insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at, disposition) values ('inbox', ${nextValidity()}, 1, now(), 'not_an_order')`)))?.code)
      .toBe("42501");
    expect((await pgError(notifyDb().execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set received_at = now() where id = ${id}::uuid`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    expect((await pgError(notifyDb().execute(sql`delete from public.contact_messages where id = ${id}::uuid`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
  });

  test("a time of receipt ahead of the database's clock is stored as the clock's time, so a deadline only ever moves earlier", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60_000));
    const r = await row(id);
    expect(Date.parse(r.received_at)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(Date.parse(r.clock));
    expect(r.received_at).toBe(r.seen_at);
  });

  test("the insert writes the first push's row: contact_mail, step 0, priority 5, to the phone on call, with the time of receipt and the deadline", async () => {
    const receivedAt = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * 60_000);
    const id = await message(receivedAt);
    const rows = await outboxOf(migrateDb, id);
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(1);
    const [first] = rows;
    expect([first!.kind, first!.step, first!.priority, first!.scope, first!.pushed_at, first!.mailed_at, first!.push_attempts]).toEqual(["contact_mail", 0, 5, "on_call", null, null, 0]);
    const stored = Date.parse((await row(id)).received_at);
    expect(Date.parse(String(first!.facts.receivedAt))).toBe(stored);
    expect(Date.parse(String(first!.facts.dueAt))).toBe(stored + ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes * 60_000);
    // The facts render the push's sentence, counts and times only.
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail", first!.facts, new Date()).sentence).toMatch(/^Mail at the authorities' contact point, received [0-9:]+ UTC[.]/);
    expect(ALERT_KINDS.contact_mail.scope).toBe(first!.scope);
  });

  test("a message received more than stale_hours before it was seen is stale and raises nothing", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date(Date.now() - (ORDER_RULES.staleHours * 60 + 1) * 60_000));
    expect((await row(id)).stale).toBe(true);
    expect(await outboxOf(migrateDb, id)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the bound on a flood: while an unhandled message's first push is younger than quiet_minutes, a further message gets its row and no first push", async () => {
    const first = await message(new Date());
    expect(await outboxOf(migrateDb, first)).toHaveLength(1);
    const second = await message(new Date());
    expect(await outboxOf(migrateDb, second)).toEqual([]);
    expect((await row(second)).stale).toBe(false);
    // Once the first push is older than the quiet minutes, a new message rings again.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${first}::uuid`);
    const third = await message(new Date());
    expect((await outboxOf(migrateDb, third)).map((r) => [r.kind, r.step])).toEqual([["contact_mail", 0]]);
    // A handled message bounds nothing: with the third handled, the next rings at once.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.contact_messages set disposition = 'not_an_order', handled_at = now() where id = ${third}::uuid`);
    const fourth = await message(new Date());
    expect(await outboxOf(migrateDb, fourth)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the loop's statements

  async function world(inbox: ScriptFolder, junk: ScriptFolder = { uidValidity: nextValidity(), messages: [] }) {
    const imap: FakeImap = await fakeImap({ user: "watcher", password: "secret", tls: pair, folders: new Map([["INBOX", inbox], ["Junk", junk]]) });
    const ntfy: FakeNtfy = await fakeNtfy();
    servers.push(imap, ntfy);
    // Each world starts from no mark: a folder of another world's validity is read whole.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_folders`);
    const watcher = createWatcher({
      store: createStore(notifyDb()),
      imap: { host: "localhost", port: imap.port, user: "watcher", password: "secret", junk: "Junk", ca: imap.ca, timeoutMs: 5_000 },
      push: { url: ntfy.url, token: "tk_publisher" },
      fetch,
      now: () => new Date(),
      log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });
    servers.push({ close: () => watcher.stop() });
    return { imap, ntfy, watcher };
  }
  /** The messages of a validity number, by UID, as the migrator reads them. */
  const messagesOf = async (uidvalidity: number) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; folder: string; uid: string; received_at: string; stale: boolean }>(sql`select id, folder, uid, received_at, stale from public.contact_messages where uidvalidity = ${uidvalidity} order by uid`)).map(
      (r) => ({ ...r, uid: Number(r.uid) }),
    );

  test("a round inserts each new message with its internal date, marks the folders, publishes the first push and beats", async () => {
    const inbox = { uidValidity: nextValidity(), messages: [{ uid: 4, internalDate: new Date(Date.now() - 30_000) }] };
    const junk = { uidValidity: nextValidity(), messages: [{ uid: 9, internalDate: new Date(Date.now() - 20_000) }] };
    const w = await world(inbox, junk);
    const report = await w.watcher.round();
    const inInbox = await messagesOf(inbox.uidValidity);
    const inJunk = await messagesOf(junk.uidValidity);
    made.push(...inInbox.map((m) => m.id), ...inJunk.map((m) => m.id));
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ mailboxOk: true, inserted: 2 });
    expect(inInbox.map((m) => [m.folder, m.uid, Date.parse(m.received_at)])).toEqual([["inbox", 4, Math.floor(inbox.messages[0]!.internalDate.getTime() / 1000) * 1000]]);
    expect(inJunk.map((m) => [m.folder, m.uid])).toEqual([["junk", 9]]);
    const marks = await migrateDb.execute<{ folder: string; uidvalidity: string; last_uid: string }>(sql`select folder, uidvalidity, last_uid from public.notify_folders order by folder`);
    expect(marks.map((m) => [m.folder, Number(m.uidvalidity), Number(m.last_uid)])).toEqual([
      ["inbox", inbox.uidValidity, 4],
      ["junk", junk.uidValidity, 9],
    ]);
    // The first message's push went out; the second, inside the quiet minutes, raised none of its own.
    const pushed = await outboxOf(migrateDb, inInbox[0]!.id);
    expect(pushed).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(pushed[0]!.pushed_at).not.toBeNull();
    expect(w.ntfy.published.filter((p) => p.tags === "contact_mail" && p.topic === "korbat-oncall")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await outboxOf(migrateDb, inJunk[0]!.id)).toEqual([]);
    const [state] = await migrateDb.execute<{ beat: boolean; mailbox: boolean; push: boolean; error: string | null }>(
      sql`select beat_at > now() - interval '1 minute' as beat, mailbox_ok_at > now() - interval '1 minute' as mailbox, push_ok_at > now() - interval '1 minute' as push, error from public.notify_state where id = 1`,
    );
    expect(state).toEqual({ beat: true, mailbox: true, push: true, error: null });
    // The next round reads from the marks and inserts nothing twice.
    expect((await w.watcher.round()).inserted).toBe(0);
    expect(await messagesOf(inbox.uidValidity)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("a push is owed for push_owed_minutes and no longer: a row past its bound is not published and counts for nothing", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date());
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.pushOwedMinutes + 1}) where message_id = ${id}::uuid`);
    const fresh = await message(new Date(Date.now() - 1000));
    const w = await world({ uidValidity: nextValidity(), messages: [] });
    // The first message's push is older than the quiet minutes too, so the second rang.
    await w.watcher.round();
    const [old] = await outboxOf(migrateDb, id);
    expect([old!.pushed_at, old!.push_attempts]).toEqual([null, 0]);
    const [rang] = await outboxOf(migrateDb, fresh);
    expect(rang!.pushed_at).not.toBeNull();
    expect(w.ntfy.published.some((p) => p.text.includes(renderAlert("contact_mail", rang!.facts, new Date()).sentence))).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a push the server refuses counts an attempt and stays owed, the beat says push_refused, and the next round publishes it", async () => {
    const id = await message(new Date());
    const w = await world({ uidValidity: nextValidity(), messages: [] });
    w.ntfy.fail({ status: 503, count: 1_000 });
    const failed = await w.watcher.round();
    expect(failed.pushOk).toBe(false);
    const [owed] = await outboxOf(migrateDb, id);
    expect([owed!.pushed_at, owed!.push_attempts]).toEqual([null, 1]);
    const [state] = await migrateDb.execute<{ error: string | null }>(sql`select error from public.notify_state where id = 1`);
    expect(state!.error).toBe("push_refused");
    w.ntfy.fail({ count: 0 });
    expect((await w.watcher.round()).pushOk).toBe(true);
    expect((await outboxOf(migrateDb, id))[0]!.pushed_at).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("a first start on a mailbox with old mail inserts every message, each stale, and raises nothing", async () => {
    const old = Date.now() - 3 * 24 * 60 * 60_000;
    const inbox = { uidValidity: nextValidity(), messages: Array.from({ length: 300 }, (_, i) => ({ uid: i + 1, internalDate: new Date(old + i * 60_000) })) };
    const w = await world(inbox);
    expect((await w.watcher.round()).inserted).toBe(300);
    const rows = await messagesOf(inbox.uidValidity);
    made.push(...rows.map((m) => m.id));
    expect(rows).toHaveLength(300);
    expect(rows.every((m) => m.stale)).toBe(true);
    const [raised] = await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.alert_outbox where message_id = any(${`{${rows.map((m) => m.id).join(",")}}`}::uuid[])`);
    expect(raised!.n).toBe(0);
  }, 120_000);

  test("a changed UIDVALIDITY reads the folder whole: every message is a new row, and the earlier rows stay", async () => {
    const first = nextValidity();
    const inbox = { uidValidity: first, messages: [{ uid: 1, internalDate: new Date(Date.now() - 10_000) }] };
    const w = await world(inbox);
    await w.watcher.round();
    const second = nextValidity();
    w.imap.folders.set("INBOX", { uidValidity: second, messages: [{ uid: 1, internalDate: new Date(Date.now() - 10_000) }] });
    expect((await w.watcher.round()).inserted).toBe(1);
    const before = await messagesOf(first);
    const after = await messagesOf(second);
    made.push(...before.map((m) => m.id), ...after.map((m) => m.id));
    expect([before.length, after.length]).toEqual([1, 1]);
    expect(after[0]!.received_at).toBe(before[0]!.received_at);
  });

  test("the watcher's role holds its four tables' grants and order_rules(), and nothing else of the database", async () => {
    const db = notifyDb();
    expect((await db.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select (public.order_rules()).hour_minutes as n`))[0]!.n).toBe(ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes);
    for (const statement of [
      sql`select 1 from public.profiles limit 1`,
      sql`select 1 from public.audit_log limit 1`,
      sql`select public.alert_steps()`,
      sql`insert into public.alert_outbox (kind, priority, scope, facts) values ('alert_test', 3, 'all', '{}')`,
      sql`update public.alert_outbox set mailed_at = now() where false`,
      sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where false`,
      sql`select 1 from auth.users limit 1`,
    ]) {
      expect((await pgError(db.execute(statement)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    }
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_state`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.notify_folders`);
    await removeMessages(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    // The rows other files' alerts left owed were published by these rounds: their pushed_at moved, their number did not.
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```sql
-- As the superuser, like infra/postgres/init/01-roles.sh, in a database of its own (pattern of research-3c/gap-G5-lab/00-roles.sql).
CREATE ROLE korbat_migrate LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE korbat_api LOGIN;
CREATE ROLE korbat_auth LOGIN;
CREATE DATABASE lab;
\c lab
REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
REVOKE USAGE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE lab TO korbat_migrate;
GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO korbat_migrate;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO korbat_api;
```
