### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/20-tables.sql`

```sql
-- LAB 3f, part 1 of the prototype: enum values, tables, columns, relaxed CHECKs, views and plain functions.
-- Everything here is parsed or executed inside the migrating transaction, so no new enum value appears as a literal.
ALTER TYPE public.action_kind ADD VALUE 'disable_by_order';
ALTER TYPE public.action_kind ADD VALUE 'reinstate_by_order';
ALTER TYPE public.decision_kind ADD VALUE 'order';
ALTER TYPE public.decision_source ADD VALUE 'order';
ALTER TYPE public.intake_kind ADD VALUE 'order';
ALTER TYPE public.intake_channel ADD VALUE 'authority';
ALTER TYPE public.moderation_level ADD VALUE 'disabled';
ALTER TYPE public.post_state ADD VALUE 'disabled';

CREATE FUNCTION public.order_rules() RETURNS TABLE (hour interval, target interval, items_per_action integer, items_per_day integer,
  records_per_day integer, hold_east interval, hold_days integer, extension_days integer, preserve_months integer, preserve_margin interval, report_hold interval)
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT interval '60 minutes', interval '55 minutes', 10, 50, 20, interval '3 hours', 43, 42, 6, interval '1 day', interval '7 days'
$$;

CREATE TABLE public.contact_messages (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  folder text NOT NULL CHECK (folder IN ('inbox', 'junk')),
  uidvalidity bigint NOT NULL,
  uid bigint NOT NULL,
  received_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  disposition text CHECK (disposition IN ('order', 'referral', 'first_order_notice', 'preservation_request', 'scrutiny_decision', 'clarification', 'not_an_order')),
  handled_by uuid,
  handled_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (folder, uidvalidity, uid)
);
CREATE TABLE public.legal_orders (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('tco_removal', 'dsa_art9', 'dsa_art10')),
  member_state text NOT NULL CHECK (member_state ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'),
  authority text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(authority) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  reference text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(reference) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  channel text NOT NULL CHECK (channel IN ('mailbox', 'portal', 'post', 'other')),
  message_id uuid REFERENCES public.contact_messages,
  received_at timestamptz,
  sent_at timestamptz,
  issued_at timestamptz,
  section_c boolean NOT NULL,
  emergency boolean NOT NULL,
  cross_border boolean NOT NULL,
  withhold_from_author boolean NOT NULL,
  preserve boolean NOT NULL,
  authority_hold_until timestamptz,
  hold_extended boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  hold_ended_at timestamptz,
  opened_by uuid,
  opened_via text NOT NULL CHECK (opened_via IN ('console', 'cli')),
  opened_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  closed_at timestamptz,
  imported_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (member_state, authority, reference),
  CONSTRAINT legal_orders_received CHECK (received_at <= opened_at AND (sent_at IS NULL OR sent_at <= opened_at)),
  CONSTRAINT legal_orders_tco CHECK (kind <> 'tco_removal' OR (withhold_from_author AND preserve))
);
CREATE TABLE public.legal_order_items (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.legal_orders,
  position smallint NOT NULL CHECK (position BETWEEN 1 AND 50),
  link text NOT NULL CHECK (char_length(link) <= 500),
  post_id uuid,
  intake_item_id uuid REFERENCES public.intake_items,
  decision_id uuid REFERENCES public.decisions,
  action_id uuid REFERENCES public.decision_actions,
  disabled_at timestamptz,
  preserve_until timestamptz,
  preserve_ended_at timestamptz,
  reinstated_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (order_id, position)
);
CREATE INDEX legal_order_items_post_idx ON public.legal_order_items (post_id) WHERE preserve_until IS NOT NULL;
CREATE TABLE public.legal_order_events (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.legal_orders,
  item_id uuid REFERENCES public.legal_order_items,
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('opened', 'annex3_sent', 'grounds_ceased', 'clarification_received', 'annex2_sent', 'receipt_confirmed',
    'effect_given', 'reinstated', 'closed_without_effect', 'verified', 'issued_at_set', 'texts_recorded', 'document_recorded', 'hold_extended',
    'hold_ended', 'notice_released', 'preservation_extended', 'preservation_ended', 'scrutiny_requested', 'scrutiny_decided', 'imported')),
  at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  effective_at timestamptz,
  ground text,
  by_staff uuid,
  via text NOT NULL CHECK (via IN ('console', 'cli', 'system')),
  CONSTRAINT legal_order_events_effective CHECK (effective_at IS NULL OR effective_at <= at)
);
CREATE INDEX legal_order_events_order_idx ON public.legal_order_events (order_id, at);
ALTER TABLE public.contact_messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.legal_orders ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.legal_order_items ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.legal_order_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY contact_messages_api ON public.contact_messages FOR ALL TO korbat_api USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY legal_orders_api ON public.legal_orders FOR ALL TO korbat_api USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY legal_order_items_api ON public.legal_order_items FOR ALL TO korbat_api USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
CREATE POLICY legal_order_events_api ON public.legal_order_events FOR ALL TO korbat_api USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);
-- 0001's default privileges give the API role every write on a new table: take them back, then grant what it needs.
REVOKE ALL ON public.contact_messages, public.legal_orders, public.legal_order_items, public.legal_order_events FROM korbat_api;
GRANT SELECT ON public.contact_messages, public.legal_orders, public.legal_order_items, public.legal_order_events TO korbat_api;
GRANT UPDATE (disposition, handled_by) ON public.contact_messages TO korbat_api;
GRANT INSERT (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by) ON public.legal_orders TO korbat_api;
GRANT INSERT (id, order_id, position, link, post_id) ON public.legal_order_items TO korbat_api;
GRANT UPDATE (intake_item_id) ON public.legal_order_items TO korbat_api;
GRANT INSERT (order_id, item_id, kind, effective_at, ground, by_staff) ON public.legal_order_events TO korbat_api;

-- Forced columns. The functions are plain, so current_user is the role that ran the statement: the migrator (the command
-- line, and the import after a restore) may supply what the API may not.
CREATE FUNCTION public.legal_orders_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF current_user <> 'korbat_migrate' THEN
    NEW.opened_at := clock_timestamp();
    NEW.opened_via := 'console';
    NEW.channel := 'mailbox';
    NEW.received_at := (SELECT m.received_at FROM public.contact_messages m WHERE m.id = NEW.message_id);
    NEW.sent_at := NULL; NEW.issued_at := NULL; NEW.authority_hold_until := NULL; NEW.hold_extended := false; NEW.hold_ended_at := NULL;
    NEW.verified_at := NULL; NEW.closed_at := NULL; NEW.imported_at := NULL;
    IF NEW.message_id IS NULL OR NEW.received_at IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_needs_message';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  IF NEW.kind = 'tco_removal' THEN
    NEW.withhold_from_author := true;
  END IF;
  NEW.preserve := NEW.kind = 'tco_removal';
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER legal_orders_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.legal_orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.legal_orders_insert();
CREATE FUNCTION public.legal_order_events_insert() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
BEGIN
  IF current_user <> 'korbat_migrate' THEN
    NEW.at := clock_timestamp();
    NEW.via := 'console';
    IF NEW.kind NOT IN ('opened', 'annex3_sent', 'grounds_ceased', 'clarification_received', 'annex2_sent', 'receipt_confirmed', 'closed_without_effect') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_event_cli_only' USING DETAIL = NEW.kind;
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.at IS NULL THEN
    NEW.at := clock_timestamp();
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $$;
CREATE TRIGGER legal_order_events_insert BEFORE INSERT ON public.legal_order_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.legal_order_events_insert();

-- The end of a non-disclosure period, never early: the calendar date of the instant in UTC+3 (POSIX 'Etc/GMT-3', the
-- easternmost EU seat in summer), plus 43 days (the day of the event is not counted; the period ends with the last hour
-- of the same weekday six weeks later), plus 42 when extended, at 00:00 in UTC-1 (POSIX 'Etc/GMT+1', the Azores in winter).
CREATE FUNCTION public.order_hold_end(from_instant timestamptz, extended boolean) RETURNS timestamptz
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT (((order_hold_end.from_instant AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-3')::date + 43 + CASE WHEN order_hold_end.extended THEN 42 ELSE 0 END)::timestamp) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT+1'
$$;
-- Until when an order's notice is held: null when nothing is held.
CREATE FUNCTION public.order_hold_until(order_id uuid) RETURNS timestamptz
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT o.section_c THEN NULL
              WHEN o.hold_ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN o.hold_ended_at
              ELSE least(public.order_hold_end(coalesce(o.issued_at, o.received_at, o.opened_at), o.hold_extended),
                         coalesce(o.authority_hold_until, 'infinity'::timestamptz)) END
    FROM public.legal_orders o WHERE o.id = order_hold_until.order_id
$$;
-- Six calendar months in UTC, as appeal_deadline counts them, plus a day.
CREATE FUNCTION public.order_preserve_until(disabled timestamptz) RETURNS timestamptz
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  SELECT ((order_preserve_until.disabled AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') + interval '6 months' + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
$$;
-- The clock of a TCO removal order.
CREATE VIEW public.legal_order_clock WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT o.id AS order_id, s.clock_start, s.stopped,
       CASE WHEN NOT s.stopped THEN s.clock_start + interval '60 minutes' END AS deadline_at,
       CASE WHEN NOT s.stopped THEN s.clock_start + interval '55 minutes' END AS target_at,
       e.first_effect_at,
       e.first_effect_at <= s.clock_start + interval '60 minutes' AS within_hour
  FROM public.legal_orders o
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT greatest(least(o.received_at, coalesce(o.sent_at, o.received_at)),
                    (SELECT max(coalesce(v.effective_at, v.at)) FROM public.legal_order_events v
                      WHERE v.order_id = o.id AND v.kind IN ('grounds_ceased', 'clarification_received'))) AS clock_start,
           EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_events a WHERE a.order_id = o.id AND a.kind = 'annex3_sent'
                    AND a.at > coalesce((SELECT max(coalesce(v.effective_at, v.at)) FROM public.legal_order_events v
                                          WHERE v.order_id = o.id AND v.kind IN ('grounds_ceased', 'clarification_received')), '-infinity')) AS stopped
  ) s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(i.disabled_at) AS first_effect_at FROM public.legal_order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) e
 WHERE o.kind = 'tco_removal';
GRANT SELECT ON public.legal_order_clock TO korbat_api;

-- decisions: the order item, a notice that may be held, and the two CHECKs an order decision cannot meet.
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD COLUMN order_item_id uuid REFERENCES public.legal_order_items;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ALTER COLUMN informed_at DROP NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions DROP CONSTRAINT decisions_restricted;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD CONSTRAINT decisions_restricted CHECK (outcome <> 'restricted' OR (ground IS NOT NULL AND ((facts_digest IS NOT NULL AND reason_digest IS NOT NULL) OR kind::text = 'order')));
ALTER TABLE public.decisions DROP CONSTRAINT decisions_ground_law;
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD CONSTRAINT decisions_ground_law CHECK (ground IS DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' OR legal_reference_digest IS NOT NULL OR kind::text = 'order');
ALTER TABLE public.decisions ADD CONSTRAINT decisions_informed CHECK (informed_at IS NOT NULL OR order_item_id IS NOT NULL OR reviews_decision_id IS NOT NULL);
ALTER TABLE public.decision_actions ADD COLUMN withhold_author boolean;
ALTER TABLE public.decision_actions ADD COLUMN order_ground text CHECK (order_ground IN ('withdrawn', 'annulled', 'scrutiny', 'not_authentic', 'wrong_item'));

-- "In force" for the new measure: like any measure of a decision that is not interim, until a row reverses it.
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.measures_in_force WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT a.id, a.kind, a.post_id, a.media_id, a.subject_account_id, d.id AS decision_id, d.kind AS decision_kind, d.case_id
  FROM public.decision_actions a
  JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id
 WHERE (a.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio') OR a.kind::text = 'disable_by_order')
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions r WHERE r.reverses_action_id = a.id)
   AND (d.kind <> 'interim'
     OR CASE WHEN a.kind = 'seal_media'
          THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i
                        WHERE i.case_id = d.case_id AND i.suspect AND i.answered_by IS NULL AND i.created_at <= d.decided_at)
          ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cases c WHERE c.id = d.case_id AND c.closed_at IS NULL)
        END);

-- The release of held notices: the only writer of an order decision's informed_at after its insert.
CREATE FUNCTION public.order_notices_release() RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  n integer;
BEGIN
  WITH due AS (
    SELECT d.id, i.id AS item_id, i.order_id
      FROM public.decisions d JOIN public.legal_order_items i ON i.id = d.order_item_id
     WHERE d.informed_at IS NULL AND d.order_item_id IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(public.order_hold_until(i.order_id) <= clock_timestamp(), true)
     ORDER BY d.id FOR UPDATE OF d),
  told AS (
    UPDATE public.decisions d SET informed_at = now(), author_mail = 'pending' FROM due WHERE d.id = due.id RETURNING due.order_id, due.item_id)
  INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, via) SELECT t.order_id, t.item_id, 'notice_released', 'system' FROM told t;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  -- Corrections (reinstatements) of a held order decision are told with it.
  UPDATE public.decisions r SET informed_at = now(), author_mail = 'pending'
    FROM public.decisions d WHERE r.reviews_decision_id = d.id AND r.informed_at IS NULL AND d.informed_at IS NOT NULL AND d.order_item_id IS NOT NULL;
  RETURN n;
END $$;
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION public.order_notices_release() FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.order_notices_release() TO korbat_api;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/21-helpers.sql`

```sql
-- LAB 3f helpers, run as korbat_migrate after 20-proto.sql. SECURITY INVOKER: called by korbat_api they run the
-- statements the API would run, in the caller's transaction, so the triggers, locks and deferred checks are the real ones.
CREATE TABLE public.lab_events (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, kind text NOT NULL, n integer, took_ms numeric, at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp());
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON public.lab_events TO korbat_api;
GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCE public.lab_events_id_seq TO korbat_api;
ALTER TABLE public.lab_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY lab_events_all ON public.lab_events FOR ALL TO korbat_api USING (true) WITH CHECK (true);

CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_salt() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS $$ SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(gen_random_uuid()::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') $$;
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_digest(salt text, body text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$
  SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to('korbat.text.v1', 'UTF8') || decode('0a', 'hex') || decode(salt, 'hex') || convert_to(body, 'UTF8')), 'hex') $$;
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_ref() RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql VOLATILE AS $$ SELECT 'N-' || translate(upper(substr(public.lab_salt(), 1, 10)), '0189', 'GHIJ') $$;

-- Opens an order from a contact message, as POST /api/staff/orders would: the row, its items, the event.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_order_open(msg uuid, kind text, state text, authority text, reference text, section_c boolean, posts uuid[], staff uuid) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  oid uuid := gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, message_id, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, opened_by)
  VALUES (oid, kind, state, authority, reference, 'mailbox', msg, section_c, false, state <> 'DE', kind = 'tco_removal', staff);
  INSERT INTO public.legal_order_items (id, order_id, position, link, post_id)
  SELECT gen_random_uuid(), oid, t.n, 'https://korbat.example/post/' || t.p, t.p FROM unnest(posts) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(p, n);
  INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, by_staff) VALUES (oid, 'opened', staff);
  RETURN oid;
END $$;

-- "Disable for an order": one transaction for up to ten items, one audit row. tamper names a fault to inject.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_order_effect(oid uuid, decider uuid, key uuid, tamper text DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  o public.legal_orders;
  it record;
  c public.cases;
  iid uuid;
  item_id uuid;
  snap uuid;
  s text;
  dg text;
  did uuid;
  h text;
  ids jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  items jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  n integer := 0;
  t0 timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
  SELECT x.* INTO o FROM public.legal_orders x WHERE x.id = oid;
  -- 1. The authors' profiles, in id order.
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id IN (SELECT q.author_id FROM public.legal_order_items i JOIN public.posts q ON q.id = i.post_id WHERE i.order_id = oid)
    ORDER BY p.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
  INSERT INTO public.intakes (kind, ref, channel, alleges_illegal, category, received_at)
  VALUES ('order', public.lab_ref(), 'authority', true, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', now()) RETURNING id INTO iid;
  -- 2. The intake items first, in post id order: each insert's attach trigger takes its case, so the cases are taken in
  -- their targets' order before any post (the API role cannot lock a case itself: it holds no UPDATE on cases).
  FOR it IN SELECT i.id, i.post_id FROM public.legal_order_items i JOIN public.posts q ON q.id = i.post_id
             WHERE i.order_id = oid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = i.action_id) ORDER BY i.post_id LOOP
    n := n + 1;
    SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.target_type = 'post' AND k.target_id = it.post_id AND k.closed_at IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      INSERT INTO public.cases (target_type, target_id, opened_at) VALUES ('post', it.post_id, now()) RETURNING * INTO c;
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO public.intake_items (intake_id, position, target_type, target_id, case_id, lane, created_at)
    VALUES (iid, n, 'post', it.post_id, c.id, 0, now()) RETURNING id INTO item_id;
    UPDATE public.legal_order_items SET intake_item_id = item_id WHERE id = it.id;
  END LOOP;
  -- 3. Then, post by post in id order: the snapshot, the decision and its measure.
  FOR it IN SELECT i.id, i.post_id, q.author_id, a.handle, x.case_id FROM public.legal_order_items i JOIN public.posts q ON q.id = i.post_id
              JOIN public.profiles a ON a.id = q.author_id JOIN public.intake_items x ON x.id = i.intake_item_id
             WHERE i.order_id = oid AND x.intake_id = iid ORDER BY i.post_id LOOP
    SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = it.case_id;
    s := public.lab_salt();
    dg := public.lab_digest(s, 'snapshot of ' || it.post_id);
    INSERT INTO public.evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, taken_at, author_handle, post_state, post_created_at, body, salt, digest)
    SELECT c.id, 'post', q.id, now(), it.handle, q.state, q.created_at, q.body, s, dg FROM public.posts q WHERE q.id = it.post_id RETURNING id INTO snap;
    INSERT INTO public.decisions (case_id, kind, order_item_id, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, ground, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                  snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
    VALUES (c.id, 'order', it.id, c.state_version, 0, 'restricted', 'illegal', 2, 1, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'own_initiative',
            snap, dg, decider, now(), pg_current_xact_id(), 'x', now(), false, false, false) RETURNING id INTO did;
    INSERT INTO public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, subject_account_id, created_at) VALUES (did, 'disable_by_order', it.author_id, now());
    IF tamper = 'extra_measure' THEN
      INSERT INTO public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, subject_account_id, created_at) VALUES (did, 'remove', it.author_id, now());
    END IF;
    ids := ids || jsonb_build_object(it.id::text, did);
    IF NOT (tamper IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'missing_item' AND ids = jsonb_build_object(it.id::text, did)) THEN
      items := items || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('itemId', it.id, 'postId', it.post_id));
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  IF tamper = 'no_audit' THEN RETURN n; END IF;
  PERFORM public.append_confirmed_audit(decider, key, CASE WHEN tamper = 'wrong_action' THEN 'case_decided' ELSE 'order_effected' END, 'order', oid::text,
    jsonb_build_object('decisionIds', ids, 'params', jsonb_build_object('kind', o.kind, 'memberState', o.member_state, 'authority', o.authority,
      'reference', CASE WHEN tamper = 'wrong_reference' THEN 'forged' ELSE o.reference END, 'sectionC', o.section_c, 'emergency', o.emergency,
      'withholdFromAuthor', o.withhold_from_author, 'items', items)),
    gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64), '{}'::jsonb, 'lab', (extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint + 60000);
  INSERT INTO public.lab_events (kind, n, took_ms) VALUES ('order_effect', n, extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp() - t0) * 1000);
  RETURN n;
END $$;

-- An ordinary 3c removal of a post on a moderator's finding (final, restricted, ground incompatible), for the derivation test.
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_remove(post uuid, decider uuid, key uuid, rule text) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.cases; iid uuid; s text; dg text; fd text; rd text; snap uuid; d public.decisions; author uuid; h text;
BEGIN
  SELECT q.author_id, a.handle INTO author, h FROM public.posts q JOIN public.profiles a ON a.id = q.author_id WHERE q.id = post;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = author FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.target_type = 'post' AND k.target_id = post AND k.closed_at IS NULL;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN INSERT INTO public.cases (target_type, target_id, opened_at) VALUES ('post', post, now()) RETURNING * INTO c; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.intakes (kind, ref, channel, finding_by, rule_id, category, received_at)
  VALUES ('finding', public.lab_ref(), 'staff', decider, rule, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', now()) RETURNING id INTO iid;
  INSERT INTO public.intake_items (intake_id, position, target_type, target_id, case_id, lane, created_at) VALUES (iid, 1, 'post', post, c.id, 1, now());
  s := public.lab_salt(); dg := public.lab_digest(s, 'snap');
  INSERT INTO public.evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, taken_at, author_handle, body, salt, digest) VALUES (c.id, 'post', post, now(), h, 'b', s, dg) RETURNING id INTO snap;
  s := public.lab_salt(); fd := public.lab_digest(s, 'facts');
  INSERT INTO public.staff_texts (case_id, author_id, kind, text, salt, digest, created_at) VALUES (c.id, decider, 'facts', 'facts', s, fd, now());
  s := public.lab_salt(); rd := public.lab_digest(s, 'reason');
  INSERT INTO public.staff_texts (case_id, author_id, kind, text, salt, digest, created_at) VALUES (c.id, decider, 'reason', 'reason', s, rd, now());
  SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = c.id;
  INSERT INTO public.decisions (case_id, kind, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, ground, rule_id, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, facts_digest, reason_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
  VALUES (c.id, 'final', c.state_version, c.intake_seq, 'restricted', 'incompatible', rule, 2, 1, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', 'own_initiative',
          snap, dg, fd, rd, decider, now(), pg_current_xact_id(), 'x', now(), false, false, false) RETURNING * INTO d;
  INSERT INTO public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, subject_account_id, created_at) VALUES (d.id, 'remove', author, now());
  PERFORM public.append_confirmed_audit(decider, key, 'case_decided', 'case', c.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('decisionId', d.id, 'params', jsonb_build_object('kind', d.kind, 'stateVersion', d.seen_state_version, 'throughSeq', d.through_seq,
      'reviewsDecisionId', d.reviews_decision_id, 'snapshotId', d.snapshot_id, 'snapshotDigest', d.snapshot_digest, 'outcome', d.outcome,
      'ground', d.ground, 'ruleId', d.rule_id, 'rulesVersion', d.rules_version, 'redressVersion', d.redress_version, 'category', d.category,
      'categoryKeyword', d.category_keyword, 'factsDigest', d.facts_digest, 'reasonDigest', d.reason_digest,
      'legalReferenceDigest', d.legal_reference_digest, 'actions', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind', 'remove', 'mediaId', NULL)))),
    gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64), '{}'::jsonb, 'lab', (extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint + 60000);
  RETURN d.id;
END $$;

-- A correction that reverses one decision in full: restore (a removal) or reinstate_by_order (an order's disabling).
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_correct(decision uuid, decider uuid, key uuid, reversal text, ground text DEFAULT NULL) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  o public.decisions; c public.cases; d public.decisions; author uuid; s text := public.lab_salt(); rd text; act jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT x.* INTO o FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = decision;
  SELECT x.* INTO c FROM public.cases x WHERE x.id = o.case_id;
  SELECT q.author_id INTO author FROM public.posts q WHERE q.id = c.target_id;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = author FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
  SELECT x.* INTO c FROM public.cases x WHERE x.id = o.case_id;
  rd := public.lab_digest(s, 'lab correction');
  INSERT INTO public.staff_texts (case_id, author_id, kind, text, salt, digest, created_at) VALUES (c.id, decider, 'review_reason', 'lab correction', s, rd, now());
  INSERT INTO public.decisions (case_id, kind, reviews_decision_id, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                                snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, reason_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
  VALUES (c.id, 'correction', o.id, c.state_version, 0, 'reversed', o.rules_version, 1, o.category, 'own_initiative',
          o.snapshot_id, o.snapshot_digest, rd, decider, now(), pg_current_xact_id(), 'x', now(), false, false, false) RETURNING * INTO d;
  INSERT INTO public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, subject_account_id, order_ground, created_at) VALUES (d.id, reversal::public.action_kind, author, ground, now());
  act := jsonb_build_object('kind', reversal, 'mediaId', NULL) || CASE WHEN ground IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('orderGround', ground) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END;
  PERFORM public.append_confirmed_audit(decider, key, 'case_decided', 'case', c.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('decisionId', d.id, 'params', jsonb_build_object('kind', d.kind, 'stateVersion', d.seen_state_version, 'throughSeq', d.through_seq,
      'reviewsDecisionId', d.reviews_decision_id, 'snapshotId', d.snapshot_id, 'snapshotDigest', d.snapshot_digest, 'outcome', d.outcome,
      'ground', d.ground, 'ruleId', d.rule_id, 'rulesVersion', d.rules_version, 'redressVersion', d.redress_version, 'category', d.category,
      'categoryKeyword', d.category_keyword, 'factsDigest', d.facts_digest, 'reasonDigest', d.reason_digest,
      'legalReferenceDigest', d.legal_reference_digest, 'actions', jsonb_build_array(act))),
    gen_random_uuid(), repeat('a', 64), '{}'::jsonb, 'lab', (extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) * 1000)::bigint + 60000);
  RETURN d.id;
END $$;

-- What the readers decide, as SQL: postAccess (apps/api/src/social/visibility.ts:20) and serve's isShown (media/flows/serve.ts:23).
CREATE FUNCTION public.lab_post_access(viewer uuid, post uuid) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
  SELECT CASE q.state::text WHEN 'deleted_by_author' THEN 'deleted' WHEN 'visible' THEN 'shown'
                            WHEN 'withheld' THEN CASE WHEN viewer = q.author_id THEN 'shown' ELSE 'hidden' END
                            WHEN 'removed' THEN CASE WHEN viewer = q.author_id THEN 'shown' ELSE 'hidden' END
                            ELSE 'hidden' END FROM public.posts q WHERE q.id = post $$;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.lab_salt(), public.lab_digest(text, text), public.lab_ref(),
  public.lab_order_open(uuid, text, text, text, text, boolean, uuid[], uuid), public.lab_order_effect(uuid, uuid, uuid, text),
  public.lab_remove(uuid, uuid, uuid, text), public.lab_correct(uuid, uuid, uuid, text, text), public.lab_post_access(uuid, uuid),
  public.order_rules(), public.order_hold_end(timestamptz, boolean), public.order_hold_until(uuid), public.order_preserve_until(timestamptz) TO korbat_api;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/RUN.txt`

```text
LAB 3f, run 2026-10-09 between 15:41 and 15:54 local time.

Where it ran. The brief names throwaway PostgreSQL 18 containers korbat3f-lab-<n>. The Docker engine stopped answering
before the first lab (docker info: "request returned 500 Internal Server Error", then no answer; `wsl -l -v` showed
the distribution docker-desktop as Stopped). It was not restarted from here, since that would start other people's
containers. No container korbat3f-lab-<n> was created. The labs ran instead on a throwaway cluster made with the
PostgreSQL 18.1 binaries installed on this machine (C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\bin; "PostgreSQL 18.1 on
x86_64-windows, compiled by msvc"), in a directory of the session's scratchpad, on 127.0.0.1:55441, trust
authentication, stopped and deleted at the end. The earlier labs ran on 18.6 (alpine): the minor version and the
platform differ, the migrations and trigger code are the same files. Session time zone: Europe/Budapest (the system's).

Commands (PGBIN = the bin directory, P = -h localhost -p 55441, M = korbat-scratch/repo/packages/db/migrations at HEAD 4be080f):
  initdb -D <scratchpad>/pg3f -U postgres -A trust -E UTF8 --locale=C ; pg_ctl -D ... -o "-p 55441 -c listen_addresses=localhost" start
  psql $P -U postgres -f 00-roles.sql ; psql $P -U postgres -d lab -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto"
  for f in M/*.sql (0000 to 0016, name order): psql $P -U korbat_migrate -d lab -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -1 -f $f     -> 39 tables
  python make_proto.py M/0015_greedy_zuras.sql M/0016_decisions_and_ledger.sql 20-tables.sql > 20-proto.sql
  sh reset.sh                                  (lab3f from the template lab: 20-proto.sql with -1, 21-helpers.sql, 22-seed.sql)
  A: out-A.txt                                 (the prototype's own run, inside reset.sh)
  C: psql $P -U korbat_api -d lab3f -X -q -f c-derivation.sql      > out-C.txt   (on a fresh reset)
  E: sh reset.sh ; psql $P -U korbat_api -d lab3f -X -q -f e-hold.sql > out-E.txt
  B, D: psql -U korbat_api -f bd-clock-effect.sql ; psql -U postgres -f d-waivers.sql   > out-BD.txt (same database as E)
  F: CREATE DATABASE labf TEMPLATE lab3f ; psql -U postgres -d lab3f -f f1-lost-work.sql (writes tail.jsonl) ; psql -U postgres -d labf -f f2-restore.sql > out-F.txt
  B2: psql -U korbat_api -d lab3f -f b2-clock.sql ; one query on labf   > out-B2.txt
Files: 20-tables.sql and make_proto.py are the prototype's source; 20-proto.sql is generated; 21-helpers.sql stands in
for the API's statements (SECURITY INVOKER, called as korbat_api); out-*.txt are the raw outputs.
Not measured: lock contention (one session at a time); the API's TypeScript readers (postAccess and serve are mirrored
in SQL by lab_post_access and one expression); audit-verify against a forged confirmation; anything of notify, ntfy,
Caddy or a phone; 3e's migrations 0019 to 0023 and 3c's 0017 and 0018, which are not built (the prototype sits on 0016).
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/c-derivation.sql`

```sql
-- LAB C, as korbat_api: the new measure against moderation_apply's derivation, the readers, hiding from the author, the freeze.
\set S '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'
\set T '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002'
\set M '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a'
\set KM '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa'
\set N '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b'
\set KN '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb'
\set P1 '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01'
\set P2 '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02'
\set PN '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000c01'
\pset format unaligned
\pset tuples_only on
\echo C1 a TCO order without Section C on P1 (two images) and on the post of the moderator, opened and given effect by the moderator N
select lab_order_open('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000e01', 'tco_removal', 'FR', 'OCLCTIC', 'TCO-1', false, array[:'P1', :'PN']::uuid[], :'N') as o1 \gset
begin; select lab_order_effect(:'o1', :'N', :'KN') as items; commit;
select 'post', right(id::text, 4), state, moderation_level from posts where id in (:'P1', :'PN') order by id;
select 'decision', kind, source, outcome, ground, category_keyword, needs_admin, informed_at = decided_at as told_at_once, author_mail from decisions where order_item_id is not null order by decided_at, id;
select 'action', a.kind, a.withhold_author, a.no_effect from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id where d.order_item_id is not null;
select 'item', position, disabled_at is not null as disabled, preserve_until = order_preserve_until(disabled_at) as preserved_6m_1d, preserve_until - disabled_at as span from legal_order_items where order_id = :'o1' order by position;
select 'case', right(target_id::text, 4), closed_at is not null as closed, intake_seq, answered_seq from cases order by target_id;
select 'clock', stopped, deadline_at - clock_start as hour, within_hour from legal_order_clock where order_id = :'o1';
\echo C2 the readers: postAccess as SQL for the author, another account and signed out; isShown of serve on the state of the post; the own state of each image
select 'postAccess author', lab_post_access(:'S', :'P1'), 'other', lab_post_access(:'T', :'P1'), 'signed out', lab_post_access(null, :'P1');
select 'serve isShown(post state)', state::text in ('visible', 'withheld', 'removed') from posts where id = :'P1';
select 'image', right(id::text, 4), moderation_state from post_media where post_id = :'P1' order by id;
select 'frozen (preserved)', post_frozen(:'P1');
\echo C3 gate K: a delete of the images of a preserved post deletes nothing
delete from post_media where post_id = :'P1' returning id;
select 'image rows left', count(*) from post_media where post_id = :'P1';
\echo C4 a removal under a korbat rule on the same post, after the order: the level stays disabled; the case and the order item
begin; select lab_remove(:'P1', :'M', :'KM', 'R5') as d_remove \gset
commit;
select 'post after remove', state, moderation_level from posts where id = :'P1';
select 'remove no_effect', no_effect from decision_actions where decision_id = :'d_remove';
\echo C5 reinstatement by the moderator is refused (admin); by the admin without a ground is refused; with a ground it lifts the measure of the order: the post is removed, not visible
select d.id as d_order from decisions d join legal_order_items i on i.id = d.order_item_id where i.post_id = :'P1' \gset
begin; select lab_correct(:'d_order', :'N', :'KN', 'reinstate_by_order', 'withdrawn'); rollback;
begin; select lab_correct(:'d_order', :'M', :'KM', 'reinstate_by_order', null); rollback;
begin; select lab_correct(:'d_order', :'M', :'KM', 'reinstate_by_order', 'withdrawn') as d_reinst \gset
commit;
select 'post after reinstatement', state, moderation_level, lab_post_access(:'S', :'P1') from posts where id = :'P1';
select 'item', reinstated_at is not null, preserve_ended_at is not null, 'frozen', post_frozen(:'P1') from legal_order_items where post_id = :'P1';
select 'events', string_agg(kind || coalesce(':' || ground, ''), ', ' order by at) from legal_order_events where order_id = :'o1';
\echo C6 the removal corrected too: visible again; then the other order: disable first, remove second, reverse the removal first
begin; select lab_correct(:'d_remove', :'M', :'KM', 'restore', null); commit;
select 'post after both reversals', state, moderation_level from posts where id = :'P1';
begin; select lab_remove(:'P2', :'M', :'KM', 'R5') as d_remove2 \gset
commit;
select lab_order_open('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000e03', 'tco_removal', 'FR', 'OCLCTIC', 'TCO-2', false, array[:'P2']::uuid[], :'N') as o2 \gset
begin; select lab_order_effect(:'o2', :'N', :'KN'); commit;
select 'P2 removed then disabled', state, moderation_level from posts where id = :'P2';
begin; select lab_correct(:'d_remove2', :'M', :'KM', 'restore', null); commit;
select 'P2 removal reversed, order stands', state, moderation_level, lab_post_access(:'S', :'P2') from posts where id = :'P2';
\echo C7 a dsa_art9 order that does not withhold from the author: level removed, shown to its author alone, nothing preserved
select lab_order_open('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000e04', 'dsa_art9', 'DE', 'Landesmedienanstalt', 'A9-1', false, array['00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b03']::uuid[], :'N') as o3 \gset
begin; select lab_order_effect(:'o3', :'N', :'KN'); commit;
select 'art9 post', state, moderation_level, lab_post_access(:'S', id), lab_post_access(:'T', id), 'frozen', post_frozen(id) from posts where id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b03';
\echo C8 the author deletes a disabled post by the statement of the API (posts_guard allows it; the route must answer not_found first)
update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '' where id = :'P2';
select 'deleted while disabled', state, moderation_level from posts where id = :'P2';
select 'snapshot kept', count(*) filter (where body is not null), 'frozen', post_frozen(:'P2') from evidence_snapshots where target_id = :'P2';
\echo C9 what the API role may not do
insert into legal_order_events (order_id, kind) values (:'o1', 'hold_ended');
update legal_orders set section_c = true where id = :'o1';
update legal_order_items set preserve_until = now() where order_id = :'o1';
update decisions set informed_at = now() where order_item_id is not null;
insert into legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'tco_removal', 'FR', 'x', 'no-message', 'mailbox', false, false, true, true);
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/d-waivers.sql`

```sql
-- LAB D3 to D5, set up as the superuser, acted as korbat_api: the checks an order decision is not held to, and the release.
\pset format unaligned
\pset tuples_only on
\echo D3 the moderator N is linked to a personal account that is the author S: a removal by N is refused; with the decision caps at zero a removal by the admin is refused; the order is given effect by N all the same
insert into auth.staff_personal_accounts (staff_user_id, personal_user_id) values ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001');
set role korbat_api;
begin; select lab_remove('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb', 'R5'); commit;
reset role;
update public.moderation_limits set decisions_per_hour = 0, decisions_per_day = 0;
set role korbat_api;
begin; select lab_remove('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa', 'R5'); commit;
begin; select lab_order_effect((select id from legal_orders where reference = 'D-R'), '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb') as items; commit;
select 'given effect', count(*) from posts where id in ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b03', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b02') and state::text = 'disabled';
reset role;
\echo D4 the release at the end of the hold, with the real clock: the authority gave a written end three seconds from now (set as the migrator)
update public.legal_orders set authority_hold_until = clock_timestamp() + interval '3 seconds' where reference = 'D-10';
set role korbat_api;
select 'before the end', order_notices_release();
select pg_sleep(2);
select 'one second before the end', order_notices_release(), (select count(informed_at) from decisions d join legal_order_items i on i.id = d.order_item_id join legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id where o.reference = 'D-10');
select pg_sleep(1.2);
select 'after the end', order_notices_release();
select 'told', count(informed_at), min(author_mail::text), bool_and(informed_at > decided_at) from decisions d join legal_order_items i on i.id = d.order_item_id join legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id where o.reference = 'D-10';
select 'events', count(*) from legal_order_events where kind = 'notice_released';
select 'again', order_notices_release();
\echo D5 the predicate at the last microsecond of a computed end
select order_hold_end('2026-10-06 21:30+00', false) <= order_hold_end('2026-10-06 21:30+00', false) - interval '1 microsecond' as released_one_microsecond_before, order_hold_end('2026-10-06 21:30+00', false) <= order_hold_end('2026-10-06 21:30+00', false) as released_at_the_end;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/e-hold.sql`

```sql
-- LAB E: the end of a non-disclosure period. (1) order_hold_end against Regulation 1182/71 Art. 3 in EU time zones;
-- (2) the release at the period's last moment, with the real clock.
\pset format unaligned
\pset tuples_only on
\echo E1 300,000 random instants of 2026 to 2030 and the hours around every clock change, in eight zones: hold_end minus the end of the same weekday six weeks later in that zone
with zones(z) as (values ('Atlantic/Azores'), ('Europe/Lisbon'), ('Europe/Dublin'), ('Europe/Berlin'), ('Europe/Paris'), ('Europe/Helsinki'), ('Europe/Athens'), ('Asia/Nicosia')),
t as (select timestamptz '2026-01-01 00:00+00' + random() * interval '1826 days' as at from generate_series(1, 300000)
      union all select d + (h || ' minutes')::interval from unnest(array[timestamptz '2026-03-29 00:00+00', '2026-10-25 00:00+00', '2027-03-28 00:00+00', '2027-10-31 00:00+00']) d,
                generate_series(-180, 1620, 1) h
      union all select (d - 43)::timestamp at time zone 'UTC' + (h || ' minutes')::interval from unnest(array[date '2026-03-29', '2026-10-25', '2027-03-28', '2027-10-31']) d, generate_series(-180, 1620, 1) h)
select z, count(*) as instants,
       count(*) filter (where public.order_hold_end(at, false) < (((at at time zone z)::date + 43)::timestamp at time zone z)) as early,
       min(public.order_hold_end(at, false) - (((at at time zone z)::date + 43)::timestamp at time zone z)) as least_late,
       max(public.order_hold_end(at, false) - (((at at time zone z)::date + 43)::timestamp at time zone z)) as most_late
  from t cross join zones group by z order by z;
\echo E2 the hold from the instant itself: shortest and longest; and an extension adds exactly 42 days
select min(public.order_hold_end(at, false) - at), max(public.order_hold_end(at, false) - at), min(public.order_hold_end(at, true) - public.order_hold_end(at, false)), max(public.order_hold_end(at, true) - public.order_hold_end(at, false))
  from (select timestamptz '2026-01-01 00:00+00' + random() * interval '1826 days' as at from generate_series(1, 300000)) t;
\echo E3 the same value in three session time zones; and against the plain "plus 42 days" of the earlier lab
set timezone = 'UTC'; select 'UTC', public.order_hold_end('2026-10-06 21:30+00', false) at time zone 'UTC', (timestamptz '2026-10-06 21:30+00' + interval '42 days') at time zone 'UTC';
set timezone = 'Europe/Berlin'; select 'Berlin', public.order_hold_end('2026-10-06 21:30+00', false) at time zone 'UTC', (timestamptz '2026-10-06 21:30+00' + interval '42 days') at time zone 'UTC';
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/f2-restore.sql`

```sql
-- LAB F, part 2, on labf (the restored backup). The import as the migrator, the attempts to write the ledger without
-- a key, and the re-application under a key. Run as the superuser, with SET ROLE for each actor.
\pset format unaligned
\pset tuples_only on
\echo F4 the restored database: the head, and the lost order and measures are not there
select seq, left(hash, 12) from public.audit_head;
select 'orders F-1', count(*) from public.legal_orders where reference = 'F-1';
select 'state', right(id::text, 4), state from public.posts where id in ('00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b0e') order by id;
set role korbat_migrate;
create table public.restore_gaps (id bigserial primary key, place bigint not null, hash text not null, action text not null, target_type text, target_id text,
  metadata jsonb, acted_at timestamptz not null, class text not null, closed_at timestamptz, closed_by uuid, disposition text);
create table public.restore_tail (line jsonb not null);
\copy public.restore_tail from 'tail.jsonl' with (format csv, quote E'\x01', delimiter E'\x02')
-- The import: refuses a tail that does not continue the restored head; inserts the plain records again with their
-- original times; writes one gap a lost row; touches neither decisions nor decision_actions.
create function public.lab_restore_import() returns text language plpgsql set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  head public.audit_head;
  r record;
  prev text;
  n_orders integer := 0;
  n_gaps integer := 0;
  oid uuid;
begin
  select h.* into head from public.audit_head h where h.id = 1;
  prev := head.hash;
  for r in select t.line from public.restore_tail t where (t.line ->> 'place')::bigint > head.seq order by (t.line ->> 'place')::bigint loop
    if r.line ->> 'prevHash' is distinct from prev then
      raise exception 'tail_not_continuous' using detail = format('place %s does not follow the restored head or the row before it', r.line ->> 'place');
    end if;
    prev := r.line ->> 'hash';
    if r.line ->> 'action' = 'order_opened' then
      oid := (r.line ->> 'targetId')::uuid;
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, received_at, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author,
                                       opened_by, opened_via, opened_at, imported_at)
      select oid, m ->> 'kind', m ->> 'memberState', m ->> 'authority', m ->> 'reference', m ->> 'channel', (m ->> 'receivedAt')::timestamptz, (m ->> 'sectionC')::boolean,
             (m ->> 'emergency')::boolean, (m ->> 'crossBorder')::boolean, (m ->> 'withholdFromAuthor')::boolean, (r.line ->> 'actor')::uuid, 'console',
             (m ->> 'openedAt')::timestamptz, now()
        from (select r.line -> 'metadata' as m) x;
      insert into public.legal_order_items (id, order_id, position, link, post_id)
      select (i ->> 'itemId')::uuid, oid, (i ->> 'position')::smallint, i ->> 'link', (i ->> 'postId')::uuid from jsonb_array_elements(r.line -> 'metadata' -> 'items') i;
      insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, at, by_staff, via) values (oid, 'opened', (r.line ->> 'at')::timestamptz, (r.line ->> 'actor')::uuid, 'console'), (oid, 'imported', null, null, 'cli');
      n_orders := n_orders + 1;
    elsif r.line ->> 'action' = 'order_effected' then
      -- The items keep the first disabling's time: preservation runs from it, and a re-applied disabling starts no new period.
      update public.legal_order_items i set disabled_at = (r.line ->> 'at')::timestamptz, preserve_until = public.order_preserve_until((r.line ->> 'at')::timestamptz)
       where i.id in (select (k)::uuid from jsonb_object_keys(r.line -> 'metadata' -> 'decisionIds') k);
    end if;
    insert into public.restore_gaps (place, hash, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, acted_at, class)
    values ((r.line ->> 'place')::bigint, r.line ->> 'hash', r.line ->> 'action', r.line ->> 'targetType', r.line ->> 'targetId', r.line -> 'metadata', (r.line ->> 'at')::timestamptz,
            case r.line ->> 'action' when 'order_effected' then 'order_effect' when 'order_opened' then 'record' else 'restriction' end);
    n_gaps := n_gaps + 1;
  end loop;
  update public.restore_gaps set closed_at = now(), disposition = 'imported' where class = 'record';
  return format('%s orders imported, %s gaps', n_orders, n_gaps);
end $$;
\echo F5 a tail whose first row does not follow the restored head is refused
begin;
update public.restore_tail set line = jsonb_set(line, '{prevHash}', '"00"') where (line ->> 'place')::bigint = (select min((line ->> 'place')::bigint) from public.restore_tail);
select public.lab_restore_import();
rollback;
\echo F6 the import
select public.lab_restore_import();
select 'gaps', place, action, class, disposition from public.restore_gaps order by place;
select 'order', reference, imported_at is not null, opened_at < now() - interval '1 second' as original_time, order_hold_until(id) is not null as held from public.legal_orders where reference = 'F-1';
select 'item', disabled_at is not null, preserve_until is not null, action_id is null as no_measure_yet, 'frozen already', post_frozen(post_id) from public.legal_order_items i join public.legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id where o.reference = 'F-1';
select 'ledger rows written by the import', count(*) from public.decisions d where d.decided_at > (select imported_at from public.legal_orders where reference = 'F-1') - interval '5 seconds' and d.decided_at >= (select max(closed_at) from public.restore_gaps);
select 'P1 still', state from public.posts where id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01';
\echo F7 the migrator copies the lost decision and its measure into the ledger by hand: (a) with no audit row; (b) with an audit row of the system actor
begin;
insert into public.cases (target_type, target_id, opened_at) values ('post', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01', now());
insert into public.intakes (kind, ref, channel, alleges_illegal, category, received_at) values ('order', public.lab_ref(), 'authority', true, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', now());
insert into public.intake_items (intake_id, position, target_type, target_id, case_id, lane, created_at)
select (select id from public.intakes order by received_at desc limit 1), 1, 'post', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01', (select id from public.cases where target_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01' and closed_at is null), 0, now();
update public.legal_order_items i set intake_item_id = (select x.id from public.intake_items x where x.target_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01' and x.answered_by is null)
 where i.post_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01' and i.order_id = (select id from public.legal_orders where reference = 'F-1');
insert into public.evidence_snapshots (case_id, target_type, target_id, taken_at, author_handle, body, salt, digest)
select c.id, 'post', c.target_id, now(), 's', 'x', repeat('ab', 32), public.lab_digest(repeat('ab', 32), 'x') from public.cases c where c.target_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01' and c.closed_at is null;
insert into public.decisions (case_id, kind, order_item_id, seen_state_version, through_seq, outcome, ground, rules_version, redress_version, category, source,
                              snapshot_id, snapshot_digest, decided_by, decided_at, xact, puid, informed_at, suspect, needs_admin, ended_interim)
select c.id, 'order', i.id, c.state_version, 0, 'restricted', 'illegal', 2, 1, 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'order', s.id, s.digest,
       '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', now() - interval '1 hour', '1'::xid8, 'x', now() - interval '1 hour', false, false, false
  from public.cases c join public.legal_order_items i on i.post_id = c.target_id join public.legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id and o.reference = 'F-1'
  join public.evidence_snapshots s on s.case_id = c.id where c.closed_at is null;
select 'forced by the trigger', decided_at = now() as decided_now, xact = pg_current_xact_id() as this_transaction from public.decisions order by decided_at desc limit 1;
insert into public.decision_actions (decision_id, kind, subject_account_id, created_at)
select d.id, 'disable_by_order', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001', now() - interval '1 hour' from public.decisions d order by d.decided_at desc limit 1;
select 'inside the transaction', state from public.posts where id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01';
savepoint a;
set constraints all immediate;
rollback to a;
insert into public.audit_log (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, metadata, request_id)
select '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', 'order_effected', 'order', o.id::text, '{}'::jsonb, 'lab' from public.legal_orders o where o.reference = 'F-1';
commit;
select 'after the refused commit', state from public.posts where id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01';
reset role;
\echo F8 the re-application: the moderator, under a key, "Disable for an order" on the imported order
set role korbat_api;
begin; select lab_order_effect((select id from legal_orders where reference = 'F-1'), '00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000b', '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000bb') as items; commit;
reset role;
set role korbat_migrate;
update public.restore_gaps g set closed_at = now(), disposition = 'reapplied', closed_by = (select i.decision_id from public.legal_order_items i where i.order_id::text = g.target_id limit 1) where g.class = 'order_effect';
select 'P1', state from public.posts where id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000b01';
select 'item', disabled_at < (select d.decided_at from public.decisions d where d.id = i.decision_id) as keeps_first_disabling, preserve_until = public.order_preserve_until(disabled_at) as keeps_first_period
  from public.legal_order_items i join public.legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id where o.reference = 'F-1';
select 'notice still held', d.informed_at is null, d.author_mail from public.decisions d join public.legal_order_items i on i.decision_id = d.id join public.legal_orders o on o.id = i.order_id where o.reference = 'F-1';
select 'open gaps', class, count(*) from public.restore_gaps where closed_at is null group by class;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/make_proto.py`

```python
"""Builds 20-proto.sql: the lab prototype of 3f's data model, run in ONE transaction on a database at migration 0016.

It copies eight objects of the scratch clone's 0016 and 0015 (decisions_record, decisions_apply, decision_actions_check,
decision_actions_apply, decision_holds, moderation_apply, append_confirmed_audit, frozen_for) and patches them by exact
text replacement, so the lab measures 3c's own trigger code with 3f's branches added. Everything parsed at creation
(views, SQL functions, CHECKs) names the new enum values only as text; PL/pgSQL bodies name them as literals.
Usage: python make_proto.py <0015.sql> <0016.sql> <20-tables.sql> > 20-proto.sql
"""
import re
import sys

src15 = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read().replace("--> statement-breakpoint", "")
src16 = open(sys.argv[2], encoding="utf-8").read().replace("--> statement-breakpoint", "")
tables = open(sys.argv[3], encoding="utf-8").read()


def fn(src: str, name: str) -> str:
    m = re.search(r'CREATE FUNCTION "public"\."' + name + r'"\(.*?(END \$\$;|\n\$\$;)', src, re.S)
    assert m, name
    return m.group(0).replace("CREATE FUNCTION", "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION", 1)


def sub(text: str, old: str, new: str) -> str:
    assert text.count(old) == 1, (old, text.count(old))
    return text.replace(old, new)


M7 = "'withhold', 'remove', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio'"

# ---- decisions_record
rec = fn(src16, "decisions_record")
rec = sub(rec, "  target_deleted boolean;\nBEGIN", "  target_deleted boolean;\n  oi public.legal_order_items;\n  o public.legal_orders;\n  held boolean := false;\nBEGIN")
rec = sub(rec, "     WHERE d.id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND d.case_id = NEW.case_id AND d.kind IN ('interim', 'final') AND d.outcome = 'restricted';",
          "     WHERE d.id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND d.case_id = NEW.case_id AND d.kind IN ('interim', 'final', 'order') AND d.outcome = 'restricted';")
rec = sub(rec, "  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A review waits for the migration that brings appeals.';\n  END IF;",
          "  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'order' THEN\n"
          "    SELECT x.* INTO oi FROM public.legal_order_items x WHERE x.id = NEW.order_item_id;\n"
          "    SELECT x.* INTO o FROM public.legal_orders x WHERE x.id = oi.order_id;\n"
          "    IF oi.id IS NULL OR NEW.outcome <> 'restricted' OR c.closed_at IS NOT NULL OR c.target_type <> 'post' OR c.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM oi.post_id\n"
          "       OR o.closed_at IS NOT NULL OR o.kind = 'dsa_art10' OR oi.intake_item_id IS NULL\n"
          "       OR NEW.ground IS DISTINCT FROM 'illegal' OR NEW.facts_digest IS NOT NULL OR NEW.reason_digest IS NOT NULL OR NEW.legal_reference_digest IS NOT NULL THEN\n"
          "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An order decision restricts the post its order item names, on the law, with no text of korbat''s.';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = oi.action_id) THEN\n"
          "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'The order item is already given effect.';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A review waits for the migration that brings appeals.';\n  END IF;\n"
          "  IF (NEW.kind = 'order') <> (NEW.order_item_id IS NOT NULL) THEN\n"
          "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'Only an order decision names an order item.';\n"
          "  END IF;")
rec = sub(rec, "     AND CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'final' THEN i.seq BETWEEN NEW.answers_from_seq AND NEW.through_seq\n"
               "              WHEN NEW.kind = 'correction' AND corrected.kind = 'final' THEN i.answered_by = corrected.id\n"
               "              ELSE i.answered_by IS NULL END;",
          "     AND CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'order' THEN i.id = oi.intake_item_id AND i.answered_by IS NULL\n"
          "              WHEN NEW.kind = 'final' THEN i.seq BETWEEN NEW.answers_from_seq AND NEW.through_seq AND n.kind <> 'order'\n"
          "              WHEN NEW.kind = 'correction' AND corrected.kind IN ('final', 'order') THEN i.answered_by = corrected.id\n"
          "              ELSE i.answered_by IS NULL AND n.kind <> 'order' END;")
rec = sub(rec, "  IF public.staff_party_conflict(NEW.decided_by,",
          "  IF NEW.kind <> 'order' AND NOT (NEW.kind = 'correction' AND corrected.kind = 'order') AND public.staff_party_conflict(NEW.decided_by,")
rec = sub(rec, "                       WHEN 'correction' THEN corrected.needs_admin\n",
          "                       WHEN 'correction' THEN corrected.needs_admin OR corrected.kind = 'order'\n")
rec = sub(rec, "    FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.decided_by = NEW.decided_by AND d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day';\n"
               "  IF in_hour >= coalesce(per_hour, 60) OR in_day >= coalesce(per_day, 300) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_cap';\n  END IF;",
          "    FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.decided_by = NEW.decided_by AND d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day' AND d.kind <> 'order';\n"
          "  IF NEW.kind <> 'order' AND (in_hour >= coalesce(per_hour, 60) OR in_day >= coalesce(per_day, 300)) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision_cap';\n  END IF;\n"
          "  IF NEW.kind = 'order' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.decided_by = NEW.decided_by AND d.kind = 'order'\n"
          "                               AND d.decided_at > now() - interval '1 day') >= (SELECT r.items_per_day FROM public.order_rules() r) THEN\n"
          "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'order_cap';\n  END IF;")
rec = sub(rec, "  NEW.source := CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'correction' THEN corrected.source\n",
          "  NEW.source := CASE WHEN NEW.kind = 'order' THEN 'order'::public.decision_source\n                     WHEN NEW.kind = 'correction' THEN corrected.source\n")
rec = sub(rec, "                       ELSE 'none' END::public.delivery_state;\n  RETURN NEW;",
          "                       ELSE 'none' END::public.delivery_state;\n"
          "  IF NEW.kind = 'order' THEN\n"
          "    NEW.needs_admin := false;\n"
          "    NEW.through_seq := 0;\n"
          "    IF o.kind = 'tco_removal' THEN\n"
          "      NEW.category := 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY';\n      NEW.category_keyword := 'KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "    held := coalesce(public.order_hold_until(o.id) > now(), false);\n"
          "    NEW.informed_at := CASE WHEN held THEN NULL ELSE NEW.decided_at END;\n"
          "    NEW.author_mail := CASE WHEN held THEN 'none' ELSE 'pending' END::public.delivery_state;\n"
          "  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'correction' AND corrected.kind = 'order' AND corrected.informed_at IS NULL THEN\n"
          "    -- A reinstatement while the notice is held tells nothing either.\n"
          "    NEW.informed_at := NULL;\n    NEW.author_mail := 'none';\n"
          "  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;")

# ---- decisions_apply
app = fn(src16, "decisions_apply")
app = sub(app, "  confirmed integer;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.kind = 'final' THEN",
          "  confirmed integer;\n  answered integer;\nBEGIN\n"
          "  IF NEW.kind = 'order' THEN\n"
          "    UPDATE public.intake_items i SET answered_by = NEW.id, outcome = 'restricted_legal'\n"
          "     WHERE i.id = (SELECT x.intake_item_id FROM public.legal_order_items x WHERE x.id = NEW.order_item_id)\n"
          "       AND i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by IS NULL;\n"
          "    GET DIAGNOSTICS answered = ROW_COUNT;\n"
          "    IF answered <> 1 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An order decision answers its own item.';\n    END IF;\n"
          "    SELECT count(*), min(i.lane), min(i.created_at) INTO open_items, open_lane, oldest\n"
          "      FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by IS NULL;\n"
          "    UPDATE public.cases k\n"
          "       SET state_version = k.state_version + 1, last_decided_at = now(), lane = coalesce(open_lane, 2), oldest_open_at = oldest,\n"
          "           answered_seq = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN k.intake_seq ELSE k.answered_seq END,\n"
          "           closed_at = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN now() END\n"
          "     WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id\n    RETURNING k.* INTO c;\n"
          "    IF c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n      PERFORM public.moderation_apply(ARRAY[c.target_id], true);\n    END IF;\n"
          "  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'final' THEN")
app = sub(app, "           answered_seq = NEW.through_seq,\n", "           answered_seq = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN k.intake_seq ELSE NEW.through_seq END,\n")

# ---- decision_actions_check
chk = fn(src16, "decision_actions_check")
chk = sub(chk, "  profile public.profiles;\nBEGIN", "  profile public.profiles;\n  o public.legal_orders;\nBEGIN")
chk = sub(chk, "  NEW.created_at := now();", "  NEW.created_at := now();\n  NEW.withhold_author := NULL;\n  IF NEW.kind <> 'reinstate_by_order' THEN NEW.order_ground := NULL; END IF;")
chk = sub(chk, "  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'restore', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'restore_media') THEN\n    NEW.post_id := c.target_id;",
          "  IF NEW.kind IN ('withhold', 'remove', 'restore', 'withhold_media', 'remove_media', 'restore_media', 'disable_by_order', 'reinstate_by_order') THEN\n    NEW.post_id := c.target_id;")
chk = sub(chk, f"  is_measure := NEW.kind IN ({M7});", f"  is_measure := NEW.kind IN ({M7}, 'disable_by_order');")
chk = sub(chk, "            WHEN 'final' THEN NEW.kind IN ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'seal_media', 'restore', 'restore_media')\n",
          "            WHEN 'final' THEN NEW.kind IN ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio', 'seal_media', 'restore', 'restore_media')\n"
          "            WHEN 'order' THEN NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order'\n")
chk = sub(chk, "                WHEN 'restore_display_name' THEN ARRAY['reset_display_name']\n",
          "                WHEN 'restore_display_name' THEN ARRAY['reset_display_name']\n                WHEN 'reinstate_by_order' THEN ARRAY['disable_by_order']\n")
chk = sub(chk, "  IF is_measure AND public.account_is_staff(subject) AND d.kind <> 'interim' THEN", "  IF is_measure AND public.account_is_staff(subject) AND d.kind NOT IN ('interim', 'order') THEN")
chk = sub(chk, "  IF NEW.kind = 'unseal_media' THEN\n    UPDATE public.decisions x SET needs_admin = true WHERE x.id = d.id;",
          "  IF NEW.kind = 'reinstate_by_order' AND (NEW.order_ground IS NULL OR d.kind <> 'correction') THEN\n"
          "    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'A reinstatement is a correction and names its ground.';\n  END IF;\n"
          "  IF NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order' THEN\n"
          "    SELECT x.* INTO o FROM public.legal_orders x JOIN public.legal_order_items i ON i.order_id = x.id WHERE i.id = d.order_item_id;\n"
          "    NEW.withhold_author := o.withhold_from_author;\n  END IF;\n"
          "  IF NEW.kind IN ('unseal_media', 'reinstate_by_order') THEN\n    UPDATE public.decisions x SET needs_admin = true WHERE x.id = d.id;")
chk = sub(chk, "      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'remove' THEN\n        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level = 'removed' THEN 'already' END;",
          "      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'remove' THEN\n        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level IN ('removed', 'disabled') THEN 'already' END;\n"
          "      ELSIF NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order' THEN\n        NEW.no_effect := CASE WHEN post_level = 'disabled' OR (post_level = 'removed' AND NOT NEW.withhold_author) THEN 'already' END;")

# ---- decision_actions_apply
aap = fn(src16, "decision_actions_apply")
aap = sub(aap, "  IF NEW.reverses_action_id IS NOT NULL AND d.kind IN ('review', 'correction') THEN",
          "  IF NEW.kind = 'disable_by_order' THEN\n"
          "    UPDATE public.legal_order_items i\n"
          "       SET decision_id = d.id, action_id = NEW.id, disabled_at = coalesce(i.disabled_at, now()), reinstated_at = NULL,\n"
          "           preserve_until = CASE WHEN (SELECT x.preserve FROM public.legal_orders x WHERE x.id = i.order_id)\n"
          "                                 THEN coalesce(i.preserve_until, public.order_preserve_until(now())) END,\n"
          "           preserve_ended_at = NULL\n"
          "     WHERE i.id = d.order_item_id;\n"
          "    INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, by_staff, via)\n"
          "    SELECT i.order_id, i.id, 'effect_given', d.decided_by, 'console' FROM public.legal_order_items i WHERE i.id = d.order_item_id;\n"
          "  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'reinstate_by_order' THEN\n"
          "    UPDATE public.legal_order_items i SET reinstated_at = now(), preserve_ended_at = now() WHERE i.action_id = NEW.reverses_action_id;\n"
          "    INSERT INTO public.legal_order_events (order_id, item_id, kind, ground, by_staff, via)\n"
          "    SELECT i.order_id, i.id, 'reinstated', NEW.order_ground, d.decided_by, 'console' FROM public.legal_order_items i WHERE i.action_id = NEW.reverses_action_id;\n"
          "  END IF;\n\n"
          "  IF NEW.reverses_action_id IS NOT NULL AND d.kind IN ('review', 'correction') THEN")

# ---- decision_holds
hol = fn(src16, "decision_holds")
hol = sub(hol, "  in_force integer;\nBEGIN", "  in_force integer;\n  oi public.legal_order_items;\n  o public.legal_orders;\n  c public.cases;\nBEGIN")
hol = sub(hol, "  IF NOT FOUND OR a.metadata ->> 'decisionId' IS DISTINCT FROM d.id::text THEN",
          "  IF d.kind = 'order' THEN\n"
          "    SELECT x.* INTO oi FROM public.legal_order_items x WHERE x.id = d.order_item_id;\n"
          "    SELECT x.* INTO o FROM public.legal_orders x WHERE x.id = oi.order_id;\n"
          "    SELECT k.* INTO c FROM public.cases k WHERE k.id = d.case_id;\n"
          "    IF a.id IS NULL OR a.step_up IS NULL OR a.actor_id IS DISTINCT FROM d.decided_by OR a.action IS DISTINCT FROM 'order_effected'\n"
          "       OR a.target_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'order' OR a.target_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.id::text THEN\n"
          "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'target: the transaction''s last audit row is not a confirmed order_effected on this decision''s order.';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "    IF a.metadata -> 'decisionIds' ->> oi.id::text IS DISTINCT FROM d.id::text THEN\n"
          "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'decisionIds: the audit row does not name this decision for its item.';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "    params := a.metadata -> 'params';\n"
          "    expected := jsonb_build_object('kind', o.kind, 'memberState', o.member_state, 'authority', o.authority, 'reference', o.reference,\n"
          "      'sectionC', o.section_c, 'emergency', o.emergency, 'withholdFromAuthor', o.withhold_from_author);\n"
          "    IF params IS NULL OR (params - 'items') IS DISTINCT FROM expected THEN\n"
          "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'params: the confirmed order facts differ from the order.';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "    IF NOT coalesce(params -> 'items' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('itemId', oi.id, 'postId', c.target_id)), false)\n"
          "       OR jsonb_array_length(params -> 'items') <> (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(a.metadata -> 'decisionIds'))\n"
          "       OR jsonb_array_length(params -> 'items') > (SELECT r.items_per_action FROM public.order_rules() r) THEN\n"
          "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'items: the confirmed list does not name this item, or names more than it gave effect to.';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "    IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id) <> 1\n"
          "       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.decision_id = d.id AND x.kind = 'disable_by_order') THEN\n"
          "      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'actions: an order decision holds exactly one disable_by_order.';\n"
          "    END IF;\n"
          "    RETURN;\n"
          "  END IF;\n"
          "  IF NOT FOUND OR a.metadata ->> 'decisionId' IS DISTINCT FROM d.id::text THEN")
hol = sub(hol, "  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', x.kind, 'mediaId', x.media_id)), '[]'::jsonb),",
          "  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', x.kind, 'mediaId', x.media_id)\n"
          "           || CASE WHEN x.order_ground IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('orderGround', x.order_ground) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END), '[]'::jsonb),")
assert hol.count(f"x.kind IN ({M7})") == 1 and hol.count(f"x.kind NOT IN ({M7})") == 1
hol = hol.replace(f"x.kind IN ({M7})", f"x.kind IN ({M7}, 'disable_by_order')").replace(f"x.kind NOT IN ({M7})", f"x.kind NOT IN ({M7}, 'disable_by_order')")
# decision_holds reads the head row in the statement before the order branch: keep FOUND's meaning for the old branch.
hol = sub(hol, "  SELECT l.* INTO a FROM public.audit_head h JOIN public.audit_log l ON l.chain_seq = h.seq WHERE h.id = 1;\n  IF d.kind = 'order' THEN",
          "  SELECT l.* INTO a FROM public.audit_head h JOIN public.audit_log l ON l.chain_seq = h.seq WHERE h.id = 1;\n  IF d.kind = 'order' THEN")

# ---- moderation_apply
mod = fn(src16, "moderation_apply")
mod = sub(mod, "           array_agg(CASE\n             WHEN p.erased_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.post_id = p.id AND m.kind = 'remove') THEN 'removed'",
          "           array_agg(CASE\n"
          "             WHEN p.erased_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m JOIN public.decision_actions x ON x.id = m.id\n"
          "                                                   WHERE m.post_id = p.id AND m.kind = 'disable_by_order' AND x.withhold_author) THEN 'disabled'\n"
          "             WHEN p.erased_at IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.post_id = p.id AND m.kind IN ('remove', 'disable_by_order')) THEN 'removed'")

# ---- append_confirmed_audit
aud = fn(src16, "append_confirmed_audit")
aud = sub(aud, "NOT IN ('case_decided', 'appeals_reviewed', 'identity_revealed')", "NOT IN ('case_decided', 'appeals_reviewed', 'identity_revealed', 'order_effected', 'order_event_recorded')")

# ---- frozen_for (0015, an SQL function: it names no enum value)
fro = fn(src15, "frozen_for")
fro = sub(fro, "      WHERE s.post_id = frozen_for.post)\n$$;",
          "      WHERE s.post_id = frozen_for.post)\n"
          "    OR EXISTS (\n"
          "      SELECT 1 FROM public.legal_order_items oi\n"
          "      WHERE oi.post_id = frozen_for.post AND oi.preserve_until > now() AND oi.preserve_ended_at IS NULL)\n$$;")

print("-- GENERATED by make_proto.py: the lab prototype of 3f on a database at 0016. Run with psql -1.\n")
print(tables)
for text in (rec, app, chk, aap, hol, mod, aud, fro):
    print(text + "\n")
```

### Create `apps/api/test/lab/orders/reset.sh`

```text
#!/bin/sh
# Rebuilds the lab database lab3f from the template lab (migrations 0000 to 0016): prototype in one transaction, helpers, seed.
set -eu
PGBIN="/c/Program Files/PostgreSQL/18/bin"; P="-h localhost -p 55441"
"$PGBIN/psql" $P -U postgres -q -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS lab3f" -c "CREATE DATABASE lab3f TEMPLATE lab" 2>/dev/null
"$PGBIN/psql" $P -U korbat_migrate -d lab3f -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -1 -f 20-proto.sql
"$PGBIN/psql" $P -U korbat_migrate -d lab3f -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -1 -f 21-helpers.sql
"$PGBIN/psql" $P -U postgres -d lab3f -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -1 -f 22-seed.sql
echo RESET_OK
```
