```ts
import { createPrivateKey, generateKeyPairSync, randomBytes, sign } from "node:crypto";
import { createServer, type Server, type TLSSocket } from "node:tls";

/**
 * A stand-in for the contact point's mail host (3f design, section 12, `fakeImap`): an IMAP server on node:tls that
 * answers from a script and records every command it was sent. Its answers hold the lines a real server sends, not only
 * the ones the client asks for: EXAMINE's whole answer with the validity number in its untagged OK, and, where the
 * script says so, unrequested lines (`* 3 EXISTS`, `* 2 FETCH (FLAGS (...))`) inside a command's answer, as a person's
 * mail app reading the same mailbox makes a server send them.
 *
 * It has a second caller, scripts/dev-mailbox.mjs, the development mailbox, which loads this file with Node's own type
 * stripping. So it is written in the TypeScript that stripping can erase (no enum, no parameter property), and imports
 * nothing but Node's own modules. Its certificate is made here too, with a small DER writer: Node can make a key but not
 * a certificate, and a dependency for one test's certificate would be a dependency of the whole repository.
 */

const CRLF = String.fromCharCode(13, 10);
const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const QUOTE = '"';
const BACKSLASH = String.fromCharCode(92);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- a self-signed certificate, written as DER

/** A DER element: its tag, then its length, then its content. */
function der(tag: number, content: Buffer): Buffer {
  const length = content.length;
  if (length < 128) return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([tag, length]), content]);
  const bytes: number[] = [];
  for (let rest = length; rest > 0; rest = Math.floor(rest / 256)) bytes.unshift(rest % 256);
  return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([tag, 128 + bytes.length, ...bytes]), content]);
}
const sequence = (...items: Buffer[]) => der(0x30, Buffer.concat(items));
const set = (...items: Buffer[]) => der(0x31, Buffer.concat(items));
const explicit = (n: number, item: Buffer) => der(0xa0 + n, item);
const utf8String = (text: string) => der(0x0c, Buffer.from(text, "utf8"));
const octetString = (content: Buffer) => der(0x04, content);
const bitString = (content: Buffer) => der(0x03, Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0]), content]));
const booleanTrue = () => der(0x01, Buffer.from([0xff]));

/** A positive INTEGER from its big-endian bytes: a leading zero keeps a high first bit from reading as negative. */
function integer(bytes: Buffer): Buffer {
  let start = 0;
  while (start < bytes.length - 1 && bytes[start] === 0) start++;
  const trimmed = bytes.subarray(start);
  return der(0x02, trimmed[0]! >= 128 ? Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0]), trimmed]) : trimmed);
}

/** An OBJECT IDENTIFIER from its dotted form. */
function oid(dotted: string): Buffer {
  const parts = dotted.split(".").map(Number);
  const bytes = [40 * parts[0]! + parts[1]!];
  for (const part of parts.slice(2)) {
    const groups: number[] = [];
    let rest = part;
    do {
      groups.unshift(rest % 128);
      rest = Math.floor(rest / 128);
    } while (rest > 0);
    for (let i = 0; i < groups.length - 1; i++) groups[i] = groups[i]! + 128;
    bytes.push(...groups);
  }
  return der(0x06, Buffer.from(bytes));
}

/** A UTCTime, which X.509 uses for every year before 2050. */
function utcTime(at: Date): Buffer {
  const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  const text = `${two(at.getUTCFullYear() % 100)}${two(at.getUTCMonth() + 1)}${two(at.getUTCDate())}${two(at.getUTCHours())}${two(at.getUTCMinutes())}${two(at.getUTCSeconds())}Z`;
  return der(0x17, Buffer.from(text, "ascii"));
}

const ECDSA_WITH_SHA256 = "1.2.840.10045.4.3.2";

/** A certificate and its key, each as PEM. */
export interface CertificatePair {
  key: string;
  cert: string;
}

/**
 * A self-signed certificate for `localhost` and 127.0.0.1 on a new P-256 key, valid from a day ago for ten years. It is
 * its own authority: a client that adds it to its roots (NOTIFY_IMAP_CA, or a test's `ca`) trusts it, and the name the
 * client checks is in its subjectAltName.
 */
export function makeCertificate(name = "korbat development mailbox"): CertificatePair {
  const { privateKey, publicKey } = generateKeyPairSync("ec", { namedCurve: "P-256" });
  const now = Date.now();
  const subject = sequence(set(sequence(oid("2.5.4.3"), utf8String(name))));
  const algorithm = sequence(oid(ECDSA_WITH_SHA256));
  // basicConstraints, critical, cA true: the certificate is the trust anchor it is checked against.
  const basicConstraints = sequence(oid("2.5.29.19"), booleanTrue(), octetString(sequence(booleanTrue())));
  // subjectAltName: dNSName localhost ([2]) and iPAddress 127.0.0.1 ([7]).
  const altNames = sequence(der(0x82, Buffer.from("localhost", "ascii")), der(0x87, Buffer.from([127, 0, 0, 1])));
  const subjectAltName = sequence(oid("2.5.29.17"), octetString(altNames));
  const tbs = sequence(
    explicit(0, integer(Buffer.from([2]))),
    integer(randomBytes(16)),
    algorithm,
    subject,
    sequence(utcTime(new Date(now - 24 * 60 * 60_000)), utcTime(new Date(now + 10 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60_000))),
    subject,
    publicKey.export({ type: "spki", format: "der" }),
    explicit(3, sequence(basicConstraints, subjectAltName)),
  );
  const signature = sign("sha256", tbs, privateKey);
  const certificate = sequence(tbs, algorithm, bitString(signature));
  const lines = certificate.toString("base64").match(/.{1,64}/g)!;
  const cert = ["-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----", ...lines, "-----END CERTIFICATE-----", ""].join(LF);
  const key = createPrivateKey(privateKey.export({ type: "pkcs8", format: "pem" })).export({ type: "pkcs8", format: "pem" }).toString();
  return { key, cert };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the server

/** One message of a folder: its UID and its internal date, the time of final delivery. */
export interface ScriptMessage {
  uid: number;
  internalDate: Date;
}

export interface ScriptFolder {
  uidValidity: number;
  messages: ScriptMessage[];
}

/** A command as the server read it: its tag, its name in capitals, and the rest of the line as sent. */
export interface ReceivedCommand {
  tag: string;
  name: string;
  args: string;
  line: string;
}

/** What a script may do in place of a command's normal answer. */
export type ScriptAnswer = { lines: string[] } | "drop" | "hang";

export interface ImapScript {
  /** The one account the server knows. */
  user: string;
  password: string;
  /** The folders by the name a client EXAMINEs. */
  folders: Map<string, ScriptFolder>;
  /** Untagged lines the server sends, unasked, inside the answer of each command of this name, before its completion. */
  unasked?: Partial<Record<string, string[]>>;
  /** The order of a FETCH's two members: the UID first, the date first, or both orders in turn. */
  fetchOrder?: "uid-first" | "date-first" | "alternate";
  /** A command's own answer, when the script wants another than the normal one: raw lines, a dropped connection or silence. */
  answer?: (command: ReceivedCommand) => ScriptAnswer | undefined;
  /** The key and certificate to serve with; a new pair when none is given. */
  tls?: CertificatePair;
  /** The port to listen on, on 127.0.0.1; any free one when none is given. */
  port?: number;
}

export interface FakeImap {
  port: number;
  /** The certificate a client adds to its roots. */
  ca: string;
  /** Every command line the server read, in order, across every connection. */
  commands: ReceivedCommand[];
  /** How many connections were opened. */
  connections(): number;
  /** The script's folders, which a test may change between rounds. */
  folders: Map<string, ScriptFolder>;
  /** Puts a new message into a folder, with the next UID, received now or at the given time. */
  drop(folder: string, at?: Date): ScriptMessage;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];

/** A date as IMAP writes an INTERNALDATE: "17-Jul-2026 02:44:25 +0000", the day padded with a space. */
export function internalDate(at: Date): string {
  const two = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${String(at.getUTCDate()).padStart(2, " ")}-${MONTHS[at.getUTCMonth()]}-${at.getUTCFullYear()} ${two(at.getUTCHours())}:${two(at.getUTCMinutes())}:${two(at.getUTCSeconds())} +0000`;
}

/** The strings of a command's arguments: each a quoted string, with a backslash before a quote or a backslash, or an atom. */
export function parseArguments(args: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  while (i < args.length) {
    if (args[i] === " ") {
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (args[i] === QUOTE) {
      let value = "";
      i++;
      while (i < args.length && args[i] !== QUOTE) {
        if (args[i] === BACKSLASH) i++;
        value += args[i] ?? "";
        i++;
      }
      i++;
      out.push(value);
      continue;
    }
    let atom = "";
    while (i < args.length && args[i] !== " ") atom += args[i++];
    out.push(atom);
  }
  return out;
}

/** The messages a `UID FETCH <from>:*` names: those at or above `from`, and the newest whatever `from` is (RFC 9051). */
function fetched(folder: ScriptFolder, from: number): ScriptMessage[] {
  const sorted = [...folder.messages].sort((a, b) => a.uid - b.uid);
  const named = sorted.filter((m) => m.uid >= from);
  if (named.length === 0 && sorted.length > 0) return [sorted.at(-1)!];
  return named;
}

/**
 * Starts the server. Each connection is greeted, then answers LOGIN, EXAMINE, UID FETCH, NOOP and LOGOUT from the script;
 * any other command is answered BAD. A connection that has not logged in may only log in.
 */
export async function fakeImap(script: ImapScript): Promise<FakeImap> {
  const pair = script.tls ?? makeCertificate();
  const commands: ReceivedCommand[] = [];
  const sockets = new Set<TLSSocket>();
  let opened = 0;
  let alternate = false;

  const server: Server = createServer({ key: pair.key, cert: pair.cert }, (socket) => {
    opened++;
    sockets.add(socket);
    socket.on("close", () => sockets.delete(socket));
    socket.on("error", () => undefined);
    let buffer = "";
    let loggedIn = false;
    let selected: ScriptFolder | null = null;
    const send = (lines: string[]) => {
      if (!socket.destroyed) socket.write(lines.map((line) => `${line}${CRLF}`).join(""));
    };
    send(["* OK [CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1] korbat test mailbox ready"]);

    const handle = (line: string) => {
      const space = line.indexOf(" ");
      const tag = space < 0 ? line : line.slice(0, space);
      const rest = space < 0 ? "" : line.slice(space + 1);
      const uid = /^UID FETCH /i.test(rest);
      const name = uid ? "FETCH" : (rest.split(" ")[0] ?? "").toUpperCase();
      const args = uid ? rest.slice("UID FETCH ".length) : rest.slice(name.length + 1);
      const command: ReceivedCommand = { tag, name, args, line };
      commands.push(command);
      const own = script.answer?.(command);
      if (own === "drop") {
        socket.destroy();
        return;
      }
      if (own === "hang") return;
      const unasked = script.unasked?.[name] ?? [];
      if (own !== undefined) {
        send([...unasked, ...own.lines]);
        return;
      }
      if (name === "LOGIN") {
        const [user, password] = parseArguments(args);
        loggedIn = user === script.user && password === script.password;
        send([...unasked, loggedIn ? `${tag} OK LOGIN completed` : `${tag} NO [AUTHENTICATIONFAILED] Invalid credentials (Failure)`]);
        return;
      }
      if (name === "LOGOUT") {
        send(["* BYE korbat test mailbox logging out", `${tag} OK LOGOUT completed`]);
        socket.end();
        return;
      }
      if (!loggedIn) {
        send([`${tag} BAD Not authenticated`]);
        return;
      }
      if (name === "EXAMINE") {
        const [folderName] = parseArguments(args);
        const folder = script.folders.get(folderName ?? "");
        if (!folder) {
          selected = null;
          send([`${tag} NO [NONEXISTENT] Unknown Mailbox: ${folderName ?? ""}`]);
          return;
        }
        selected = folder;
        const next = folder.messages.reduce((max, m) => Math.max(max, m.uid), 0) + 1;
        // EXAMINE's whole answer, as a real server sends it: the flags, the counts, the validity, the next UID.
        send([
          "* FLAGS (" + BACKSLASH + "Answered " + BACKSLASH + "Flagged " + BACKSLASH + "Deleted " + BACKSLASH + "Seen " + BACKSLASH + "Draft)",
          "* OK [PERMANENTFLAGS ()] Read-only mailbox.",
          `* ${folder.messages.length} EXISTS`,
          "* 0 RECENT",
          `* OK [UIDVALIDITY ${folder.uidValidity}] UIDs valid`,
          `* OK [UIDNEXT ${next}] Predicted next UID`,
          ...unasked,
          `${tag} OK [READ-ONLY] EXAMINE completed`,
        ]);
        return;
      }
      if (name === "FETCH") {
        if (!selected) {
          send([`${tag} BAD No mailbox selected`]);
          return;
        }
        const range = /^([0-9]+):[*] [(]UID INTERNALDATE[)]$/i.exec(args);
        if (!range) {
          send([`${tag} BAD This test server answers only UID FETCH n:* (UID INTERNALDATE)`]);
          return;
        }
        const sorted = [...selected.messages].sort((a, b) => a.uid - b.uid);
        const lines = fetched(selected, Number(range[1])).map((m) => {
          const seq = sorted.indexOf(m) + 1;
          const order = script.fetchOrder ?? "uid-first";
          const uidFirst = order === "uid-first" || (order === "alternate" && (alternate = !alternate));
          const date = `INTERNALDATE "${internalDate(m.internalDate)}"`;
          return uidFirst ? `* ${seq} FETCH (UID ${m.uid} ${date})` : `* ${seq} FETCH (${date} UID ${m.uid})`;
        });
        // The unasked lines come in the middle of the answer, as a server interleaves them.
        const half = Math.floor(lines.length / 2);
        send([...lines.slice(0, half), ...unasked, ...lines.slice(half), `${tag} OK UID FETCH completed`]);
        return;
      }
      if (name === "NOOP") {
        send([...unasked, `${tag} OK NOOP completed`]);
        return;
      }
      send([`${tag} BAD Unknown command`]);
    };

    socket.setEncoding("utf8");
    socket.on("data", (chunk: string) => {
      buffer += chunk;
      for (let end = buffer.indexOf(CRLF); end >= 0; end = buffer.indexOf(CRLF)) {
        const line = buffer.slice(0, end);
        buffer = buffer.slice(end + CRLF.length);
        handle(line);
      }
    });
  });

  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    server.once("error", reject);
    server.listen(script.port ?? 0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve());
  });
  const address = server.address();
  const port = typeof address === "object" && address !== null ? address.port : 0;

  return {
    port,
    ca: pair.cert,
    commands,
    connections: () => opened,
    folders: script.folders,
    drop(folderName, at = new Date()) {
      const folder = script.folders.get(folderName);
      if (!folder) throw new Error(`the script has no folder ${folderName}`);
      const message = { uid: folder.messages.reduce((max, m) => Math.max(max, m.uid), 0) + 1, internalDate: at };
      folder.messages.push(message);
      return message;
    },
    close: () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        for (const socket of sockets) socket.destroy();
        server.close(() => resolve());
      }),
  };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/notify/fake-ntfy.ts`

```ts
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type Server } from "node:http";

/**
 * A stand-in for the push server (3f design, section 12, `fakeNtfy`): an HTTP server that records each publish (topic,
 * priority, tag, title, text and token) and answers 200 with ntfy's message JSON. It can be told to fail: to refuse the
 * next requests with a status, for a number of them or for a time, or to drop them without an answer.
 */
export interface Publish {
  topic: string;
  priority: string | null;
  tags: string | null;
  title: string | null;
  text: string;
  /** The bearer token the request carried, or null. */
  token: string | null;
  method: string;
}

export interface FakeNtfy {
  /** The base URL the publisher posts to, as http://ntfy:2586 is in the stack. */
  url: string;
  /** Every publish the server answered 200, in order. */
  published: Publish[];
  /** Every request, answered or refused. */
  requests: number;
  /** Refuses the next `count` requests with this status, or every request until `until` (a time in ms) when it is given. */
  fail(options: { status?: number; count?: number; until?: number; drop?: boolean }): void;
  close(): Promise<void>;
}

const read = (req: IncomingMessage) =>
  new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    let body = "";
    req.setEncoding("utf8");
    req.on("data", (chunk: string) => (body += chunk));
    req.on("end", () => resolve(body));
    req.on("error", reject);
  });

export async function fakeNtfy(now: () => number = Date.now): Promise<FakeNtfy> {
  const published: Publish[] = [];
  let requests = 0;
  let failing: { status: number; count: number | null; until: number | null; drop: boolean } | null = null;

  const server: Server = createServer((req, res) => {
    void (async () => {
      requests++;
      const text = await read(req);
      if (failing) {
        const timed = failing.until !== null && now() < failing.until;
        const counted = failing.count !== null && failing.count > 0;
        if (timed || counted) {
          if (counted) failing.count = failing.count! - 1;
          if (failing.drop) {
            req.socket.destroy();
            return;
          }
          res.writeHead(failing.status, { "content-type": "application/json" });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ code: failing.status * 100 + 1, http: failing.status, error: "refused by the test" }));
          return;
        }
        failing = null;
      }
      const auth = req.headers.authorization ?? null;
      const topic = (req.url ?? "/").split("?")[0]!.slice(1);
      published.push({
        topic,
        priority: (req.headers["x-priority"] as string | undefined) ?? null,
        tags: (req.headers["x-tags"] as string | undefined) ?? null,
        title: (req.headers["x-title"] as string | undefined) ?? null,
        text,
        token: auth?.startsWith("Bearer ") ? auth.slice("Bearer ".length) : null,
        method: req.method ?? "",
      });
      res.writeHead(200, { "content-type": "application/json" });
      res.end(JSON.stringify({ id: `m${published.length}`, time: Math.floor(now() / 1000), event: "message", topic, message: text }));
    })();
  });

  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", () => resolve()));
  const address = server.address();
  const port = typeof address === "object" && address !== null ? address.port : 0;

  return {
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
    published,
    get requests() {
      return requests;
    },
    fail({ status = 503, count, until, drop = false }) {
      failing = { status, count: count ?? null, until: until ?? null, drop };
    },
    close: () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        server.closeAllConnections();
        server.close(() => resolve());
      }),
  };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/notify/imap.test.ts`

```ts
import pino from "pino";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { IMAP_LINE_MAX, ImapFailure, checkImapValue, imapQuoted, openImap, parseInternalDate, readLine, type ImapOptions } from "../../src/notify/imap";
import { createWatcher, readSettings, type NotifyStore, type OwedPush } from "../../src/notify/main";
import { fakeImap, makeCertificate, parseArguments, type FakeImap, type ImapScript, type ScriptFolder } from "./fake-imap";

/**
 * The watcher parses nothing an outsider wrote (3f design, sections 5, 7.1 and 12.1, invariant 13): against fakeImap, as
 * unit tests, the client sends the five commands and no FETCH that names a header, a body, a flag or an envelope; it
 * reads the four kinds of line it knows, ignores every other untagged line that holds no literal, and ends the round
 * with one of the eight error words on anything else. The loop's part of it runs with a store in memory: the database's
 * own part (the role, the triggers) is the integration file notify-loop.test.ts.
 */

const BACKSLASH = String.fromCharCode(92);
const QUOTE = '"';
const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const CR = String.fromCharCode(13);
const SEEN = `${BACKSLASH}Seen`;

/** One certificate for the whole file: making a key is the slow part of a server. */
const pair = makeCertificate();
const servers: FakeImap[] = [];
afterEach(async () => {
  await Promise.all(servers.splice(0).map((server) => server.close()));
});

const at = (iso: string) => new Date(iso);
const folders = (inbox: ScriptFolder, junk: ScriptFolder = { uidValidity: 7, messages: [] }) =>
  new Map<string, ScriptFolder>([
    ["INBOX", inbox],
    ["Junk", junk],
  ]);

async function server(over: Partial<ImapScript> = {}): Promise<FakeImap> {
  const made = await fakeImap({ user: "watcher", password: "secret", folders: folders({ uidValidity: 1, messages: [] }), tls: pair, ...over });
  servers.push(made);
  return made;
}

const optionsFor = (s: FakeImap, over: Partial<ImapOptions> = {}): ImapOptions => ({ host: "localhost", port: s.port, user: "watcher", password: "secret", ca: s.ca, timeoutMs: 2_000, ...over });

/** The word a failing call threw, or null. */
async function word(run: () => Promise<unknown>): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    await run();
    return null;
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof ImapFailure) return err.word;
    throw err;
  }
}

describe("the anchored expressions, one for each kind of line the client reads", () => {
  test("the completion of the command in flight, and of any other command", () => {
    expect(readLine("a3 OK UID FETCH completed", "a3")).toEqual({ kind: "completion", status: "OK" });
    expect(readLine("a3 NO [AUTHENTICATIONFAILED] Invalid credentials", "a3")).toEqual({ kind: "completion", status: "NO" });
    expect(readLine("a3 BAD Unknown command", "a3")).toEqual({ kind: "completion", status: "BAD" });
    expect(readLine("a3 ok done", "a3")).toEqual({ kind: "completion", status: "OK" });
    // A completion that is not for the command in flight.
    expect(readLine("a2 OK LOGIN completed", "a3")).toEqual({ kind: "error", reason: "a completion for another command" });
  });

  test("the folder's validity, in the untagged OK of EXAMINE's answer", () => {
    expect(readLine("* OK [UIDVALIDITY 3857529045] UIDs valid", "a2")).toEqual({ kind: "uidvalidity", value: 3857529045 });
    expect(readLine("* OK [UIDNEXT 4392] Predicted next UID", "a2")).toEqual({ kind: "ignored" });
  });

  test("a FETCH that holds both a UID and an internal date, in either order; one without both is ignored", () => {
    const date = at("2026-07-17T00:44:25.000Z");
    expect(readLine('* 12 FETCH (UID 4827 INTERNALDATE "17-Jul-2026 02:44:25 +0200")', "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "fetch", uid: 4827, internalDate: date });
    expect(readLine('* 12 FETCH (INTERNALDATE "17-Jul-2026 02:44:25 +0200" UID 4827)', "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "fetch", uid: 4827, internalDate: date });
    expect(readLine(`* 2 FETCH (FLAGS (${SEEN}))`, "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "ignored" });
    expect(readLine(`* 2 FETCH (UID 9 FLAGS (${SEEN}))`, "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "ignored" });
  });

  test("every other untagged line that holds no literal is ignored, and BYE is read", () => {
    for (const line of ["* 3 EXISTS", "* 0 RECENT", "* 4 EXPUNGE", `* FLAGS (${SEEN} ${BACKSLASH}Deleted)`, '* LIST () "/" INBOX', "* CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 IDLE", "* OK [ALERT] Maintenance tonight", "* NO [OVERQUOTA] Nearly full", "* BAD unexpected"]) {
      expect(readLine(line, "a5"), line).toEqual({ kind: "ignored" });
    }
    expect(readLine("* BYE Autologout; idle for too long", "a5")).toEqual({ kind: "bye" });
  });

  test("a line that announces a literal, a continuation, and any line of no known form are errors", () => {
    expect(readLine("* 1 FETCH (UID 2 BODY[HEADER] {342}", "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "error", reason: "a literal" });
    expect(readLine("* 1 FETCH (UID 2 BODY[HEADER] {342+}", "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "error", reason: "a literal" });
    expect(readLine("+ Ready for additional command text", "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "error", reason: "a line of no known form" });
    expect(readLine("hello there", "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "error", reason: "a line of no known form" });
    expect(readLine('* 12 FETCH (UID 4827 INTERNALDATE "yesterday")', "a4")).toEqual({ kind: "error", reason: "an internal date of no known form" });
  });

  test("an internal date as RFC 9051 writes one, the day padded with a space, in any offset", () => {
    expect(parseInternalDate(" 7-Jul-2026 02:44:25 +0200")).toEqual(at("2026-07-07T00:44:25.000Z"));
    expect(parseInternalDate("31-Dec-2026 23:59:59 -0130")).toEqual(at("2027-01-01T01:29:59.000Z"));
    expect(parseInternalDate("17-Jul-2026 02:44:25")).toBeNull();
    expect(parseInternalDate("17-Foo-2026 02:44:25 +0000")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the two strings the client sends from settings are quoted strings; a value with a line break is refused", () => {
    const hard = `pa${QUOTE}ss ${BACKSLASH}word{3}`;
    expect(imapQuoted(hard)).toBe(`${QUOTE}pa${BACKSLASH}${QUOTE}ss ${BACKSLASH}${BACKSLASH}word{3}${QUOTE}`);
    expect(parseArguments(imapQuoted(hard))).toEqual([hard]);
    expect(() => checkImapValue("NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD", `a${LF}b`)).toThrow(/NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD/);
    expect(() => checkImapValue("NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK", `a${CR}`)).toThrow(/NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK/);
    expect(() => checkImapValue("NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK", "Spam folder")).not.toThrow();
  });
});

describe("the client against fakeImap", () => {
  test("it sends the five commands and no FETCH names a header, a body, a flag or an envelope", async () => {
    const s = await server({ folders: folders({ uidValidity: 41, messages: [{ uid: 3, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:00:00.000Z") }] }) });
    const imap = await openImap(optionsFor(s));
    expect(await imap.examine("INBOX")).toBe(41);
    expect(await imap.fetchSince(0)).toEqual([{ uid: 3, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:00:00.000Z") }]);
    await imap.noop();
    await imap.logout();
    expect(s.commands.map((c) => c.name)).toEqual(["LOGIN", "EXAMINE", "FETCH", "NOOP", "LOGOUT"]);
    const fetches = s.commands.filter((c) => c.name === "FETCH");
    expect(fetches.map((c) => c.line.slice(c.tag.length + 1))).toEqual(["UID FETCH 1:* (UID INTERNALDATE)"]);
    for (const c of s.commands) expect(c.line).not.toMatch(/BODY|HEADER|FLAGS|ENVELOPE|RFC822|BODYSTRUCTURE|STORE|SELECT /i);
  });

  test("what a real server sends is read or ignored without an error: EXAMINE's whole answer, unasked lines inside a FETCH and a NOOP, and a FETCH's members in both orders", async () => {
    const messages = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => ({ uid: 10 + i, internalDate: at(`2026-10-12T20:0${i}:00.000Z`) }));
    const s = await server({
      folders: folders({ uidValidity: 9, messages }),
      fetchOrder: "alternate",
      unasked: { FETCH: ["* 7 EXISTS", `* 2 FETCH (FLAGS (${SEEN}))`, "* 1 RECENT"], NOOP: ["* 8 EXISTS", `* 3 FETCH (FLAGS (${SEEN}))`, "* 2 EXPUNGE"] },
    });
    const imap = await openImap(optionsFor(s));
    expect(await imap.examine("INBOX")).toBe(9);
    expect(await imap.fetchSince(0)).toEqual(messages);
    await imap.noop();
    await imap.logout();
  });

  test("a UID at or below the mark is dropped: n:* always answers the newest message", async () => {
    const s = await server({ folders: folders({ uidValidity: 9, messages: [{ uid: 5, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:00:00.000Z") }] }) });
    const imap = await openImap(optionsFor(s));
    await imap.examine("INBOX");
    expect(await imap.fetchSince(5)).toEqual([]);
    expect(s.commands.at(-1)!.args).toBe("6:* (UID INTERNALDATE)");
    imap.close();
  });

  test("a line that announces a literal, a line over the bound and a completion for another command each end it with imap_protocol", async () => {
    const literal = await server({ answer: (c) => (c.name === "FETCH" ? { lines: ["* 1 FETCH (UID 1 BODY[] {12}", `${c.tag} OK done`] } : undefined) });
    let imap = await openImap(optionsFor(literal));
    await imap.examine("INBOX");
    expect(await word(() => imap.fetchSince(0))).toBe("imap_protocol");
    expect(imap.closed).toBe(true);

    const long = await server({ answer: (c) => (c.name === "NOOP" ? { lines: [`* OK ${"x".repeat(IMAP_LINE_MAX)}`, `${c.tag} OK done`] } : undefined) });
    imap = await openImap(optionsFor(long));
    expect(await word(() => imap.noop())).toBe("imap_protocol");
    expect(imap.closed).toBe(true);

    const other = await server({ answer: (c) => (c.name === "NOOP" ? { lines: ["a1 OK something else"] } : undefined) });
    imap = await openImap(optionsFor(other));
    expect(await word(() => imap.noop())).toBe("imap_protocol");
  });

  test("a dropped connection is imap_connect, a host that does not answer imap_timeout, a wrong password imap_login, a folder it cannot open imap_folder", async () => {
    const dropping = await server({ answer: (c) => (c.name === "EXAMINE" ? "drop" : undefined) });
    let imap = await openImap(optionsFor(dropping));
    expect(await word(() => imap.examine("INBOX"))).toBe("imap_connect");

    const hanging = await server({ answer: (c) => (c.name === "EXAMINE" ? "hang" : undefined) });
    imap = await openImap(optionsFor(hanging, { timeoutMs: 300 }));
    expect(await word(() => imap.examine("INBOX"))).toBe("imap_timeout");

    const s = await server();
    expect(await word(() => openImap(optionsFor(s, { password: "wrong" })))).toBe("imap_login");
    imap = await openImap(optionsFor(s));
    expect(await word(() => imap.examine("No such folder"))).toBe("imap_folder");
    imap.close();

    // Nothing listens: the connection itself fails.
    const port = s.port;
    await s.close();
    servers.splice(servers.indexOf(s), 1);
    expect(await word(() => openImap({ host: "localhost", port, user: "watcher", password: "secret", ca: pair.cert, timeoutMs: 2_000 }))).toBe("imap_connect");
  });

  test("a certificate the client does not trust is imap_tls: the roots compiled into Node, and one more only when it is given", async () => {
    const s = await server();
    expect(await word(() => openImap(optionsFor(s, { ca: undefined })))).toBe("imap_tls");
    // Another key's certificate for the same name is not the one the server holds.
    expect(await word(() => openImap(optionsFor(s, { ca: makeCertificate().cert })))).toBe("imap_tls");
    expect(s.commands).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the password and the junk folder's name, each with a quote, a backslash, a space and a brace, go as quoted strings and arrive as they were", async () => {
    const password = `p${QUOTE}a ${BACKSLASH}s{5}`;
    const junk = `Junk ${QUOTE}mail${QUOTE} ${BACKSLASH}{2}`;
    const s = await server({ password, folders: new Map([["INBOX", { uidValidity: 1, messages: [] }], [junk, { uidValidity: 2, messages: [] }]]) });
    const imap = await openImap(optionsFor(s, { password }));
    expect(await imap.examine(junk)).toBe(2);
    imap.close();
    expect(parseArguments(s.commands[0]!.args)).toEqual(["watcher", password]);
    expect(parseArguments(s.commands[1]!.args)).toEqual([junk]);
  });
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the loop's part, with a store in memory

interface StoredMessage {
  folder: "inbox" | "junk";
  uidvalidity: number;
  uid: number;
  receivedAt: Date;
}

/** The watcher's statements, kept in memory: what it inserted, its marks and its beats. */
function memoryStore() {
  const messages: StoredMessage[] = [];
  const marks = new Map<string, { uidvalidity: number; lastUid: number }>();
  const beats: { mailboxOk: boolean; pushOk: boolean; error: string | null }[] = [];
  const store: NotifyStore = {
    async folderMark(folder) {
      return marks.get(folder) ?? null;
    },
    async insertMessage(folder, uidvalidity, uid, receivedAt) {
      // The unique key of folder, validity and UID drops a repeat, as the database's does.
      if (!messages.some((m) => m.folder === folder && m.uidvalidity === uidvalidity && m.uid === uid)) messages.push({ folder, uidvalidity, uid, receivedAt });
      marks.set(folder, { uidvalidity, lastUid: Math.max(uid, marks.get(folder)?.uidvalidity === uidvalidity ? marks.get(folder)!.lastUid : 0) });
    },
    async setMark(folder, uidvalidity, lastUid) {
      marks.set(folder, { uidvalidity, lastUid });
    },
    async owedPushes(): Promise<OwedPush[]> {
      return [];
    },
    async markPushed() {},
    async markFailed() {},
    async beat(state) {
      beats.push(state);
    },
  };
  return { store, messages, marks, beats };
}

const silent = pino({ level: "silent" });

function watcherFor(s: FakeImap, store: NotifyStore, password = "secret") {
  return createWatcher({
    store,
    imap: { host: "localhost", port: s.port, user: "watcher", password, junk: "Junk", ca: s.ca, timeoutMs: 2_000 },
    push: { url: "http://127.0.0.1:9", token: "tk_test" },
    fetch: async () => {
      throw new Error("nothing is owed in these rounds");
    },
    now: () => new Date(),
    log: silent,
  });
}

describe("the watcher's round, the mailbox's side (row 13)", () => {
  test("the first round reads both folders whole, inserts each message once in UID order with its internal date, marks the folders and beats", async () => {
    const s = await server({
      folders: folders(
        { uidValidity: 50, messages: [{ uid: 2, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:02:00.000Z") }, { uid: 1, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:01:00.000Z") }] },
        { uidValidity: 60, messages: [{ uid: 8, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:08:00.000Z") }] },
      ),
    });
    const m = memoryStore();
    const w = watcherFor(s, m.store);
    const report = await w.round();
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ mailboxOk: true, error: null, inserted: 3 });
    expect(m.messages).toEqual([
      { folder: "inbox", uidvalidity: 50, uid: 1, receivedAt: at("2026-10-12T20:01:00.000Z") },
      { folder: "inbox", uidvalidity: 50, uid: 2, receivedAt: at("2026-10-12T20:02:00.000Z") },
      { folder: "junk", uidvalidity: 60, uid: 8, receivedAt: at("2026-10-12T20:08:00.000Z") },
    ]);
    expect(Object.fromEntries(m.marks)).toEqual({ inbox: { uidvalidity: 50, lastUid: 2 }, junk: { uidvalidity: 60, lastUid: 8 } });
    expect(m.beats).toEqual([{ mailboxOk: true, pushOk: true, error: null }]);
    // EXAMINE opens each folder read-only; the junk folder by the name the setting gives.
    expect(s.commands.filter((c) => c.name === "EXAMINE").map((c) => parseArguments(c.args)[0])).toEqual(["INBOX", "Junk"]);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("the next round keeps the connection with NOOP, asks from the mark and inserts only what is new", async () => {
    const s = await server({ folders: folders({ uidValidity: 50, messages: [{ uid: 1, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:01:00.000Z") }] }) });
    const m = memoryStore();
    const w = watcherFor(s, m.store);
    await w.round();
    s.drop("INBOX", at("2026-10-12T21:00:00.000Z"));
    expect((await w.round()).inserted).toBe(1);
    expect((await w.round()).inserted).toBe(0);
    expect(s.connections()).toBe(1);
    expect(s.commands.filter((c) => c.name === "LOGIN")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(s.commands.filter((c) => c.name === "NOOP").length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    expect(s.commands.filter((c) => c.name === "FETCH").map((c) => c.args)).toEqual(["1:* (UID INTERNALDATE)", "1:* (UID INTERNALDATE)", "2:* (UID INTERNALDATE)", "1:* (UID INTERNALDATE)", "3:* (UID INTERNALDATE)", "1:* (UID INTERNALDATE)"]);
    expect(m.messages.map((x) => x.uid)).toEqual([1, 2]);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a changed UIDVALIDITY resets the folder's mark: the folder is read whole and every message is a new row", async () => {
    const s = await server({ folders: folders({ uidValidity: 50, messages: [{ uid: 1, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:01:00.000Z") }, { uid: 2, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:02:00.000Z") }] }) });
    const m = memoryStore();
    const w = watcherFor(s, m.store);
    await w.round();
    // The mail host renumbered the folder: the same two messages under a new validity and new UIDs.
    s.folders.set("INBOX", { uidValidity: 51, messages: [{ uid: 1, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:01:00.000Z") }, { uid: 2, internalDate: at("2026-10-12T20:02:00.000Z") }] });
    expect((await w.round()).inserted).toBe(2);
    expect(m.messages.map((x) => [x.uidvalidity, x.uid])).toEqual([
      [50, 1],
      [50, 2],
      [51, 1],
      [51, 2],
    ]);
    expect(m.marks.get("inbox")).toEqual({ uidvalidity: 51, lastUid: 2 });
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a dropped connection is found by the next round's NOOP, and the round logs in again and reads", async () => {
    let dropNoop = false;
    const s = await server({ answer: (c) => (c.name === "NOOP" && dropNoop ? "drop" : undefined) });
    const m = memoryStore();
    const w = watcherFor(s, m.store);
    await w.round();
    dropNoop = true;
    s.drop("Junk");
    const report = await w.round();
    dropNoop = false;
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ mailboxOk: true, error: null, inserted: 1 });
    expect(s.connections()).toBe(2);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a wrong password is imap_login, tried once a round and never faster; the beat says the mailbox was not read", async () => {
    const s = await server();
    const m = memoryStore();
    const w = watcherFor(s, m.store, "wrong");
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ mailboxOk: false, error: "imap_login", inserted: 0 });
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ mailboxOk: false, error: "imap_login" });
    expect(s.commands.filter((c) => c.name === "LOGIN")).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(m.beats.map((b) => [b.mailboxOk, b.error])).toEqual([
      [false, "imap_login"],
      [false, "imap_login"],
    ]);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a folder that cannot be opened is imap_folder and the folder does not count as read", async () => {
    const s = await server({ folders: new Map([["INBOX", { uidValidity: 1, messages: [] }]]) });
    const m = memoryStore();
    const w = watcherFor(s, m.store);
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ mailboxOk: false, error: "imap_folder" });
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a first start on a mailbox with 10,000 old messages reads them all in one round and inserts each once", async () => {
    const old = Date.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z");
    const messages = Array.from({ length: 10_000 }, (_, i) => ({ uid: i + 1, internalDate: new Date(old + i * 60_000) }));
    const s = await server({ folders: folders({ uidValidity: 3, messages }) });
    const m = memoryStore();
    const w = watcherFor(s, m.store);
    const report = await w.round();
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ mailboxOk: true, inserted: 10_000 });
    expect(m.messages).toHaveLength(10_000);
    expect(m.messages.at(-1)).toEqual({ folder: "inbox", uidvalidity: 3, uid: 10_000, receivedAt: messages.at(-1)!.internalDate });
    await w.stop();
  }, 60_000);
});

  test("the development settings are refused in production, and so is the example's token", () => {
    const dev = { NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT: "51993", NOTIFY_IMAP_CA: "/repo/.data/dev-mailbox/ca.pem", NOTIFY_PUSH_URL: "http://127.0.0.1:2586" };
    expect(readSettings({ ...good, ...dev, NODE_ENV: "development" }, () => "PEM")).toMatchObject({ imap: { port: 51993, ca: "PEM" }, push: { url: "http://127.0.0.1:2586" } });
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(dev)) {
      expect(() => readSettings({ ...good, [name]: value, NODE_ENV: "production" }, () => "PEM"), name).toThrow(new RegExp(`${name}.*production`));
    }
    expect(() => readSettings({ ...good, NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN: "tk_korbatdevpublisher00000000001", NODE_ENV: "production" })).toThrow(/NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN/);
    expect(() => readSettings({ ...good, NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT: "993x", NODE_ENV: "development" })).toThrow(/NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT/);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/notify/publish.test.ts`

```ts
import pino from "pino";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ALERT_KIND_LIST, ALERT_KINDS, renderAlert, type AlertFacts, type AlertKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { createWatcher, type NotifyStore, type OwedPush } from "../../src/notify/main";
import { TOPICS, publish } from "../../src/notify/push";
import { fakeNtfy, type FakeNtfy } from "./fake-ntfy";

/**
 * The publisher (3f design, sections 5 and 7.1 step 5; invariants 14 and 15): every row still owed its push goes to
 * ntfy's topic of its scope with the publisher's token, its priority, its kind as the tag and the fixed text of its kind
 * filled from its facts, which hold counts and times only. A 200 marks it pushed; anything else counts one attempt and is
 * no cap: the row is tried every round until it is published or past its bound, which is the database's to apply
 * (notify-loop.test.ts). Without a database: the rows come from a store in memory.
 */

const servers: FakeNtfy[] = [];
afterEach(async () => {
  await Promise.all(servers.splice(0).map((s) => s.close()));
});
async function ntfy(now?: () => number) {
  const made = await fakeNtfy(now);
  servers.push(made);
  return made;
}

const NOW = new Date("2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z");
const row = (id: number, kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts): OwedPush => ({ id, kind, priority: ALERT_KINDS[kind].priority, scope: ALERT_KINDS[kind].scope, facts });

describe("one publish", () => {
  test("goes to the topic of its scope, with the token, its priority, its kind as the tag, the title and the sentence", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    const facts = { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" };
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(1, "contact_mail", facts), NOW)).toBe("ok");
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(2, "moderation_waiting", { count: 4 }), NOW)).toBe("ok");
    const text = renderAlert("contact_mail", facts, NOW);
    expect(s.published).toEqual([
      { topic: "korbat-oncall", priority: "5", tags: "contact_mail", title: text.title, text: text.sentence, token: "tk_secret", method: "POST" },
      { topic: "korbat-all", priority: "3", tags: "moderation_waiting", title: "Cases are waiting", text: "4 cases or replies are waiting longer than their response time.", token: "tk_secret", method: "POST" },
    ]);
    expect(TOPICS).toEqual({ on_call: "korbat-oncall", all: "korbat-all" });
  });

  test("a refusal is push_refused, and a server that cannot be reached or drops the request push_connect", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    s.fail({ status: 403, count: 1 });
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), NOW)).toBe("push_refused");
    s.fail({ count: 1, drop: true });
    expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), NOW)).toBe("push_connect");
    expect(await publish(fetch, "http://127.0.0.1:9", "tk_secret", row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), NOW)).toBe("push_connect");
    expect(s.published).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("every kind with a push leg renders a push that names nobody: no @, no link, nothing but its words, counts and times", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    let id = 0;
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((k) => ALERT_KINDS[k].legs.includes("push"))) {
      const facts: Record<string, number | string> = {};
      for (const name of ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts) facts[name] = name === "at" || name === "since" || name.endsWith("At") ? "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z" : 2;
      expect(await publish(fetch, s.url, "tk_secret", row(++id, kind, facts), NOW), kind).toBe("ok");
    }
    expect(s.published.length).toBe(ALERT_KIND_LIST.length - 1);
    for (const p of s.published) {
      expect(`${p.title} ${p.text}`).not.toMatch(/@|http/);
    }
  });
});

/** A store in memory that owes the given rows and records what the round did with them. */
function owing(rows: OwedPush[]) {
  const owed = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
  const attempts = new Map<number, number>();
  const beats: { mailboxOk: boolean; pushOk: boolean; error: string | null }[] = [];
  const store: NotifyStore = {
    folderMark: async () => null,
    insertMessage: async () => undefined,
    setMark: async () => undefined,
    owedPushes: async () => [...owed.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id),
    markPushed: async (id) => {
      owed.delete(id);
    },
    markFailed: async (id) => {
      attempts.set(id, (attempts.get(id) ?? 0) + 1);
    },
    beat: async (state) => {
      beats.push(state);
    },
  };
  return { store, owed, attempts, beats };
}

describe("the round's publish step", () => {
  /** A watcher whose mailbox cannot be reached at all, so a round is its publish step and its beat. */
  const watcher = (s: FakeNtfy, store: NotifyStore, now = () => NOW) =>
    createWatcher({
      store,
      imap: { host: "localhost", port: 9, user: "watcher", password: "secret", junk: "Junk", timeoutMs: 500 },
      push: { url: s.url, token: "tk_publisher" },
      fetch,
      now,
      log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });

  test("every owed row is published oldest first and marked; the beat says the push worked", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    const m = owing([row(7, "moderation_urgent", { count: 1, oldestAt: "2026-10-16T08:30:00.000Z" }), row(3, "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" })]);
    const w = watcher(s, m.store);
    const report = await w.round();
    expect(report).toMatchObject({ pushed: 2, pushOk: true, error: "imap_connect" });
    expect(s.published.map((p) => p.tags)).toEqual(["contact_mail", "moderation_urgent"]);
    expect(s.published.every((p) => p.token === "tk_publisher")).toBe(true);
    expect(m.owed.size).toBe(0);
    expect(m.beats).toEqual([{ mailboxOk: false, pushOk: true, error: "imap_connect" }]);
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("a refused row counts an attempt, sets push_refused and stays owed; the next row is still tried; nothing owed reads as a working push", async () => {
    const s = await ntfy();
    const m = owing([row(1, "alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }), row(2, "moderation_burst", { count: 20 })]);
    const w = watcher(s, m.store);
    s.fail({ status: 500, count: 1 });
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: false });
    expect([...m.owed.keys()]).toEqual([1]);
    expect(m.attempts.get(1)).toBe(1);
    expect(m.beats.at(-1)).toEqual({ mailboxOk: false, pushOk: false, error: "push_refused" });
    // No cap: the next round tries it again, and it goes.
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: true });
    expect(m.owed.size).toBe(0);
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 0, pushOk: true });
    await w.stop();
  });

  test("ntfy away for four minutes and then answering: the owed rows go when it is back, without anyone touching a row", async () => {
    let clock = NOW.getTime();
    const s = await ntfy(() => clock);
    s.fail({ status: 502, until: clock + 4 * 60_000 });
    const m = owing([row(1, "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:59:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:59:00.000Z" })]);
    const w = watcher(s, m.store, () => new Date(clock));
    for (let minute = 0; minute < 4; minute++) {
      expect((await w.round()).pushOk, `minute ${minute}`).toBe(false);
      clock += 60_000;
    }
    clock += 1;
    expect(await w.round()).toMatchObject({ pushed: 1, pushOk: true });
    expect(m.attempts.get(1)).toBe(4);
    expect(s.published).toHaveLength(1);
    await w.stop();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

} from "../src/index";

/**

 * reads, the closed lists, the alert kinds with their legs, and the fixed texts of a push and of 3f's staff mails, which
 * carry counts and UTC times only (invariant 15).
 */

describe("ORDER_RULES and ALERT_RULES", () => {
  test("ORDER_RULES holds every number of order_rules(), each the column's name in camel case, with the design's values", () => {
    expect(ORDER_RULES).toEqual({
      hourMinutes: 60,
      targetMinutes: 55,
      itemsPerAction: 10,
      decisionsPerDay: 50,
      recordsPerDay: 20,
      holdDays: 43,
      holdExtensionDays: 42,
      holdWarningDays: 7,
      unconfirmedHoldHours: null,
      preserveMonths: 6,
      preserveMarginDays: 1,
      reportHoldDays: 7,
      reportAlertHours: 24,
      staleHours: 2,
      quietMinutes: 15,
      escalateMinutes: 15,
      remindMinutes: 45,
      channelDownMinutes: 3,
      pushOwedMinutes: 60,
      copyOverdueHours: 48,
      handoverAlertDays: 7,
      messageKeepDays: 30,
      recordKeepYears: 3,
      gapKeepMonths: 12,
    });
  });

  test("a hold with its one extension ends before the preservation does: hold_days + hold_extension_days days are fewer than preserve_months months", () => {
    // The shortest run of preserve_months calendar months has this many days (February in a common year among them).
    const shortestMonths = 30 * ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths - 3;
    expect(ORDER_RULES.holdDays + ORDER_RULES.holdExtensionDays).toBeLessThan(shortestMonths);
  });

  test("ALERT_RULES holds only what the database never reads, and no name is in both tables", () => {

});

describe("the closed lists", () => {

describe("the contact point's requests and answers", () => {

    expect(ContactPage.safeParse({ items: [{ ...message, subject: "x" }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ContactPage.safeParse({ items: [{ ...message, folder: "spam" }], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ContactPage.safeParse({ items: Array.from({ length: CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE + 1 }, () => message), nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    const handled = { ...message, disposition: "not_an_order", handledAt: "2026-10-12T22:05:00.000Z", handledBy: "mod_anna" };

    expect(ContactCloseRequest.safeParse({ disposition: "order" }).success).toBe(false);

    expect(shape.alerts.parse({ channel: "off", since: null })).toEqual({ channel: "off", since: null });
    expect(shape.alerts.safeParse({ channel: "broken", since: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("ALERT_TEXTS (W.4): one text serves both legs, and it carries counts and times only (invariant 15)", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z");
  /** One set of facts for a kind: every count is `n`, every time the given instant. */
  const factsOf = (kind: AlertKind, n: number, time: string, over: Partial<Record<string, number | string | undefined>> = {}): AlertFacts => {
    const facts: Record<string, number | string> = {};
    for (const name of ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts) facts[name] = isTimeFact(name) ? time : n;
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(over)) {
      if (!ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts.includes(name)) continue;
      if (value === undefined) delete facts[name];
      else facts[name] = value;
    }
    return facts;
  };
  const DIGITS = /[0-9]/g;
  const all = (kind: AlertKind, facts: AlertFacts) => {
    const r = renderAlert(kind, facts, now);
    return [r.title, r.sentence, r.todo ?? ""].join(" | ");
  };

  test("rendered with two sets of facts, every kind's title, sentence and line differ only in their digits", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      // The flags of order_effected and order_opened chose a variant: both sets hold the same flags.
      const flags = { urgent: 0, unknown: 0 };
      const first = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 3, "2026-10-16T07:05:00.000Z", flags));
      const second = all(kind, factsOf(kind, 1234, "2026-10-16T22:49:59.999Z", flags));
      expect(first.replace(DIGITS, ""), kind).toBe(second.replace(DIGITS, ""));
      expect(first, kind).not.toBe(second);
    }
  });

  test("no entry holds an @, a link or a placeholder that is neither a fact of its kind nor a number of ORDER_RULES", () => {
    for (const kind of ALERT_KIND_LIST) {
      const text = ALERT_TEXTS[kind];
      const words = [text.title, ...text.sentence.map((part) => part.text), text.todo ?? ""].join(" ");
      expect(words, kind).not.toContain("@");
      expect(words.toLowerCase(), kind).not.toContain("http");
      for (const name of alertPlaceholders(kind)) {
        expect([...ALERT_KINDS[kind].facts, ...Object.keys(ORDER_RULES)], `${kind}: {${name}}`).toContain(name);
      }
      // Every number a sentence of 3f prints comes from the facts or from ORDER_RULES: no digit is typed. 3c's burst
      // window is 3c's own number, which its push names as its mail does.
      if (ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail !== "own") expect(words.replace(/[{][a-zA-Z]+[}]/g, ""), kind).not.toMatch(DIGITS);
    }
  });

  test("a time prints as 14:05 UTC, with the day when it is not the day of the alert", () => {
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-16T14:05:59.000Z", now)).toBe("14:05 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-15T23:59:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-15 23:59 UTC");
    expect(alertTime("2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z", now)).toBe("2026-10-17 00:00 UTC");
  });

  test("the words of the kinds Task 1 sends, as W.4 has them", () => {
    const mail = renderAlert("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now);
    expect(mail).toEqual({
      title: "Mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: `Read it in the mail host's app, never in korbat, and with it every other new message there: further mail within ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes raises no alarm of its own. Then open Contact point in the staff console. What ends this message's alarms is handling it there: opening an order from it, or closing it.`,
    });
    // A restart of an order's clock has no time of receipt.
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now).sentence).toBe("A removal order's hour has started again: due 09:05 UTC.");
    expect(renderAlert("contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Nobody has answered: mail at the contact point",
      sentence: "Nobody has answered the mail that arrived at the authorities' contact point at 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
      todo: "This went to every staff phone. Whoever reads it first acts, and tells the others.",
    });
    const due = renderAlert("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: 15 }, now);
    expect(due.title).toBe("15 minutes left");
    expect(due.sentence).toBe("A removal order, or mail that may be one, is due 09:05 UTC: 15 minutes are left and it is not carried out in full.");
    expect(due.todo).toBe(
      "Give effect now, to every post the order names. Only if the order has a manifest error, or lacks what you need to find the content, send Annex III and record it: that is no way to stop this alarm. If nobody can act in time: the README, When nobody can act within the hour.",
    );
    expect(renderAlert("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "The contact point cannot be read",
      sentence: "korbat has not been able to read the contact-point mailbox since 2026-10-15 23:00 UTC.",
      todo: `Mail that arrives there raises no alert now. Check the mailbox in the mail host's app until this is repaired; an order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator checks the password and the mail host.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({
      title: "Phone alerts are down",
      sentence: "Phone alerts are down since 08:57 UTC: korbat's watcher or its push server does not answer.",
      todo: `Until it is repaired, korbat wakes nobody: the mail host's own app on the on-call phone, signed in to the contact-point mailbox and allowed to ring at night, is the only thing that does. Check now that it is. An order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed". The operator restarts the notify and ntfy services.`,
    });
    expect(renderAlert("alert_test", { at: "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" }, now)).toEqual({ title: "Daily test", sentence: "Daily test, 08:00 UTC. If you read this on your phone, alerts reach it. Nothing to do.", todo: null });
  });
```

```ts
const CHANNEL = process.env.KORBAT_BROWSER_CHANNEL || "chromium";

const STRIKE_FACTS = `The post sells followers again ${HOSTILE.img}`;

/** The headers each static file was served with, by path. */

async function texts(): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await userTexts(page);
  for (const text of found) seen.add(text);
  return found;
}

/** Waits for a locator to show, failing with what it looked for. */
async function shown(locator: Locator, timeout = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`not shown within ${timeout} ms: ${locator.toString()}`);
  }
}

/** A virtual CTAP2 authenticator that verifies its user: a security key on USB, or a platform one whose passkeys sync. */
async function addAuthenticator(kind: "device-bound security key" | "synced platform passkey"): Promise<string> {
  const synced = kind === "synced platform passkey";
  const { authenticatorId } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator", {
    options: {
      protocol: "ctap2",
      transport: synced ? "internal" : "usb",
      hasResidentKey: true,
      hasUserVerification: true,
      isUserVerified: true,
      automaticPresenceSimulation: true,
      // The flags a password manager's passkey reports, and a security key never does.
      defaultBackupEligibility: synced,
      defaultBackupState: synced,
    },
  });
  return authenticatorId;
}

/** How many times an authenticator's keys have signed: the virtual authenticator counts every signature. */
async function signaturesOf(authenticatorId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { credentials } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.getCredentials", { authenticatorId });
  return credentials.reduce((sum, credential) => sum + credential.signCount, 0);
}

/** How many times every staff key of the walk has signed. */
async function signatures(): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const id of staffAuthenticators) sum += await signaturesOf(id);
  return sum;
}

/**
 * Waits until an expression is true in the page. The expression is plain text, sent as page.evaluate sends it: nothing
 * of the test runner's is put into the page, and nothing in the page evaluates it under the page's policy.
 */
async function until(expression: string, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries++) {
    if (await page.evaluate(expression)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/**
 * Waits until the fixtures have seen something. A text is saved when its field loses focus, and the request arrives a
 * moment after the key press that moved the focus.
 */
async function arrived(check: () => boolean, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !check(); tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  if (!check()) throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/** The one image of the page: whether it is there, loaded as a real image of 2 by 2 pixels, from this address, drawn with this class. */
const imageIs = (src: string, className: string) =>

/** The end of every step: no report, error or dialog on any channel, nothing in the page the console never writes, and no request the fixtures refused for the page's fault. */

    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);

    fixtures.state.recuseNextCaseRead = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(dialog.getByText("Revealed to you; recorded and shown to every staff member"));

    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, text: "The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour." });
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toEqual([{ itemId: ITEM_REPORTER, reasonDigest: reason.digest }]);
    // The name alone in its frame, under the console's own line that says what it is, with its hidden characters to show.
    await shown(dialog.getByText("The reporter's handle:", { exact: true }));
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    await shown(dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Show hidden characters" }));
    // The refused read left the case on the page and says why on the page's error line; the name is still there.

    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`).at(-1)!.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    // Shown once: with the dialog closed the page holds the name nowhere.

    expect(await userTexts(page)).not.toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await page.locator("#root").innerText()).not.toContain("a_reporter");

    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;

    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/reveal")).length).toBe(reveals);
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toHaveLength(1);
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
    await clean();
  });

  test("a decision whose step-up options bind other params is refused before the key is asked; the draft stays, and confirmed again it is recorded without its texts being saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path.endsWith("/decisions")).length;
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome this person may decide on the case; the page opens on a restriction.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.restricted, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    // A restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason before anything can be confirmed.
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure));
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus: the facts when the reason was begun, the reason now.
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "reason", text: "It sells followers, which the rule names." });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    // Under both fields of a restriction: the rule on personal data, and that the author receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.personalData, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.done.remove("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`The facts: ${TYPED_FACTS}`);
    expect(await preview.last().textContent()).toMatch(/^You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until /);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);

    // The API asks the key to confirm another decision than the one the page built: the key is never asked.
    const [options, posted] = [fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed, sent()];
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(1);
    // The confirmation saved nothing more: both texts were on the server before it. What was chosen and written is still there.
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the decision itself: the saved texts are used as they are.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    const [facts, reason] = fixtures.state.texts.slice(-2);
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions[1]).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_POST,
      // 3e: the case answer says a strike is due, so the key confirmed it with the removal.
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 4, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: facts!.digest, reasonDigest: reason!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The answer is the case as it now stands: closed, with nothing more to decide on it.
    await shown(page.getByText("; closed ", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByText(COMPOSER.closed));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).count()).toBe(0);
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("an admin's composer on a case with an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material: every outcome listed first, the choice not to seal only while deciding, and an answer without a measure that needs its facts, tells its author nothing and leaves the later report open", async () => {
    const [asked, before] = [fixtures.state.imageRequests.length, await signatures()];
    fixtures.state.role = "admin";
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_ADMIN}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome an admin may decide; beside them, that an answer now is given unseen.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.adminFinal).count()).toBe(0);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.unseen));
    // While deciding, the seal and the choice not to seal stand side by side.
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.interim).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }));
    // Deciding the case, an admin seals for good or answers without a seal: the choice not to seal is not offered.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze));
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.unseen));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);

    // An answer without a measure: no kind is asked, the category the key will confirm is shown, and the facts are needed.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "When" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "Measures" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Ground").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Category").inputValue()).toBe("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC");
    await composer.getByLabel("Category").selectOption("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // Under both fields: never to say what the images are, and that the author never receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(`${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor, { exact: false }).count()).toBe(0);
    // Nothing was done while deciding on this case, so the answer is told to nobody, and the page says so in the preview's place.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview").count()).toBe(0);
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("Nothing in the report or in the post supports it.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason and the facts saved when their fields lost focus");
    const written = (kind: string) => fixtures.state.texts.slice(saved).find((text) => text.kind === kind)!;
    expect(written("facts")).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_ADMIN, text: TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    await clean();

    await confirm.click();
    // The answer reaches the newest report of child sexual abuse material: the rule report that arrived after it stays open.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${COMPOSER.recorded} ${COMPOSER.leftForLater(1)}`));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_ADMIN,
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 3, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [], factsDigest: written("facts").digest, reasonDigest: written("reason").digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the answer with its facts, for staff, and a composer for the report left open.
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 4", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    const after = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    expect(await after.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(1);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked);
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    // The steps that follow are a moderator's again: each opens its page anew, and reads who is signed in.
    fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case that another staff member decided meanwhile: a save that failed is worded under its field and made again by the confirmation, the refusal is worded in place, the case is read again with the draft kept, and confirmed again the decision is recorded without a text saved twice", async () => {

    fixtures.decideBehindThePage(CASE_CHANGED);
```
