```tsx
import { CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS, DISPOSITION_LABELS, type ContactCloseRequest, type ContactMessage, type ContactPage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { describeError, ORDER_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { bothTimes, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";

/**
 * The Contact point screen (3f design, section 8.3): the messages the watcher recorded at the authorities' contact point,
 * newest first, 50 a page with "Load older". korbat records that a message arrived and when, never who sent it or what it
 * says: a person reads each in the mail host's own app. A message nobody handled is closed here as what it turned out to
 * be, one of six words, without a key, since closing restricts nothing and tells nobody; the stale ones an outage left are
 * closed together, one request each. Opening an order from a message is the form of a later task. Every list is a list of
 * blocks, label above value, usable at a phone's width.
 */

type CloseWord = ContactCloseRequest["disposition"];
const W = ORDER_WORDS.contact;

/** The choices of "Close as", each with its hint: radio buttons of one group, a group a message or one for the stale ones. */
function CloseChoices({ group, chosen, disabled, onChoose }: { group: string; chosen: CloseWord | null; disabled: boolean; onChoose(word: CloseWord): void }) {
  return (
    <ul className="choices">
      {CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS.map((word) => (
        <li key={word}>
          <label className="choice">
            <input type="radio" name={group} value={word} checked={chosen === word} disabled={disabled} onChange={() => onChoose(word)} />
            {DISPOSITION_LABELS[word]}
          </label>
          <p className="hint">{W.hints[word]}</p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

/** Who handled a message and when, or that nobody has. */
function Handled({ message }: { message: ContactMessage }) {
  if (message.disposition === null) return <p>{W.notHandled}</p>;
  if (message.disposition === "order") return <p>{W.handledOrder}</p>;
  const label = DISPOSITION_LABELS[message.disposition];
  const at = message.handledAt === null ? "" : bothTimes(message.handledAt);
  if (message.handledBy === null) return <p>{W.handledBySystem(label, at)}</p>;
  return (
    <p>
      {W.handledBefore(label)}
      <UserText>{message.handledBy}</UserText>
      {W.handledAfter(at)}
    </p>
  );
}

export interface ContactViewProps {
  page: Loadable<{ items: ContactMessage[]; nextCursor: string | null }>;
  /** The word chosen for each message, and for the stale ones together (key "stale"). */
  choices: Readonly<Record<string, CloseWord>>;
  /** The id of the message being closed, "stale" while the stale ones are, or null. */
  busy: string | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  loadingOlder: boolean;
  onChoose(key: string, word: CloseWord): void;
  onClose(id: string): void;
  onCloseStale(): void;
  onLoadOlder(): void;
}

export function ContactView({ page, choices, busy, notice, error, loadingOlder, onChoose, onClose, onCloseStale, onLoadOlder }: ContactViewProps) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="contact-title">
      <h2 id="contact-title">{W.title}</h2>
      <p>{W.what}</p>
      <p className="hint">{W.reply}</p>
      {notice ? (
        <p role="status" className="notice">
          {notice}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {error ? (
        <p role="alert" className="error">
          {error}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <Loaded
        value={page}
        render={(value) => {
          const stale = value.items.filter((m) => m.stale && m.disposition === null);
          return (
            <>
              {stale.length > 1 ? (
                <fieldset className="stale-together">
                  <legend>{W.staleTogether(stale.length)}</legend>
                  <p className="hint">{W.staleAll(stale.length)}</p>
                  <CloseChoices group="close-stale" chosen={choices.stale ?? null} disabled={busy !== null} onChoose={(word) => onChoose("stale", word)} />
                  <button type="button" onClick={onCloseStale} disabled={busy !== null || choices.stale === undefined} aria-busy={busy === "stale"}>
                    {W.staleButton}
                  </button>
                </fieldset>
              ) : null}
              {value.items.length === 0 ? (
                <p>{W.empty}</p>
              ) : (
                <ul className="blocks messages">
                  {value.items.map((message) => (
                    <li key={message.id} className="block">
                      <p>{W.received(bothTimes(message.receivedAt))}</p>
                      <p>{W.folders[message.folder]}</p>
                      {message.stale ? <p className="notice">{W.stale}</p> : null}
                      <Handled message={message} />
                      {message.disposition === null ? (
                        <fieldset>
                          <legend>{W.closeAs}</legend>
                          <CloseChoices group={`close-${message.id}`} chosen={choices[message.id] ?? null} disabled={busy !== null} onChoose={(word) => onChoose(message.id, word)} />
                          <p className="hint">{W.close}</p>
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => onClose(message.id)} disabled={busy !== null || choices[message.id] === undefined} aria-busy={busy === message.id}>
                            {W.closeButton}
                          </button>
                        </fieldset>
                      ) : null}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              )}
              {value.nextCursor !== null ? (
                <button type="button" onClick={onLoadOlder} disabled={loadingOlder} aria-busy={loadingOlder}>
                  {W.loadOlder}
                </button>
              ) : null}
            </>
          );
        }}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

export function Contact({ api }: { api: StaffApi }) {
  const [page, setPage] = useState<Loadable<ContactPage>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [choices, setChoices] = useState<Record<string, CloseWord>>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loadingOlder, setLoadingOlder] = useState(false);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  /** The first page, read again: after a close, and when the screen opens (a person's action, so marked). */
  const readFirst = async () => {
    try {
      const value = await api.contact(null, false, { activity: true });
      if (alive.current) setPage({ state: "ready", value });
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setPage({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    void readFirst();
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen; the API client never changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const close = async (id: string) => {
    const word = choices[id];
    if (word === undefined) return;
    setBusy(id);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.closeContact(id, { disposition: word }, { activity: true });
      if (alive.current) setNotice(W.closed(DISPOSITION_LABELS[word]));
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) {
        setBusy(null);
        await readFirst();
      }
    }
  };

  /** The stale messages of the page, closed one request each with the word chosen for them all, then the page read again. */
  const closeStale = async () => {
    const word = choices.stale;
    if (word === undefined || page.state !== "ready") return;
    const stale = page.value.items.filter((m) => m.stale && m.disposition === null);
    setBusy("stale");
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    let closed = 0;
    try {
      for (const message of stale) {
        await api.closeContact(message.id, { disposition: word }, { activity: true });
        closed++;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) {
        if (closed > 0) setNotice(W.staleClosed(closed));
        setBusy(null);
        await readFirst();
      }
    }
  };

  const loadOlder = async () => {
    if (page.state !== "ready" || page.value.nextCursor === null) return;
    setLoadingOlder(true);
    try {
      const older = await api.contact(page.value.nextCursor, false, { activity: true });
      if (alive.current) setPage({ state: "ready", value: { items: [...page.value.items, ...older.items], nextCursor: older.nextCursor } });
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setLoadingOlder(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <ContactView
      page={page}
      choices={choices}
      busy={busy}
      notice={notice}
      error={error}
      loadingOlder={loadingOlder}
      onChoose={(key, word) => setChoices((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: word }))}
      onClose={(id) => void close(id)}
      onCloseStale={() => void closeStale()}
      onLoadOlder={() => void loadOlder()}
    />
  );
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/orders-repo.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ContactDisposition, ContactFolder } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";

/**
 * The SQL of authorities' orders (3f design, section 5): in this task, the messages at the contact point, which the
 * watcher inserts and the console lists and closes. The API role reads every column of contact_messages and may update
 * only its disposition and who set it; the database forces when.
 */

type Querier = Pick<Db, "execute"> | Pick<DbTx, "execute">;

/** One message as the Contact point screen reads it, with its place in the list as text of microseconds for the cursor. */
export interface ContactRow {
  id: string;
  folder: ContactFolder;
  receivedAt: Date;
  /** received_at in UTC to the microsecond: the cursor's sort key. */
  place: string;
  seenAt: Date;
  stale: boolean;
  disposition: ContactDisposition | null;
  handledAt: Date | null;
  /** The handle of the staff member who handled it, or null. */
  handledBy: string | null;
}

/** A page of messages, newest first by the time of receipt, after the given place; only those without a disposition when `open`. */
export async function contactMessages(q: Querier, options: { open: boolean; after: { place: string; id: string } | null; limit: number }): Promise<ContactRow[]> {
  const after = options.after === null ? sql`true` : sql`(m.received_at, m.id) < (${options.after.place}::timestamptz, ${options.after.id}::uuid)`;
  const rows = await q.execute<{
    id: string;
    folder: ContactFolder;
    received_at: string;
    place: string;
    seen_at: string;
    stale: boolean;
    disposition: ContactDisposition | null;
    handled_at: string | null;
    handled_by: string | null;
  }>(sql`
    select m.id, m.folder, m.received_at, to_char(m.received_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as place,
           m.seen_at, m.stale, m.disposition, m.handled_at, p.handle as handled_by
      from public.contact_messages m
      left join public.profiles p on p.id = m.handled_by
     where ${after} and (not ${options.open} or m.disposition is null)
     order by m.received_at desc, m.id desc
     limit ${options.limit}`);
  return rows.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id,
    folder: row.folder,
    receivedAt: new Date(row.received_at),
    place: row.place,
    seenAt: new Date(row.seen_at),
    stale: row.stale,
    disposition: row.disposition,
    handledAt: row.handled_at === null ? null : new Date(row.handled_at),
    handledBy: row.handled_by,
  }));
}

/**
 * Sets a message's disposition and who set it, only while it has none: the trigger stamps when, and refuses any other
 * change. Answers the message's time of receipt and folder for the audit row, or null when no message without a
 * disposition has the id.
 */
export async function closeMessage(tx: DbTx, id: string, disposition: Exclude<ContactDisposition, "order">, staffId: string): Promise<{ receivedAt: Date; folder: ContactFolder } | null> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ received_at: string; folder: ContactFolder }>(sql`
    update public.contact_messages set disposition = ${disposition}, handled_by = ${staffId}::uuid
     where id = ${id}::uuid and disposition is null
    returning received_at, folder`);
  return row ? { receivedAt: new Date(row.received_at), folder: row.folder } : null;
}

/** Whether a message has the id, whatever its disposition. */
export async function messageExists(q: Querier, id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await q.execute(sql`select 1 from public.contact_messages where id = ${id}::uuid`)).length > 0;
}

/**
 * The home screen's counts of the contact point: the messages without a disposition, stale ones included, the oldest
 * one's time of receipt, and the earliest deadline among them, the time of receipt and order_rules().hour_minutes, also
 * once it has passed. Task 2 adds the orders' deadlines.
 */
export async function contactCounts(q: Querier): Promise<{ open: number; oldestAt: Date | null; dueAt: Date | null }> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ open: number; oldest_at: string | null; due_at: string | null }>(sql`
    select count(*)::int as open, min(m.received_at) as oldest_at,
           min(m.received_at) + make_interval(mins => (select r.hour_minutes from public.order_rules() r)) as due_at
      from public.contact_messages m
     where m.disposition is null`);
  return { open: row!.open, oldestAt: row!.oldest_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.oldest_at), dueAt: row!.due_at === null ? null : new Date(row!.due_at) };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/moderation/orders.ts`

```ts
import { CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE, type ContactCloseRequest, type ContactPage, type ContactQuery, type StaffOverview } from "@korbat/contracts";
import type { ActiveStaffSession } from "../auth";
import { appendAuditRow } from "../staff";
import { ModerationError, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { closeMessage, contactCounts, contactMessages, messageExists } from "./orders-repo";

/**
 * Authorities' orders (3f design, sections 5, 7.3 and 8.3). In this task: the messages at the contact point. The watcher
 * records that a message arrived and when, and never who sent it or what it says; a person reads it in the mail host's own
 * app, and then either opens an order from it (Task 2) or closes it here with what it was. Closing restricts nothing and
 * tells nobody, so it needs no key: one transaction, the disposition and then the audit row `contact_closed`.
 */

const PLACE = /^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{6}Z$/;
const UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

/** The list's cursor: the last row's time of receipt to the microsecond and its id, as an opaque word. */
const encodeCursor = (row: { place: string; id: string }): string => Buffer.from(JSON.stringify([row.place, row.id]), "utf8").toString("base64url");

/** Reads a cursor back; anything this module did not write is refused, never guessed at. */
function decodeCursor(cursor: string): { place: string; id: string } {
  let parts: unknown;
  try {
    parts = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cursor, "base64url").toString("utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(parts) || parts.length !== 2) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  const [place, id] = parts as unknown[];
  if (typeof place !== "string" || !PLACE.test(place) || typeof id !== "string" || !UUID.test(id)) throw new ModerationError("invalid_request");
  return { place, id };
}

/**
 * GET /api/staff/contact: the messages newest first by the time of receipt, CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE a page; with open=1 only
 * those without a disposition. No sender and no subject exist to show. A message's orders are Task 2's.
 */
export async function contactPage(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, query: ContactQuery): Promise<ContactPage> {
  const after = query.cursor === undefined ? null : decodeCursor(query.cursor);
  // One row more than a page, to know whether another page follows.
  const rows = await contactMessages(deps.apiDb, { open: query.open === "1", after, limit: CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE + 1 });
  const page = rows.slice(0, CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE);
  return {
    items: page.map((row) => ({
      id: row.id,
      folder: row.folder,
      receivedAt: row.receivedAt.toISOString(),
      seenAt: row.seenAt.toISOString(),
      stale: row.stale,
      disposition: row.disposition,
      handledAt: row.handledAt === null ? null : row.handledAt.toISOString(),
      handledBy: row.handledBy,
      orders: [],
    })),
    nextCursor: rows.length > CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE ? encodeCursor(page.at(-1)!) : null,
  };
}

/**
 * POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close (section 7.3 step 3): the disposition and who set it, only while the message has
 * none (the trigger stamps when), then the audit row, last, with the disposition, the time of receipt and the folder. A
 * message that has a disposition already is message_handled, and a disposition never changes; an unknown id is
 * not_found.
 */
export async function closeContact(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, session: ActiveStaffSession, messageId: string, request: ContactCloseRequest, ctx: { requestId: string }): Promise<void> {
  await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    const closed = await closeMessage(tx, messageId, request.disposition, session.userId);
    if (closed === null) throw new ModerationError((await messageExists(tx, messageId)) ? "message_handled" : "not_found");
    await appendAuditRow(tx, {
      actorId: session.userId,
      action: "contact_closed",
      targetType: "contact_message",
      targetId: messageId,
      requestId: ctx.requestId,
      staffSession: session.handle,
      metadata: { disposition: request.disposition, receivedAt: closed.receivedAt.toISOString(), folder: closed.folder },
    });
  });
}

/** StaffOverview.contact: the messages nobody has handled, the oldest one's time of receipt and the earliest deadline. */
export async function contactOverview(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">): Promise<StaffOverview["contact"]> {
  const counts = await contactCounts(deps.apiDb);
  return { open: counts.open, oldestAt: counts.oldestAt?.toISOString() ?? null, dueAt: counts.dueAt?.toISOString() ?? null };
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/notify/imap.ts`

```ts
import { connect, rootCertificates, type TLSSocket } from "node:tls";
import { isIP } from "node:net";
import type { NotifyError } from "@korbat/contracts";

/**
 * The watcher's IMAP client (3f design, section 2 rows 2 and 3, sections 5 and 7.1), written for this one job on
 * node:tls: LOGIN, EXAMINE, `UID FETCH n:* (UID INTERNALDATE)`, NOOP and LOGOUT, nothing else. It asks for no header, no
 * body, no flag and no envelope, so no line it reads holds a byte an outsider wrote. It reads four kinds of line, each
 * by one anchored expression (readLine): the completion of the command in flight, the folder's UIDVALIDITY after EXAMINE,
 * a FETCH that holds both a UID and an internal date, and BYE. Every other untagged line that holds no literal is
 * ignored: the mailbox is shared with a person's mail app, and a server may send a line nobody asked for at any time
 * (RFC 9051, 2.2.2). A line that announces a literal, a line longer than IMAP_LINE_MAX and a completion that is not for
 * the command in flight are errors, which close the connection.
 *
 * A failure is an ImapFailure with one of NOTIFY_ERRORS' words; the connection is then closed, and the next round logs
 * in again. No regular expression here holds a backslash: a literal bracket or parenthesis is written as a class.
 */

const CRLF = String.fromCharCode(13, 10);
const LF = 10;
const CR = 13;
const QUOTE = '"';
const BACKSLASH = String.fromCharCode(92);

/** The longest line the client reads, in bytes, its end included. A FETCH line of two members is far shorter. */
export const IMAP_LINE_MAX = 4096;
/** How long a command may wait for its completion, and the connection for its greeting, unless the caller says otherwise. */
export const IMAP_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;

/** A failure of the client, named by one of the watcher's error words. */
export class ImapFailure extends Error {
  readonly word: NotifyError;
  constructor(word: NotifyError, message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ImapFailure";
    this.word = word;
  }
}

export interface FetchedMessage {
  uid: number;
  internalDate: Date;
}

/** What one line of an answer is to the client. */
export type ReadLine =
  | { kind: "completion"; status: "OK" | "NO" | "BAD" }
  | { kind: "uidvalidity"; value: number }
  | { kind: "fetch"; uid: number; internalDate: Date }
  | { kind: "bye" }
  | { kind: "ignored" }
  | { kind: "error"; reason: string };

// The anchored expressions, one for each kind of line the client reads.
const TAGGED = /^(a[0-9]+) (OK|NO|BAD)( .*)?$/i;
const UIDVALIDITY = /^[*] OK [[]UIDVALIDITY ([0-9]+)]/i;
const FETCH = /^[*] [0-9]+ FETCH [(](.*)[)]$/i;
const BYE = /^[*] BYE( .*)?$/i;
const UNTAGGED = /^[*] /;
/** A line that ends in {n} or {n+} announces a literal of n bytes: the client asks for none and reads none. */
const LITERAL = /[{][0-9]+[+]?[}]$/;
// The two members of a FETCH, each a word of its own in the list, in either order.
const FETCH_UID = /(^| )UID ([0-9]+)( |$)/i;
const FETCH_DATE = /(^| )INTERNALDATE "([^"]*)"( |$)/i;
const INTERNAL_DATE = /^([ 0-9][0-9])-(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)-([0-9]{4}) ([0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2}) ([+-])([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})$/;
const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];

/** An IMAP date-time ("17-Jul-2026 02:44:25 +0200") as an instant, or null for any other form. */
export function parseInternalDate(text: string): Date | null {
  const found = INTERNAL_DATE.exec(text);
  if (!found) return null;
  const [, day, month, year, hour, minute, second, sign, offsetHours, offsetMinutes] = found;
  const local = Date.UTC(Number(year), MONTHS.indexOf(month!), Number(day!.trim()), Number(hour), Number(minute), Number(second));
  const offset = (Number(offsetHours) * 60 + Number(offsetMinutes)) * 60_000;
  const at = new Date(sign === "+" ? local - offset : local + offset);
  return Number.isNaN(at.getTime()) ? null : at;
}

/** What one line is, while the command tagged `tag` is in flight. */
export function readLine(line: string, tag: string): ReadLine {
  if (LITERAL.test(line)) return { kind: "error", reason: "a literal" };
  const tagged = TAGGED.exec(line);
  if (tagged) {
    if (tagged[1] !== tag) return { kind: "error", reason: "a completion for another command" };
    return { kind: "completion", status: tagged[2]!.toUpperCase() as "OK" | "NO" | "BAD" };
  }
  const validity = UIDVALIDITY.exec(line);
  if (validity) return { kind: "uidvalidity", value: Number(validity[1]) };
  const fetched = FETCH.exec(line);
  if (fetched) {
    const uid = FETCH_UID.exec(fetched[1]!);
    const date = FETCH_DATE.exec(fetched[1]!);
    // A FETCH without both members is the server telling of something else (flags another client changed).
    if (!uid || !date) return { kind: "ignored" };
    const internalDate = parseInternalDate(date[2]!);
    if (internalDate === null) return { kind: "error", reason: "an internal date of no known form" };
    return { kind: "fetch", uid: Number(uid[2]), internalDate };
  }
  if (BYE.test(line)) return { kind: "bye" };
  if (UNTAGGED.test(line)) return { kind: "ignored" };
  return { kind: "error", reason: "a line of no known form" };
}

/** A string as IMAP's quoted string: in quotes, with a backslash before each quote and each backslash. */
export function imapQuoted(value: string): string {
  let out = QUOTE;
  for (const char of value) out += char === QUOTE || char === BACKSLASH ? `${BACKSLASH}${char}` : char;
  return `${out}${QUOTE}`;
}

/** Refuses, naming the setting, a value a quoted string cannot carry: a line break, or any other control character. */
export function checkImapValue(name: string, value: string): void {
  for (const char of value) {
    const code = char.charCodeAt(0);
    if (code < 32 || code === 127) throw new Error(`${name} holds a line break or another control character, which IMAP cannot send: set it again without one`);
  }
}

export interface ImapOptions {
  host: string;
  port: number;
  user: string;
  password: string;
  /** One more trusted certificate, PEM, beside the roots compiled into Node: the development mailbox's only. */
  ca?: string;
  timeoutMs?: number;
}

export interface ImapSession {
  /** Opens a folder read-only and answers its UIDVALIDITY. */
  examine(folder: string): Promise<number>;
  /** The messages above the mark, in UID order: `UID FETCH <last + 1>:* (UID INTERNALDATE)`, a UID at or below the mark dropped. */
  fetchSince(lastUid: number): Promise<FetchedMessage[]>;
  noop(): Promise<void>;
  /** LOGOUT, then the connection closed; never throws. */
  logout(): Promise<void>;
  close(): void;
  readonly closed: boolean;
}

/** A socket's failure as one of the words: a certificate or handshake problem is imap_tls, anything else imap_connect. */
function socketWord(err: unknown): NotifyError {
  const code = typeof err === "object" && err !== null && "code" in err ? String((err as { code: unknown }).code) : "";
  const tls = code.startsWith("ERR_TLS") || code.startsWith("ERR_SSL") || code.includes("CERT") || code.includes("SELF_SIGNED") || code.includes("VERIFY") || code === "EPROTO";
  return tls ? "imap_tls" : "imap_connect";
}

/**
 * Connects over TLS to the mail host, with the roots compiled into Node (and one more only when given) and the
 * certificate's name checked, reads the greeting and logs in. The user and the password go as quoted strings.
 */
export async function openImap(options: ImapOptions): Promise<ImapSession> {
  checkImapValue("NOTIFY_IMAP_USER", options.user);
  checkImapValue("NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD", options.password);
  const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? IMAP_TIMEOUT_MS;
  let socket: TLSSocket;
  let closed = false;
  let pending: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  let failure: ImapFailure | null = null;
  let wake: (() => void) | null = null;
  const notify = () => {
    const w = wake;
    wake = null;
    w?.();
  };

  const fail = (f: ImapFailure) => {
    if (failure === null) failure = f;
    closed = true;
    socket?.destroy();
    notify();
  };

  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      socket?.destroy();
      reject(new ImapFailure("imap_timeout", "the mail host did not answer the connection in time"));
    }, timeoutMs);
    socket = connect({
      host: options.host,
      port: options.port,
      // The name the certificate is checked against; an address is checked against the certificate's addresses.
      servername: isIP(options.host) ? undefined : options.host,
      ca: options.ca === undefined ? undefined : [...rootCertificates, options.ca],
      rejectUnauthorized: true,
    });
    socket.once("secureConnect", () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve();
    });
    socket.once("error", (err) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(new ImapFailure(socketWord(err), `the connection to the mail host failed: ${err.message}`));
    });
  });

  socket!.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => {
    pending = pending.length === 0 ? chunk : Buffer.concat([pending, chunk]);
    for (let end = pending.indexOf(LF); end >= 0; end = pending.indexOf(LF)) {
      const raw = pending.subarray(0, end + 1);
      pending = pending.subarray(end + 1);
      if (raw.length > IMAP_LINE_MAX) {
        fail(new ImapFailure("imap_protocol", "the mail host sent a line longer than the client reads"));
        return;
      }
      // A line ends in CRLF; its bytes are ASCII as far as the client reads them, and anything else is ignored or refused by form.
      const body = raw.length >= 2 && raw[raw.length - 2] === CR ? raw.subarray(0, raw.length - 2) : raw.subarray(0, raw.length - 1);
      lines.push(body.toString("latin1"));
    }
    if (pending.length > IMAP_LINE_MAX) {
      fail(new ImapFailure("imap_protocol", "the mail host sent a line longer than the client reads"));
      return;
    }
    notify();
  });
  socket!.on("error", (err) => fail(new ImapFailure("imap_connect", `the connection to the mail host failed: ${err.message}`)));
  socket!.on("close", () => {
    closed = true;
    if (failure === null) failure = new ImapFailure("imap_connect", "the mail host closed the connection");
    notify();
  });

  /** The next line, waiting at most until `deadline`. */
  const next = async (deadline: number): Promise<string> => {
    for (;;) {
      if (lines.length > 0) return lines.shift()!;
      if (failure !== null) throw failure;
      const left = deadline - Date.now();
      if (left <= 0) {
        const late = new ImapFailure("imap_timeout", "the mail host did not answer in time");
        fail(late);
        throw late;
      }
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(resolve, left);
        wake = () => {
          clearTimeout(timer);
          resolve();
        };
      });
    }
  };

  // The greeting: OK or PREAUTH, or BYE when the host refuses the connection.
  const greeting = await next(Date.now() + timeoutMs);
  if (!/^[*] (OK|PREAUTH)( |$)/i.test(greeting)) {
    fail(new ImapFailure("imap_connect", "the mail host did not greet the client"));
    throw failure!;
  }

  let counter = 0;
  /**
   * Sends one command and reads its answer up to its completion. Each line goes to `onLine` when it is one the command
   * reads; the completion's status is answered. A BYE before the completion means the host is closing the connection.
   */
  const run = async (command: string, onLine: (line: ReadLine) => void, refused: NotifyError): Promise<void> => {
    if (closed) throw failure ?? new ImapFailure("imap_connect", "the connection is closed");
    const tag = `a${++counter}`;
    socket.write(`${tag} ${command}${CRLF}`);
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    for (;;) {
      const read = readLine(await next(deadline), tag);
      if (read.kind === "error") {
        const f = new ImapFailure("imap_protocol", `the mail host sent ${read.reason}`);
        fail(f);
        throw f;
      }
      if (read.kind === "bye") {
        const f = new ImapFailure("imap_connect", "the mail host ended the session");
        fail(f);
        throw f;
      }
      if (read.kind === "completion") {
        if (read.status !== "OK") {
          const f = new ImapFailure(refused, `the mail host answered ${read.status}`);
          // A refused LOGIN or folder leaves the connection usable, but the round ends: close it and start clean.
          fail(f);
          throw f;
        }
        return;
      }
      onLine(read);
    }
  };

  const session: ImapSession = {
    async examine(folder) {
      checkImapValue("NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK", folder);
      let validity: number | null = null;
      await run(`EXAMINE ${imapQuoted(folder)}`, (read) => {
        if (read.kind === "uidvalidity") validity = read.value;
      }, "imap_folder");
      if (validity === null) {
        const f = new ImapFailure("imap_protocol", "the mail host named no UIDVALIDITY for the folder");
        fail(f);
        throw f;
      }
      return validity;
    },
    async fetchSince(lastUid) {
      const found: FetchedMessage[] = [];
      await run(`UID FETCH ${lastUid + 1}:* (UID INTERNALDATE)`, (read) => {
        // n:* always answers the newest message, also when n is above it: a UID at or below the mark is dropped.
        if (read.kind === "fetch" && read.uid > lastUid) found.push({ uid: read.uid, internalDate: read.internalDate });
      }, "imap_protocol");
      return found.sort((a, b) => a.uid - b.uid);
    },
    async noop() {
      await run("NOOP", () => undefined, "imap_protocol");
    },
    async logout() {
      if (closed) return;
      try {
        await run("LOGOUT", () => undefined, "imap_protocol");
      } catch {
        // The BYE that answers LOGOUT, or anything else: the connection goes either way.
      }
      session.close();
    },
    close() {
      closed = true;
      socket.destroy();
    },
    get closed() {
      return closed;
    },
  };

  await run(`LOGIN ${imapQuoted(options.user)} ${imapQuoted(options.password)}`, () => undefined, "imap_login");
  return session;
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/notify/main.ts`

```ts
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino, { type Logger } from "pino";
import { ALERT_RULES, PUSH_KINDS, type AlertKind, type AlertScope, type ContactFolder, type NotifyError } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { ImapFailure, checkImapValue, openImap, type ImapSession } from "./imap";
import { publish, type OwedPush } from "./push";

export type { OwedPush } from "./push";

/**
 * notify, the contact point's watcher (3f design, sections 5 and 7.1): an entry point of the API's image
 * (dist/notify.js) that runs one loop, alone, with its own database role, korbat_notify, and no lock. Every
 * ALERT_RULES.pollSeconds after the last round ended:
 *   1. it reads INBOX and the junk folder over IMAP (imap.ts), read-only, and inserts one row of contact_messages a new
 *      message, each in a transaction of its own with the folder's mark, so the first push never waits for the rest of a
 *      long folder; the database's triggers force the row's times and write the message's first push;
 *   2. it publishes every row of alert_outbox still owed its push (push.ts), oldest first, with no cap on attempts;
 *   3. it beats: notify_state says when it last ran, last read both folders and last published, and the word of its
 *      last failure, which the API's alert tick reads for the channel's health.
 * It reads no header, body or flag of any message, holds no SMTP credential, and imports the contracts and nothing of
 * the API's modules. It stops itself rather than hang: it exits 1 when the database has been unreachable for longer than
 * a round, or when no round has finished for WATCHDOG_MS, and Docker starts it again.
 */

/** No round finished for this long: the process exits, and Docker starts it again. */
export const WATCHDOG_MS = 2 * 60_000;
/** The file whose time the Compose health check reads: written after every round that reached the database. */
export const HEALTH_FILE = join(tmpdir(), "korbat-notify-beat");
/** The example's ntfy token (infra/ntfy/server.yml.example), which production refuses, as the API refuses test keys. */
export const EXAMPLE_PUBLISH_TOKENS: readonly string[] = ["tk_korbatdevpublisher00000000001"];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- settings

export interface NotifySettings {
  databaseUrl: string;
  production: boolean;
  imap: { host: string; port: number; user: string; password: string; junk: string; ca?: string; timeoutMs?: number };
  push: { url: string; token: string };
}

/**
 * The watcher's settings. No setting of a profiled service is required by Compose (it writes `${NAME:-}`), so the
 * program refuses to start on an empty one, naming it. NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT, NOTIFY_IMAP_CA and NOTIFY_PUSH_URL are for the
 * development mailbox alone, and production refuses them, as it refuses the example's ntfy token.
 */
export function readSettings(env: Record<string, string | undefined>, readFile: (path: string) => string = (path) => readFileSync(path, "utf8")): NotifySettings {
  const required = (name: string): string => {
    const value = env[name];
    if (value === undefined || value.trim() === "") throw new Error(`${name} is not set: notify cannot start without it (infra/.env, README Upgrading)`);
    return value;
  };
  const production = (env.NODE_ENV ?? "production").trim() !== "development" && (env.NODE_ENV ?? "").trim() !== "test";
  const devOnly = (name: string): string | undefined => {
    const value = env[name];
    if (value === undefined || value.trim() === "") return undefined;
    if (production) throw new Error(`${name} is for the development mailbox only and is refused in production`);
    return value.trim();
  };
  const settings: NotifySettings = {
    databaseUrl: required("DATABASE_URL_NOTIFY"),
    production,
    imap: { host: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_HOST").trim(), port: 993, user: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_USER"), password: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD"), junk: required("NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK") },
    push: { url: "http://ntfy:2586", token: required("NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN").trim() },
  };
  for (const name of ["NOTIFY_IMAP_HOST", "NOTIFY_IMAP_USER", "NOTIFY_IMAP_PASSWORD", "NOTIFY_IMAP_JUNK", "NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN"]) checkImapValue(name, env[name]!);
  // Compose builds the URL from KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD, which it does not require: an empty one is that setting missing.
  let databaseUrl: URL;
  try {
    databaseUrl = new URL(settings.databaseUrl);
  } catch {
    throw new Error("DATABASE_URL_NOTIFY is not a PostgreSQL URL");
  }
  if (databaseUrl.password === "") throw new Error("KORBAT_NOTIFY_DB_PASSWORD is not set: notify cannot sign in to the database without it (infra/.env, README Upgrading)");
  if (production && EXAMPLE_PUBLISH_TOKENS.includes(settings.push.token)) throw new Error("NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN is the example's token: production needs the publisher's own (README, On call)");
  const port = devOnly("NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT");
  if (port !== undefined) {
    if (!/^[0-9]{1,5}$/.test(port) || Number(port) < 1 || Number(port) > 65535) throw new Error("NOTIFY_IMAP_PORT must be a port number");
    settings.imap.port = Number(port);
  }
  const ca = devOnly("NOTIFY_IMAP_CA");
  if (ca !== undefined) settings.imap.ca = readFile(ca);
  const pushUrl = devOnly("NOTIFY_PUSH_URL");
  if (pushUrl !== undefined) {
    if (!/^https?:[/][/][^/]+$/.test(pushUrl)) throw new Error("NOTIFY_PUSH_URL must be an origin such as http://127.0.0.1:2586");
    settings.push.url = pushUrl;
  }
  return settings;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the database's side

/** The watcher's statements, each within the grants of korbat_notify: its four tables and order_rules(), nothing else. */
export interface NotifyStore {
  /** A folder's mark: its validity and the highest UID inserted, or null before the first read. */
  folderMark(folder: ContactFolder): Promise<{ uidvalidity: number | null; lastUid: number | null } | null>;
  /** One message's row and the folder's mark, in one transaction; a message already there is left as it is. */
  insertMessage(folder: ContactFolder, uidvalidity: number, uid: number, receivedAt: Date): Promise<void>;
  /** The folder's mark as the round leaves it, also when the folder held nothing new. */
  setMark(folder: ContactFolder, uidvalidity: number, lastUid: number): Promise<void>;
  /** Every row still owed its push, oldest first: not pushed, of a kind with a push leg, younger than push_owed_minutes. */
  owedPushes(kinds: readonly AlertKind[]): Promise<OwedPush[]>;
  markPushed(id: number): Promise<void>;
  /** One more failed attempt, for the log: no cap. */
  markFailed(id: number): Promise<void>;
  /** The beat: now, and now for the mailbox and the push when the round read both folders and pushed what it owed. */
  beat(state: { mailboxOk: boolean; pushOk: boolean; error: NotifyError | null }): Promise<void>;
}

/** A list of words as a PostgreSQL array, for `= any(...)`. The kinds are the contracts' own words: no comma or quote. */
const textArray = (values: readonly string[]) => sql`${`{${values.join(",")}}`}::text[]`;

export function createStore(db: Db): NotifyStore {
  return {
    async folderMark(folder) {
      const [row] = await db.execute<{ uidvalidity: string | null; last_uid: string | null }>(sql`select uidvalidity, last_uid from public.notify_folders where folder = ${folder}`);
      return row ? { uidvalidity: row.uidvalidity === null ? null : Number(row.uidvalidity), lastUid: row.last_uid === null ? null : Number(row.last_uid) } : null;
    },
    async insertMessage(folder, uidvalidity, uid, receivedAt) {
      await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        // The unique key of folder, validity and UID drops a message read twice (a round stopped before its mark).
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.contact_messages (folder, uidvalidity, uid, received_at) values (${folder}, ${uidvalidity}, ${uid}, ${receivedAt.toISOString()}) on conflict do nothing`);
        await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.notify_folders (folder, uidvalidity, last_uid) values (${folder}, ${uidvalidity}, ${uid})
          on conflict (folder) do update set uidvalidity = excluded.uidvalidity,
            last_uid = greatest(case when public.notify_folders.uidvalidity = excluded.uidvalidity then public.notify_folders.last_uid else 0 end, excluded.last_uid)`);
      });
    },
    async setMark(folder, uidvalidity, lastUid) {
      await db.execute(sql`insert into public.notify_folders (folder, uidvalidity, last_uid) values (${folder}, ${uidvalidity}, ${lastUid})
        on conflict (folder) do update set uidvalidity = excluded.uidvalidity, last_uid = excluded.last_uid`);
    },
    async owedPushes(kinds) {
      const rows = await db.execute<{ id: string; kind: AlertKind; priority: number; scope: AlertScope; facts: Record<string, number | string> }>(sql`
        select o.id, o.kind, o.priority, o.scope, o.facts from public.alert_outbox o
         where o.pushed_at is null and o.kind = any(${textArray(kinds)})
           and o.created_at > now() - make_interval(mins => (select r.push_owed_minutes from public.order_rules() r))
         order by o.id`);
      return rows.map((row) => ({ id: Number(row.id), kind: row.kind, priority: row.priority === 5 ? 5 : 3, scope: row.scope, facts: row.facts }));
    },
    async markPushed(id) {
      await db.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set pushed_at = now() where id = ${id} and pushed_at is null`);
    },
    async markFailed(id) {
      await db.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set push_attempts = push_attempts + 1 where id = ${id}`);
    },
    async beat({ mailboxOk, pushOk, error }) {
      await db.execute(sql`insert into public.notify_state (id, beat_at, mailbox_ok_at, push_ok_at, error)
        values (1, now(), case when ${mailboxOk} then now() end, case when ${pushOk} then now() end, ${error})
        on conflict (id) do update set beat_at = excluded.beat_at,
          mailbox_ok_at = coalesce(excluded.mailbox_ok_at, public.notify_state.mailbox_ok_at),
          push_ok_at = coalesce(excluded.push_ok_at, public.notify_state.push_ok_at),
          error = excluded.error`);
    },
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the round

export interface WatcherDeps {
  store: NotifyStore;
  imap: NotifySettings["imap"];
  push: NotifySettings["push"];
  fetch: typeof fetch;
  now(): Date;
  log: Logger;
}

export interface RoundReport {
  /** Both folders were read. */
  mailboxOk: boolean;
  /** Every publish of the round succeeded, or nothing was owed. */
  pushOk: boolean;
  /** The word of the round's last failure, or null. */
  error: NotifyError | null;
  inserted: number;
  pushed: number;
}

/**
 * The watcher's loop body, holding its IMAP connection from one round to the next. A failure of the mail host or of
 * ntfy is a word in the beat; a failure of the database is thrown, for the caller to judge.
 */
export function createWatcher(deps: WatcherDeps) {
  let session: ImapSession | null = null;

  /** Both folders, INBOX and then the junk folder, from each one's mark; answers how many messages it inserted. */
  async function readMailbox(): Promise<number> {
    // NOOP keeps the connection between rounds; a dropped one is found here and opened again in this round.
    if (session !== null && !session.closed) {
      try {
        await session.noop();
      } catch (err) {
        if (!(err instanceof ImapFailure)) throw err;
        session.close();
        session = null;
      }
    }
    if (session === null || session.closed) session = await openImap(deps.imap);
    let inserted = 0;
    const folders: [ContactFolder, string][] = [
      ["inbox", "INBOX"],
      ["junk", deps.imap.junk],
    ];
    for (const [folder, name] of folders) {
      const validity = await session.examine(name);
      const mark = await deps.store.folderMark(folder);
      // A changed (or first) validity resets the mark: the folder is read whole, and its messages are new rows.
      const last = mark !== null && mark.uidvalidity === validity ? (mark.lastUid ?? 0) : 0;
      const messages = await session.fetchSince(last);
      for (const message of messages) {
        await deps.store.insertMessage(folder, validity, message.uid, message.internalDate);
        inserted++;
      }
      await deps.store.setMark(folder, validity, messages.at(-1)?.uid ?? last);
    }
    return inserted;
  }

  async function round(): Promise<RoundReport> {
    let error: NotifyError | null = null;
    let mailboxOk = false;
    let inserted = 0;
    try {
      inserted = await readMailbox();
      mailboxOk = true;
    } catch (err) {
      if (!(err instanceof ImapFailure)) throw err;
      error = err.word;
      deps.log.warn({ error: err.word, reason: err.message }, "notify: the mailbox could not be read this round");
      session?.close();
      session = null;
    }
    let pushOk = true;
    let pushed = 0;
    for (const row of await deps.store.owedPushes(PUSH_KINDS)) {
      const outcome = await publish(deps.fetch, deps.push.url, deps.push.token, row, deps.now());
      if (outcome === "ok") {
        await deps.store.markPushed(row.id);
        pushed++;
      } else {
        await deps.store.markFailed(row.id);
        pushOk = false;
        error = outcome;
        deps.log.warn({ error: outcome, alert: row.id, kind: row.kind }, "notify: a push was not taken; it is tried again next round");
      }
    }
    await deps.store.beat({ mailboxOk, pushOk, error });
    return { mailboxOk, pushOk, error, inserted, pushed };
  }

  /** LOGOUT and the connection closed. */
  async function stop(): Promise<void> {
    const open = session;
    session = null;
    await open?.logout();
  }

  return { round, stop };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the process

/** Runs the loop until SIGTERM. Never returns. */
export async function runNotify(env: Record<string, string | undefined> = process.env): Promise<void> {
  const settings = readSettings(env);
  const log = pino({ level: env.LOG_LEVEL?.trim() || "info", base: { service: "notify" } });
  const db = createDb(settings.databaseUrl, { max: 2 });
  const watcher = createWatcher({ store: createStore(db), imap: settings.imap, push: settings.push, fetch, now: () => new Date(), log });
  const pollMs = ALERT_RULES.pollSeconds * 1000;
  let lastRoundEnd = Date.now();
  /** When the database first failed a round, or null while it answers. */
  let databaseDownSince: number | null = null;
  let stopping = false;

  // A round that hangs (a socket that never answers, a statement that never returns) is ended by Docker: the watchdog
  // exits, and the container is started again.
  const watchdog = setInterval(() => {
    if (Date.now() - lastRoundEnd > WATCHDOG_MS) {
      log.error("notify: no round has finished for two minutes; exiting so that Docker starts it again");
      process.exit(1);
    }
  }, 10_000);
  watchdog.unref();

  process.once("SIGTERM", () => {
    stopping = true;
    void (async () => {
      await watcher.stop().catch(() => undefined);
      await closeDb(db).catch(() => undefined);
      process.exit(0);
    })();
  });

  log.info({ host: settings.imap.host, port: settings.imap.port }, "notify: started");
  while (!stopping) {
    try {
      const report = await watcher.round();
      databaseDownSince = null;
      writeFileSync(HEALTH_FILE, String(Date.now()));
      if (report.inserted > 0 || report.pushed > 0 || report.error !== null) log.info(report, "notify: round");
    } catch (err) {
      databaseDownSince ??= Date.now();
      log.error({ err }, "notify: a round could not reach the database");
      if (Date.now() - databaseDownSince > pollMs) {
        log.error("notify: the database has been unreachable for longer than a round; exiting so that Docker starts it again");
        process.exit(1);
      }
    }
    lastRoundEnd = Date.now();
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, pollMs));
  }
}

const invokedDirectly = process.argv[1] !== undefined && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;
if (invokedDirectly) {
  runNotify().catch((err: unknown) => {
    // A setting it cannot start without: one sentence that names it, and exit 1.
    console.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
    process.exit(1);
  });
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/notify/push.ts`

```ts
import { renderAlert, type AlertFacts, type AlertKind, type AlertScope, type NotifyError } from "@korbat/contracts";

/**
 * The watcher's publisher (3f design, sections 5 and 7.1 step 5): one row of alert_outbox as one publish to ntfy, at
 * http://ntfy:2586/<topic> in the stack, with the publisher's token. The push is the title and the one sentence of the
 * row's kind in the contracts' ALERT_TEXTS, filled from the row's facts, which hold counts and UTC times only, so a lock
 * screen shows that an alert of a kind went out at a time and nothing else. The kind is the push's tag.
 */

/** The ntfy topic of each scope: the phone on call subscribes to the first, every staff phone to the second. */
export const TOPICS: Record<AlertScope, string> = { on_call: "korbat-oncall", all: "korbat-all" };

/** How long one publish may take before it counts as a failure to connect. */
const PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

/** A row still owed its push, as the watcher reads it. */
export interface OwedPush {
  id: number;
  kind: AlertKind;
  priority: 3 | 5;
  scope: AlertScope;
  facts: AlertFacts;
}

export type PublishOutcome = "ok" | Extract<NotifyError, "push_connect" | "push_refused">;

/**
 * Publishes one row: a 200 is "ok", any other answer push_refused, and a request that fails or does not finish in time
 * push_connect. Never throws.
 */
export async function publish(fetchFn: typeof fetch, baseUrl: string, token: string, row: OwedPush, now: Date): Promise<PublishOutcome> {
  let text: { title: string; sentence: string };
  try {
    text = renderAlert(row.kind, row.facts, now);
  } catch {
    // A row whose facts do not fill its words is never published with a hole in it.
    return "push_refused";
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetchFn(`${baseUrl}/${TOPICS[row.scope]}`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        "x-priority": String(row.priority),
        "x-tags": row.kind,
        "x-title": text.title,
        "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
      },
      body: text.sentence,
      redirect: "error",
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_MS),
    });
    // The answer's body is ntfy's message as JSON; nothing in it is needed.
    await res.body?.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
    return res.status === 200 ? "ok" : "push_refused";
  } catch {
    return "push_connect";
  }
}
```

### Create `apps/api/src/staff/orders.ts`

```ts
import { ContactCloseRequest, ContactQuery } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Hono, type Context } from "hono";
import { z } from "zod";
import type { ActiveStaffSession, AuthForStaff } from "../auth";
import type { AppEnv } from "../env";
import { validate } from "../lib/validate";
import type { ModerationForStaff } from "../moderation";

/** A message's id in a path: a uuid in the lower case the database writes (3f design, section 10.2). */
const MessageParam = z.object({ message: z.uuid().regex(/^[0-9a-f-]+$/, { message: "a uuid in lower case" }) });

/**
 * The console's routes of authorities' orders (3f design, sections 5, 7.3 and 10.2), a route group the staff routes mount
 * behind the staff gate. In this task, the contact point: its messages, read, and one closed as what it turned out to be.
 * Each stands behind requireStaff. Closing a message stands without a step-up, by name: it restricts nothing and tells
 * nobody, and its audit row records who closed it. The handlers only call the moderation module's staff interface.
 */
export function orderRoutes(auth: AuthForStaff, moderation: ModerationForStaff) {
  const routes = new Hono<AppEnv>();

  /** The session requireStaff read; a route without it in front is a wiring fault, not a refusal. */
  const staffSession = (c: Context<AppEnv>): ActiveStaffSession => {
    const session = c.get("staffSession");
    if (!session) throw new Error("a staff route ran without requireStaff");
    return session;
  };

  // The messages at the contact point, newest first; the console reads the list again every 20 seconds without the mark.
  routes.get("/contact", auth.requireStaff, validate("query", ContactQuery), async (c) => c.json(await moderation.contact(c.req.valid("query"))));

  // A message closed as what it turned out to be: every disposition but order, which only opening an order sets.
  routes.post("/contact/:message/close", auth.requireStaff, validate("param", MessageParam), validate("json", ContactCloseRequest), async (c) => {
    await moderation.closeContact(staffSession(c), c.req.valid("param").message, c.req.valid("json"), { requestId: c.get("requestId") });
    return c.body(null, 204);
  });

  return routes;
}
```

### Create `infra/ntfy/server.yml.example`

```text
# ntfy, korbat's push server (3f design, section 5). Copy to infra/ntfy/server.yml, which is git-ignored and which
# `node scripts/gen-dev-env.mjs` makes from this file when it is missing. Compose mounts it read-only: a user's line holds
# a bcrypt hash ($2a$10$...), which Compose would blank if it were a variable, and a mounted file is not interpolated.
#
# This example holds one development publisher and one development phone user, each with a fixed password and token,
# committed as examples as Turnstile's test keys are in infra/.env.example. Never use them anywhere else: notify refuses
# the example's publisher token when NODE_ENV is production. For a real server, make each user's hash and token with
# ntfy's own commands (`docker compose --profile notify run --rm ntfy user hash`, `ntfy token generate`: a token starts
# with tk_ and is 32 characters long), put the publisher's token also in NTFY_PUBLISH_TOKEN in infra/.env, and leave no
# example line here (README, On call).

# Port 2586, above 1024: ntfy runs as an unprivileged user with every capability dropped.
listen-http: ":2586"
# Behind Caddy's push site, which sets X-Forwarded-For to the client: the address Caddy sees, or behind the tunnel (a
# TUNNEL=on build) the CF-Connecting-IP that cloudflared sets, so this one setting holds for both. Without it ntfy would
# count every phone as Caddy, and 30 wrong tokens from anyone would shut every phone out (3f, lab L3).
behind-proxy: true
proxy-forwarded-header: "X-Forwarded-For"

# Private: nobody reads or writes a topic without a user who may, and nobody signs up or logs in to a web app.
auth-file: "/var/tmp/auth.db"
auth-default-access: "deny-all"
enable-signup: false
enable-login: false
web-root: disable

# The cache is how a phone gets an alert published while its connection was down: kept on ntfy's volume for 12 hours.
cache-file: "/var/tmp/cache.db"
cache-duration: "12h"
# No attachments (no attachment-cache-dir), no metrics, no upstream server: nothing leaves the push network.

# Users. Rights belong to users, never to tokens: the publisher may only write the two topics, and each phone may only
# read them. Removing a user's lines and restarting ntfy revokes the user.
auth-users:
  - "publisher:$2a$10$izatRusTjNkJX9CpzpseIeEwutWOlV8w/VXyrYlqSDz/9WtDw6pWC:user"
  - "phone-dev:$2a$10$/O3Rh9tpM/s89FMFRDL8G.lJDLqENxvLgBSLfSrlUihS2.qGbdQ3m:user"
auth-access:
  - "publisher:korbat-oncall:write-only"
  - "publisher:korbat-all:write-only"
  - "phone-dev:korbat-oncall:read-only"
  - "phone-dev:korbat-all:read-only"
auth-tokens:
  - "publisher:tk_korbatdevpublisher00000000001:notify"
  - "phone-dev:tk_korbatdevphone000000000000001:development phone"
```

### Create `packages/contracts/src/orders.ts`

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

// Authorities' orders and the alert channel (3f design, sections 6.1, 10.1, 10.2 and 18, W.1 and W.4). This module
// imports nothing from the other modules of the contracts: moderation.ts reads its constants for the staff overview, and
// the watcher (apps/api/src/notify), which imports the contracts and nothing of the API, renders its pushes from it.

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the numbers

/**
 * The numbers of 3f, the same as the SQL function order_rules() returns, which a database test compares member by
 * member: one constant mirrors one function, as STANDING_RULES mirrors standing_rules(). Every function and view of 3f
 * reads its numbers from there, and every word of the console, the pushes and the mails from here. Each is a cautious
 * default flagged for the owner (3f design, section 2): one line to change in each place.
 */
export const ORDER_RULES = {
  /** A removal order's hour (TCO Art. 3(3)); a restart of its clock is a fresh one; a message's deadline as an order. */
  hourMinutes: 60,
  /** The console's target until sub-project 3d purges edge copies. */
  targetMinutes: 55,
  /** The most items one "Disable for an order" confirms, and the most links one request names. */
  itemsPerAction: 10,
  /** Order decisions of one staff account in 24 hours. */
  decisionsPerDay: 50,
  /** Order records one staff account opens in 24 hours. */
  recordsPerDay: 20,
  /** A removal order's computed hold, and its one extension. */
  holdDays: 43,
  holdExtensionDays: 42,
  /** Every staff account is alerted this long before a held notice is released. */
  holdWarningDays: 7,
  /** No shorter hold for a tick the command line has not confirmed; a number here would cap it. */
  unconfirmedHoldHours: null,
  /** How long what a removal order disabled is preserved: months from the disabling, and a margin of days. */
  preserveMonths: 6,
  preserveMarginDays: 1,
  /** How long a deletion keeps the address while a report is owed, and when an owed report is alerted. */
  reportHoldDays: 7,
  reportAlertHours: 24,
  /** A message read more than this long after it arrived is stale and raises no push. */
  staleHours: 2,
  /** While an unhandled message's first push is this young, a further message raises no first push of its own; 0 switches the bound off. */
  quietMinutes: 15,
  /** When an unanswered message rings every phone, and the first reminder of its deadline. */
  escalateMinutes: 15,
  remindMinutes: 45,
  /** When the channel reads as down, and how long a row is still owed its push. */
  channelDownMinutes: 3,
  pushOwedMinutes: 60,
  /** When the copy of the audit log's tail is overdue, and when a hand-over archive not destroyed is alerted. */
  copyOverdueHours: 48,
  handoverAlertDays: 7,
  /** How long a handled message, an order's records and a closed restore gap are kept. */
  messageKeepDays: 30,
  recordKeepYears: 3,
  gapKeepMonths: 12,
} as const;
export type OrderRules = typeof ORDER_RULES;

/** What the database never reads: the watcher's round, the alert tick's, and how long the tick tries a row's mail. */
export const ALERT_RULES = {
  pollSeconds: 20,
  tickSeconds: 30,
  mailRetryHours: 24,
} as const;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the contact point

/** The two folders the watcher reads: the inbox, and the folder the mail host files junk in. */
export const CONTACT_FOLDERS = ["inbox", "junk"] as const;
export type ContactFolder = (typeof CONTACT_FOLDERS)[number];

/** What a message at the contact point turned out to be; `order` is set only by opening an order from it. */
export const CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS = ["order", "referral", "first_order_notice", "preservation_request", "scrutiny_decision", "clarification", "not_an_order"] as const;
export type ContactDisposition = (typeof CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS)[number];
/** What the close route takes: every disposition but `order`. */
export const CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS = ["referral", "first_order_notice", "preservation_request", "scrutiny_decision", "clarification", "not_an_order"] as const satisfies readonly Exclude<ContactDisposition, "order">[];

/** The words of the Contact point screen for each disposition (W.1). */
export const DISPOSITION_LABELS: Record<ContactDisposition, string> = {
  order: "An order",
  referral: "Referral",
  first_order_notice: "Notice before a first order",
  preservation_request: "Request to preserve longer",
  scrutiny_decision: "Scrutiny decision",
  clarification: "About an order korbat holds",
  not_an_order: "Not an order",
};

/** The eight words of notify_state.error: why the watcher's last round failed. */
export const NOTIFY_ERRORS = ["imap_connect", "imap_timeout", "imap_tls", "imap_login", "imap_folder", "imap_protocol", "push_connect", "push_refused"] as const;
export type NotifyError = (typeof NOTIFY_ERRORS)[number];

/** Messages a page of the Contact point screen. */
export const CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

const Instant = z.iso.datetime();

/** One message at the contact point, as the console reads it: no sender, no subject and no content exist to show. */
export const ContactMessage = z.strictObject({
  id: z.uuid(),
  folder: z.enum(CONTACT_FOLDERS),
  receivedAt: Instant,
  seenAt: Instant,
  stale: z.boolean(),
  disposition: z.enum(CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS).nullable(),
  handledAt: Instant.nullable(),
  /** The staff handle of whoever closed it, or null. */
  handledBy: z.string().nullable(),
  /** The orders opened from it. */
  orders: z.array(z.uuid()),
});
export type ContactMessage = z.infer<typeof ContactMessage>;

/** GET /api/staff/contact: the messages newest first by receivedAt, a page at a time. */
export const ContactPage = z.strictObject({
  items: z.array(ContactMessage).max(CONTACT_PAGE_SIZE),
  nextCursor: z.string().nullable(),
});
export type ContactPage = z.infer<typeof ContactPage>;

/** The list's query: after the cursor the API handed out, and only the messages without a disposition with open=1. */
export const ContactQuery = z.strictObject({
  cursor: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
  open: z.literal("1").optional(),
});
export type ContactQuery = z.infer<typeof ContactQuery>;

/** POST /api/staff/contact/:message/close. */
export const ContactCloseRequest = z.strictObject({ disposition: z.enum(CONTACT_CLOSE_DISPOSITIONS) });
export type ContactCloseRequest = z.infer<typeof ContactCloseRequest>;

/** The channel's state on the console's home: up, down, the mailbox unreadable, or switched off on this server. */
export const ALERT_CHANNEL_STATES = ["ok", "down", "mailbox", "off"] as const;
export type AlertChannelState = (typeof ALERT_CHANNEL_STATES)[number];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the alerts

/**
 * The closed list of alerts, the CHECK of alert_outbox.kind written from it: 3f's kinds, then 3c's and 3e's six, whose
 * mails stay their own and which gain a push.
 */
export const ALERT_KIND_LIST = [
  "contact_mail",
  "contact_mail_escalated",
  "order_due",
  "order_opened",
  "order_corrected",
  "order_effected",
  "order_reinstated",
  "order_unverified",
  "hold_ending",
  "report_owed",
  "handover_undestroyed",
  "copy_overdue",
  "copy_taken",
  "alert_channel_down",
  "mailbox_unreachable",
  "alert_test",
  "moderation_urgent",
  "moderation_waiting",
  "moderation_burst",
  "moderation_reads",
  "moderation_reveal",
  "moderation_csam_lifted",
] as const;
export type AlertKind = (typeof ALERT_KIND_LIST)[number];

export type AlertLeg = "push" | "mail";
/** The ntfy topic of a push: the phone on call, or every staff phone. A mail goes to every staff account whatever the scope. */
export type AlertScope = "on_call" | "all";

/** One kind's entry: its priority and scope, its legs, who renders its mail, and the names of its facts. */
export interface AlertKindEntry {
  readonly priority: 3 | 5;
  readonly scope: AlertScope;
  readonly legs: readonly AlertLeg[];
  /**
   * `sentence`: the mail is the kind's own entry of ALERT_TEXTS, which the alert tick can mail again from the row's facts;
   * `own`: a mail of 3c or 3e that says more than the facts hold, which only staffAlert sends; null: pushed only.
   */
  readonly mail: "sentence" | "own" | null;
  /** The names of the row's facts: counts and times, at most six. */
  readonly facts: readonly string[];
}

const both: readonly AlertLeg[] = ["push", "mail"];
const sentenceKind = (priority: 3 | 5, scope: AlertScope, facts: readonly string[]): AlertKindEntry => ({ priority, scope, legs: both, mail: "sentence", facts });
const ownKind = (priority: 3 | 5, scope: AlertScope, facts: readonly string[]): AlertKindEntry => ({ priority, scope, legs: both, mail: "own", facts });

/**
 * Each kind's facts under the names the sentences print. `order_opened` carries `unknown` (1 for an order opened without
 * a time of receipt, else 0) beside its count and its deadline, so its sentence can tell "No deadline runs" from "Its
 * deadline is unknown"; `order_effected` carries `urgent` the same way.
 */
export const ALERT_KINDS: Record<AlertKind, AlertKindEntry> = {
  contact_mail: sentenceKind(5, "on_call", ["receivedAt", "dueAt"]),
  contact_mail_escalated: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["receivedAt", "dueAt"]),
  order_due: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["dueAt", "minutesLeft", "itemsOpen"]),
  order_opened: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["items", "dueAt", "unknown"]),
  order_corrected: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "at"]),
  order_effected: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["items", "at", "itemsOpen", "urgent"]),
  order_reinstated: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at"]),
  order_unverified: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["count", "textsMissing", "holdsOpen", "oldestAt"]),
  hold_ending: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count", "at"]),
  report_owed: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["count", "oldestAt"]),
  handover_undestroyed: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["count"]),
  copy_overdue: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["hours"]),
  copy_taken: sentenceKind(3, "all", ["at", "rows"]),
  alert_channel_down: { priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["mail"], mail: "sentence", facts: ["since"] },
  mailbox_unreachable: sentenceKind(5, "all", ["since"]),
  alert_test: { priority: 3, scope: "all", legs: ["push"], mail: null, facts: ["at"] },
  moderation_urgent: ownKind(5, "on_call", ["count", "oldestAt"]),
  moderation_waiting: ownKind(3, "all", ["count"]),
  moderation_burst: ownKind(3, "all", ["count"]),
  moderation_reads: ownKind(3, "all", ["limit"]),
  moderation_reveal: ownKind(3, "all", ["at"]),
  moderation_csam_lifted: ownKind(3, "all", ["at"]),
};

/** The kinds the watcher publishes: every kind with a push leg. */
export const PUSH_KINDS: readonly AlertKind[] = ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => ALERT_KINDS[kind].legs.includes("push"));
/** The kinds whose mail is their push's sentence, which the alert tick mails from the row. */
export const SENTENCE_MAIL_KINDS: readonly AlertKind[] = ALERT_KIND_LIST.filter((kind) => ALERT_KINDS[kind].mail === "sentence");

/** The facts of a row: counts, and instants as ISO strings in UTC. */
export type AlertFacts = Readonly<Record<string, number | string>>;

/** A fact that is a time: `at`, `since`, or a name that ends in At. Every other fact is a count. */
export const isTimeFact = (name: string): boolean => name === "at" || name === "since" || name.endsWith("At");

/** What a part of a sentence is printed under: a fact present or missing, above zero, or equal to 1 or not. */
export interface AlertCondition {
  readonly fact: string;
  readonly is: "present" | "absent" | "positive" | "one" | "not_one";
}
/** A part of a sentence, printed when its condition holds; the parts printed are joined with a space. */
export interface AlertPart {
  readonly text: string;
  /** One condition, or several that must all hold. */
  readonly when?: AlertCondition | readonly AlertCondition[];
}
/** A kind's words: the title, the sentence in parts, and for a kind whose mail is its sentence the mail's line of what to do. */
export interface AlertText {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly sentence: readonly AlertPart[];
  readonly todo: string | null;
}

const NOT_LISTED = 'An order you find there is opened in the console under Orders, with "The message is not listed".';
const KEY_TOLD = "Every staff account gets this. If it was confirmed with your key and not by you, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.";
const one = (text: string): readonly AlertPart[] => [{ text }];

/**
 * The words of each kind (W.4). A value in braces is a member of the row's facts, a count or a time, or a number of
 * ORDER_RULES, which is no fact of the row: no number is typed here, so a changed rule changes the words. The push is the
 * title and the sentence; a mail whose kind's mail is its sentence has the title as its subject after "korbat: ", and
 * the sentence and the line of what to do as its paragraphs.
 */
export const ALERT_TEXTS: Record<AlertKind, AlertText> = {
  contact_mail: {
    title: "Mail at the contact point",
    sentence: [
      { text: "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received {receivedAt}. If it is a removal order it is due {dueAt}.", when: { fact: "receivedAt", is: "present" } },
      // A restart of an order's clock writes a row with the new deadline and no time of receipt.
      { text: "A removal order's hour has started again: due {dueAt}.", when: { fact: "receivedAt", is: "absent" } },
    ],
    todo: "Read it in the mail host's app, never in korbat, and with it every other new message there: further mail within {quietMinutes} minutes raises no alarm of its own. Then open Contact point in the staff console. What ends this message's alarms is handling it there: opening an order from it, or closing it.",
  },
  contact_mail_escalated: {
    title: "Nobody has answered: mail at the contact point",
    sentence: one("Nobody has answered the mail that arrived at the authorities' contact point at {receivedAt}. If it is a removal order it is due {dueAt}."),
    todo: "This went to every staff phone. Whoever reads it first acts, and tells the others.",
  },
  order_due: {
    title: "{minutesLeft} minutes left",
    sentence: one("A removal order, or mail that may be one, is due {dueAt}: {minutesLeft} minutes are left and it is not carried out in full."),
    todo: "Give effect now, to every post the order names. Only if the order has a manifest error, or lacks what you need to find the content, send Annex III and record it: that is no way to stop this alarm. If nobody can act in time: the README, When nobody can act within the hour.",
  },
  order_opened: {
    title: "An order was opened",
    sentence: [
      { text: "An order was opened: {items} items." },
      { text: "Due {dueAt}.", when: { fact: "dueAt", is: "present" } },
      { text: "No deadline runs.", when: [{ fact: "dueAt", is: "absent" }, { fact: "unknown", is: "not_one" }] },
      { text: "Its deadline is unknown: act now.", when: [{ fact: "dueAt", is: "absent" }, { fact: "unknown", is: "one" }] },
    ],
    todo: "If you are not the one on call, you need do nothing. If nobody was on call, ask who opened it.",
  },
  order_corrected: {
    title: "An order's record was corrected",
    sentence: one("An order's record was corrected at {at}: {count} of its entries changed."),
    todo: "Every staff account gets this, because a record can be corrected without a key. If you are on call, read the order again before you act on it. If nobody says it was them, a staff session is in someone else's hands: tell the operator at once.",
  },
  order_effected: {
    title: "An order was given effect",
    sentence: [
      { text: "An order was given effect at {at}: {items} posts disabled.", when: { fact: "urgent", is: "not_one" } },
      { text: "An order that is not verified was given effect as urgent at {at}: {items} posts disabled.", when: { fact: "urgent", is: "one" } },
      { text: "{itemsOpen} items of the order are still open.", when: { fact: "itemsOpen", is: "positive" } },
    ],

  },
  order_reinstated: {

  },

      { text: "{count} orders are given effect and not verified, or hold a post added after their check, the oldest since {oldestAt}." },
      { text: "{textsMissing} are given effect and have no reasons of the authority recorded for their authors.", when: { fact: "textsMissing", is: "positive" } },
      { text: "{holdsOpen} hold a notice with no end recorded.", when: { fact: "holdsOpen", is: "positive" } },
    ],

  },

    title: "A report to the authorities is owed",
    sentence: one("{count} reports to the authorities have been owed for more than {reportAlertHours} hours, the oldest since {oldestAt}."),
    todo: "The admin answers the case; whoever has the server reports and records it (staff.js records). This repeats daily until then.",
  },
  handover_undestroyed: {
    title: "A hand-over copy still exists",
    sentence: one("{count} hand-over archives are older than {handoverAlertDays} days and not recorded as destroyed."),
    todo: "Whoever has the server deletes every copy and records it with staff.js handover-destroyed.",
  },
  copy_overdue: {
    title: "The copy is overdue",
    sentence: one("The audit log's tail was last downloaded {hours} hours ago."),
    todo: "The keeper opens the console's Audit log today and presses Download since my last copy.",
  },

    todo: "If you are the keeper's stand-in, or asked for it, nothing is to be done. If nobody says it was them, a staff session and its key are in someone else's hands: tell the operator at once.",
  },
```
