```text
/*
 * The staff console's only stylesheet. The page's policy allows styles from its own files only (style-src 'self'), so
 * every rule is here and no component sets a style. Red marks the staff console apart from the app at a glance.
 */
:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;
  --bg: #fafaf9;
  --fg: #1c1917;
  --muted: #57534e;
  --line: #d6d3d1;
  --panel: #ffffff;
  --accent: #991b1b;
  --accent-fg: #ffffff;
  --error-bg: #fef2f2;
  --error-fg: #991b1b;
  --notice-bg: #fffbeb;
  --notice-fg: #78350f;
  --ok-bg: #f0fdf4;
  --ok-fg: #14532d;
  --focus: #2563eb;
  font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --bg: #0c0a09;
    --fg: #f5f5f4;
    --muted: #a8a29e;
    --line: #44403c;
    --panel: #1c1917;
    --accent: #dc2626;
    --error-bg: #450a0a;
    --error-fg: #fecaca;
    --notice-bg: #451a03;
    --notice-fg: #fde68a;
    --ok-bg: #052e16;
    --ok-fg: #bbf7d0;
    --focus: #60a5fa;
  }
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--fg);
}

.masthead {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  border-top: 4px solid var(--accent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--panel);
}

.masthead h1 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.masthead nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.masthead .who {
  margin: 0 0 0 auto;
  color: var(--muted);
}

main {
  max-width: 72rem;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 1.5rem;
}

.unavailable {
  max-width: 40rem;
  padding-top: 4rem;
}

.panel {
  max-width: 40rem;
}

h2 {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
}

h3 {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  margin: 2rem 0 0.25rem;
}

a {
  color: var(--accent);
}

a[aria-current="page"] {
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
}

button {
  font: inherit;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.9rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  background: var(--panel);
  color: var(--fg);
  cursor: pointer;
}

button.primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-fg);
}

button:disabled {
  opacity: 0.6;
  cursor: default;
}

button[aria-busy="true"] {
  cursor: progress;
}

a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

label {
  display: block;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

input[type="text"] {
  font: inherit;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 24rem;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  background: var(--panel);
  color: var(--fg);
}

input[aria-invalid="true"] {
  border-color: var(--error-fg);
}

.actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.hint,
.quiet {
  color: var(--muted);
}

.error {
  background: var(--error-bg);
  color: var(--error-fg);
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
}

.error p {
  margin: 0.25rem 0;
}

.notice {
  background: var(--ok-bg);
  color: var(--ok-fg);
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
}

.ended {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.idle.warning {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  background: var(--notice-bg);
  color: var(--notice-fg);
}

.idle.warning p {
  margin: 0;
}

.place {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.place label {
  margin: 0;
}

.place input[type="text"] {
  width: 12rem;
}

.scroll {
  overflow-x: auto;
}

table {
  border-collapse: collapse;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 1rem;
}

th,
td {
  text-align: left;
  vertical-align: top;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

code {
  font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 0.85em;
}

/* A hash is copied whole by the keeper, so it wraps anywhere rather than widening the table. */
.hash {
  word-break: break-all;
}

/* User-written text may be one long word. */
bdi {
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.signins,
.keys {
  padding-left: 1.25rem;
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  margin: -1px;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* Moderation cases (3c design, section 8). */

select,
textarea {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 40rem;
  margin: 0.25rem 0 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem;
  font: inherit;
  color: var(--fg);
  background: var(--panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

select:focus-visible,
textarea:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

h4 {
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.lanes,
.reveals,
.today,
.history,
.seal-list {
  padding-left: 1.25rem;
}

.plain {
  padding-left: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.item,
.decision,
.snapshot {
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
}

/* A banner stands above the evidence and is read before it. */
.banner {
  margin: 1rem 0;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--error-bg);
  color: var(--error-fg);
}

.banner p {
  margin: 0.4rem 0;
}

/*
 * Text someone else wrote, inside a frame that says who wrote it: the label is the console's, the text is theirs, and
 * the border keeps the two apart.
 */
.frame {
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--line);
  background: var(--panel);
}

.frame-label {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.frame-text {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}

.quiet-button {
  padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.images {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding-left: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.images li {
  width: 16rem;
}

/* Every image of a case starts as this grey box of one size, whatever the image's own size, until its person asks for it. */
.placeholder {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 16rem;
  height: 12rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  color: var(--muted);
  background: var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
}

.evidence {
  max-width: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
}

/* The first look at an image: blurred and grey, so its person sees what kind of image it is before they see it. */
.evidence.blurred {
  filter: blur(14px) grayscale(1);
}

.dialog {
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: var(--panel);
}

/* The decision composer: its choices, the rule beside its examples, and the statement its author will receive. */
.composer {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.composer fieldset {
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
}

.composer fieldset label {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 1.25rem;
}

.composer textarea {
  width: 100%;
}

/* What a rule allows and what it does not, side by side. */
.examples {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.examples h5 {
  margin: 0.25rem 0;
}

.preview h4 {
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
}

/* Authorities' orders (3f design, section 8): the home screen's block, and the Contact point screen's lists of blocks. */

.authorities p {
  margin: 0.5rem 0;
}

.blocks {
  padding-left: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.block {
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
  background: var(--panel);
}

.block p {
  margin: 0.25rem 0;
}

.block fieldset,
.stale-together {
  margin: 0.75rem 0;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 0.375rem;
}

.choices {
  padding-left: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

/* A choice is its radio button and its label, one block that is touched as one. */
.choice {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 44px;
}

.choices .hint {
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1.75rem;
}

/*
 * The phone (3f design, section 8.1): at widths under 600 px every screen is one column, a table is a list of blocks,
 * and every control is at least 44 px high and wide. A link inside a sentence is laid out as a block of its own, so it
 * can be measured and touched; a tick box or a radio button is measured with its label.
 */
@media (max-width: 599px) {
  .masthead {
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem;
  }

  .masthead nav {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0 0.75rem;
  }

  .masthead .who {
    margin: 0;
    flex-basis: 100%;
  }

  main {
    padding: 1rem;
  }

  a,
  button,
  select,
  textarea,
  summary,
  input:not([type="radio"]):not([type="checkbox"]) {
    min-height: 44px;
    min-width: 44px;
  }

  a {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  main p a,
  main li a {
    display: flex;
  }

  button {
    max-width: 100%;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  table,
  thead,
  tbody,
  tr,
  th,
  td,
  caption {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  thead {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
  }

  tr {
    padding: 0.5rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  th,
  td {
    padding: 0.15rem 0;
    border-bottom: none;
  }

  .examples {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .images li,
  .placeholder {
    width: 100%;
  }

  code,
  pre {
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }

  .composer fieldset label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 44px;
    margin-right: 0;
  }
}
```

```ts
    /** [keep.lateEnded] */
    lateEnded: (endedAt: string) => `Nothing changes; it ended on ${endedAt}, as decided.`,
  },
  reverse: {
    /** [reverse.onTime] */
    onTime: "It never starts.",
    /** [reverse.late] */
    late: "It ends when you confirm.",
    /** [reverse.lateEnded] */
    lateEnded: (endedAt: string) => `It ended on ${endedAt}. Reversing it takes it off the record: it no longer counts toward a later suspension.`,
  },
  /** 8.7: "Withdraw it for another measure". */
  replace: {
    label: "Withdraw it for another measure",
    /** [replace.what] */
    what: "Use this only to make room for a measure at once: after you confirm, take that measure in the account's case. The person is told that korbat withdrew the announced suspension because it is taking another measure, and that this is no decision on their reply. A withdrawn suspension was never a step of the ladder.",
    /** [replace.reply] */
    reply: "The person's reply is closed by this withdrawal without an answer on its merits. Say in the reason that their reply was read, if it was, and that they can reply to the new measure.",
  },
  /** 8.7: [review.reply] */
  reviewReply:
    "This review also answers the person's reply. Keep, and Reverse in part when the suspension stays, answer it as a kept answer does: a suspension held by the reply then starts when you confirm, or at its announced time if that is later. Read the reply before you decide; its text is kept until it is answered.",
  /** 8.7: [review.admin] */
  reviewAdmin: "A decision that holds a termination, or a measure taken at once, is reviewed and corrected by an admin.",
  /** 8.6: the Standing screen. */
  lists: {
    title: "Standing",
    strikesTitle: `Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes`,
    /** A row of the accounts at the ladder's strikes. */
    strikesRow: (handle: string, activeStrikes: number, rule: string, day: string, maxDays: number | null, mayTerminate: boolean) =>
      `@${handle}: ${activeStrikes} active strikes, the newest under ${rule} on ${day}. ${mayTerminate ? "A termination can be announced." : `A suspension of at most ${maxDays ?? 0} days can be announced.`}`,
    /** [lists.strikes] */
    strikes: `An account appears here while it has ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} active strikes, one of them newer than its last suspension under the ladder, and no suspension or termination that stands and has not ended. Nothing happens by itself: a moderator opens a case, reads the strikes' decisions and decides.`,
    /** [lists.finding] */
    finding: "Opening the case is a finding of your own, so you cannot review an appeal in it.",
    openCase: "Open a case on this account",
    reportingTitle: "Reporting records",
    reportingRow: (handle: string, unfounded: number, reports: number) => `@${handle}: ${unfounded} of the ${reports} rule reports sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days hold a mark manifestly unfounded.`,
    /** Task 5: after a reporting record's row, whether the account is at the warning's threshold or was warned. */
    reportingThreshold: "At the warning threshold.",
    reportingWarned: (warnedOn: string, marksSince: number) => `Warned on ${warnedOn}; ${marksSince} of the reports sent since then are marked.`,
    noticesTitle: "Notices not sent",
    noticesRow: (handle: string, decidedOn: string, startsAt: string) =>

    terminationsTitle: "Terminations waiting",
    terminatedOn: (handle: string, decidedOn: string) => `@${handle}: terminated on ${decidedOn}.`,
    finalOn: (finalOn: string) => `Final on ${finalOn}; the account is deleted in the first round after that.`,
    appealHolds: "An appeal is pending: nothing is deleted before it is answered.",

    more: (total: number, shown: number) => `${total - shown} more not listed here.`,
  },
  /** 8.8: the home screen's two lines. */
  home: {
    replies: (n: number, age: string) =>
      `Replies waiting: ${n}, the oldest for ${age}. A held suspension does not start until its reply is answered, and a terminated account is not deleted before its reply is.`,
    strikes: (n: number) => `Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes: ${n}.`,
  },
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 5 (design, sections 8.3, 8.4 and 8.7)
  /** 8.3: the warning about reporting and the restriction of it. Both cite R6; the composer sets it. */
  reporting: {
    warnLabel: "Warn about reporting",
    restrictLabel: "Restrict reporting",
    /** Beside both controls. */
    rule: "Both measures cite R6; the composer sets it.",
    /** [warn.what], with the account's counts as this page read them. */
    warnWhat: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `A warning restricts nothing. It tells the account that ${unfounded} of the ${reports} reports it sent under the rules in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days were marked manifestly unfounded, lists them, and says that ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks} marked reports among those it sends after the warning may lead to a restriction. A report counts once, however many of its items were marked, and by the day it was sent. A notice of illegal content is never counted.`,
    /** [warn.short] */
    warnShort: (unfounded: number, reports: number) =>
      `Not open: a warning needs at least ${STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks} marked reports among those the account sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days, and they must be at least half of its rule reports sent in that time. This account has ${unfounded} of ${reports}. One report never reaches the number alone.`,
    /** [warn.standing] */
    warnStanding: (warnedOn: string) => `Not open: the warning of ${warnedOn} still counts.`,
    /** [restrict.what], with the days chosen. */
    restrictWhat: (days: number) =>
      `This stops the account's reports under korbat's rules for ${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"}, from the moment you confirm; the warning was its notice, and the restriction ends with it if the warning is lifted. At most ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days. Notices of illegal content, reports of child sexual abuse material and requests for re-examination stay open to it.`,
    /** [restrict.noWarning] */
    restrictNoWarning: "Not open: the account has no warning that still counts. Warn first.",
    /** [restrict.short] */
    restrictShort: (marksSince: number, warnedOn: string) => `Not open: ${marksSince} of the reports the account sent since the warning of ${warnedOn} were marked; a restriction needs ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks}.`,
    /** [restrict.running] */
    restrictRunning: (restrictedUntil: string) => `Not open: a restriction runs until ${restrictedUntil}.`,
    /** How many days, at most the restriction's own number. */
    daysLabel: `Days (1 to ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays})`,
    /** 8.7: the reversal of each reporting measure, named by what it lifts. */
    liftWarning: "Lift the warning about reporting",
    liftRestriction: "Lift the restriction of reporting",
  },
  /** 8.4: the mark "manifestly unfounded" beside the items a "No breach" decision answers, and its withdrawal. */
  mark: {
    /** [mark.label] */
    label: "Manifestly unfounded",
    /** [mark.rule] */
    rule: `Tick only a report that anyone could see was unfounded without weighing it: it names nothing the rule could cover. A report you had to think about is not manifestly unfounded, also when you found no breach. Your key signs the mark. What counts toward a warning about reporting is the report, once, for ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days from the day it was sent, however many of its items are ticked. The person who sent it sees the mark on their own list of reports once this answer is released to them, and can ask for a re-examination.`,
    /** [mark.never], once, when an item the decision answers cannot be marked. */
    never: "Only a signed-in person's report under a rule can be marked: never a notice of illegal content, a report on the path for child sexual abuse material, or a report sent without an account.",
    /** [mark.undone] */
    undone: "A mark stops counting when a re-examination of its report ends in a restriction, and when a correction of the decision that set it withdraws it.",

    withdrawLabel: "Withdraw this decision's marks",
    withdrawWhat:
      "Use this when the reports were arguable after all: it was wrong to call them manifestly unfounded, also if no rule was broken. All marks this decision set are withdrawn together.     /** On the case page, beside an item whose mark stands and one whose mark was withdrawn (CaseItem.markWithdrawn). */
    marked: "Marked manifestly unfounded",
    withdrawn: "Mark withdrawn",

    noStatement: "No statement is sent: withdrawing marks changes nothing for the author of what was reported, and the people who reported see it on their own lists.",

    legend: "Reports this decision answers",
  },
  /** 8.7: [review.warning], when a restriction of reporting rests on the reviewed decision's warning. */

  /** 8.5: [appeals.order] */
  appealsOrder: "Appeals of a running suspension or of a termination come first.",
  /** 8.5: the mark of an appeal listed first. */
  appealsFirst: "a running suspension or a termination",

/**
 * The moderation codes the console can meet (3c design, sections 8 and 10): those of the case routes, of a decision, of
 * a review, of a finding's link and of a reveal. The codes of the app's own report form, appeal and re-examination never
 * reach the console.
 */
export const CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES = [
  "notice_link_invalid",
  "notice_link_offsite",
  "case_changed",
  "case_closed",
  "staff_recused",
  "staff_target",
  "admin_required",
  "reviewer_conflict",
  "decision_cap",
  "profile_changed",
  "snapshot_mismatch",
  "snapshot_erased",
  "text_invalid",
  "text_quotes_user",
  "text_not_found",
  "invalid_decision",
  "image_refused",
  "reveal_refused",
  // 3e (design, section 8.9): the first three are the ones the composer meets; the other two cannot reach the console
  // today and are worded so that the table has an entry for each code of the type.
  "strike_mismatch",
  "standing_conflict",
  "ground_not_established",
  "reply_not_open",
  "reporting_restricted",
  // 3f (design, section 8.9): a message at the contact point that someone else closed meanwhile.
  "message_handled",
] as const satisfies readonly ModerationErrorCode[];
export type ConsoleModerationCode = (typeof CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES)[number];

/** The console's words for each of them. A recusal reads the same whether the conflict concerns the author or a reporter. */
export const MODERATION_MESSAGES: Record<ConsoleModerationCode, string> = {
  notice_link_invalid: "That link does not name a post or a profile on korbat.",
  notice_link_offsite: "That link leads to another site. A case is opened only on a post or a profile of this korbat.",
  case_changed: "The case changed since this page read it. Read it again, check it and decide again.",
  case_closed: "The case changed at that moment. Try again.",
  staff_recused:
    "You cannot open or decide this case: an account linked to you takes part in it, or follows, blocks, mutes or replied to someone who does, or the post replies to or quotes a post of an account linked to you. Another staff member must handle it.",
  staff_target: "A final decision cannot restrict a staff account: staff are disciplined by demotion. A measure taken while deciding can.",
  admin_required: "Only an admin can take this decision.",
  reviewer_conflict: "You cannot review this appeal: you made a decision in its case, or opened a finding in it. Another staff member must review it.",
  decision_cap: "You have reached the limit on decisions one staff account may confirm for now. Try again later.",
  profile_changed: "The profile changed since the snapshot was taken. Take a fresh snapshot and decide again.",
  snapshot_mismatch: "The snapshot is not the one this case holds. Read the case again.",
  snapshot_erased: "That snapshot was erased under korbat's retention rules. Take a fresh snapshot and decide again.",
  text_invalid: "This text cannot be saved as it is: it is longer than 5000 characters, or holds a control character or an invisible direction or spacing character.",
  text_quotes_user: "This text quotes what someone wrote about this case. Describe it in your own words, never copy it.",
  text_not_found: "A text of this action is not saved any more, or was used already. Save it again.",
  invalid_decision: "This decision cannot stand as it is.",
  image_refused: "That image is not shown.",
  reveal_refused: "Nobody can be revealed for this item: it names no sender, or its sender's name is no longer kept.",
  strike_mismatch: "The strike rule changed for this post since this page read it. Read the case again and decide again.",
  standing_conflict: STANDING_CONFLICT,
  ground_not_established: STANDING_TERMINATE_R2,
  reply_not_open: "This measure takes no reply: it has ended or was lifted.",
  reporting_restricted: "That account's reports under the rules are restricted.",
  message_handled: "That message was already handled. Read Contact point again.",

/** A small number as a word, as the design's sentences write it; a larger one in digits. */
const inWords = (n: number): string => ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten", "eleven", "twelve"][n] ?? String(n);

/** A removal order's hour (ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes) in the words the console's sentences use. */
const HOUR_WORDS = ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes === 60 ? "one hour" : `${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes} minutes`;
/** The last choice of the form "Open an order" (Task 2), which every sentence that sends a person there names. */
const NOT_LISTED = '"The message is not listed"';

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 8.2, 8.3 and 18): the console's sentences of authorities' orders, each under the design's key
 * (`home.contact` is [home.contact]). Every number in one is printed from the answer or from ORDER_RULES, never typed, and
 * every time is the database's instant, printed by bothTimes. Later tasks of 3f add their keys here.
 */
export const ORDER_WORDS = {
  home: {
    title: "Authorities",
    /** [home.contact], in three parts: the words before the link to Contact point, the link's own words, and the rest. */
    contact: (oldestAt: string, open: number) => ({
      before: `Mail at the authorities' contact point since ${oldestAt}: ${open} ${open === 1 ? "message" : "messages"} nobody has handled. Read it in the mail host's app, then open `,
      link: "Contact point",
      after: `. A removal order is due ${HOUR_WORDS} after it arrived.`,
    }),
    channel: (since: string) =>
      `Phone alerts are down since ${since}. Alerts arrive by mail only: keep the mail host's app open on the contact-point mailbox until this line is gone. An order you find there that Contact point does not list is opened under Orders, with ${NOT_LISTED}.`,
    mailbox: (since: string) => `korbat has not been able to read the contact-point mailbox since ${since}. Check it in the mail host's app until this line is gone. An order you find there is opened under Orders, with ${NOT_LISTED}.`,
    off: "Phone alerts and the contact point's watcher are switched off on this server. Nothing watches the contact-point mailbox: the operator switches them on.",
  },
  contact: {
    title: "Contact point",
    what: `korbat records that a message arrived and when. It never reads who sent it or what it says: read the message in the mail host's app. Every message here may be a removal order until a person has read it. The junk folder is watched too: an order filed as junk has still arrived. While one message's alarm is less than ${ORDER_RULES.quietMinutes} minutes old, further mail is listed here and raises no new alarm of its own: read every message listed, not only the first. A message that is in the mailbox and not listed here (the watcher was down, or the mail host filed it in another folder) is opened as an order all the same: Orders, "Open an order", ${NOT_LISTED}.`,
    reply: "Never answer an authority from korbat, and never open an attachment on a device that holds a staff key before you have checked the sender against the register.",
    received: (at: string) => `Received ${at}`,
    folders: { inbox: "Inbox", junk: "Junk folder" } as Record<"inbox" | "junk", string>,
    stale: `korbat first saw this message more than ${ORDER_RULES.staleHours} hours after it arrived (after an outage or a restore). It raised no phone alert.`,
    notHandled: "Not handled",
    /** "Handled as {disposition} by @{handle} on {handledAt}", around the handle, which the screen shows as text. */
    handledBefore: (label: string) => `Handled as ${label} by @`,
    handledAfter: (at: string) => ` on ${at}`,
    /** The same when no staff member set it (an order opened from the command line). */
    handledBySystem: (label: string, at: string) => `Handled as ${label} on ${at}`,
    handledOrder: "Handled as an order",
    closeAs: "Close as",
    closeButton: "Close",
    close: "Closing ends this message's alerts and cannot be changed. Close it only after you have read it in the mail host's app.",
    closed: (label: string) => `Closed as ${label}.`,
    staleTogether: (n: number) => `Close the ${n} stale messages as`,
    staleButton: "Close them",
    staleAll: (n: number) =>
      `These ${n} messages reached korbat's record more than ${ORDER_RULES.staleHours} hours after they arrived and raised no alert. Look at each in the mail host's app before you close them: one of them may be an order, and it is then opened, not closed. Closing cannot be changed.`,
    staleClosed: (n: number) => `${n} stale messages closed.`,
    loadOlder: "Load older",
    empty: "No message has arrived at the contact point.",
    /** The hint under each choice of "Close as" (8.3's table). */
    hints: {
      referral: "An authority points to content and orders nothing. Open a case of your own on it (Queue, Open a case) and decide it under korbat's rules or the law.",
      first_order_notice: "An authority tells korbat about its procedures and deadlines at least 12 hours before its first removal order (Article 3(2)). Keep the mail and tell the operator: an order from that authority may follow.",
      preservation_request: `An authority or a court asks korbat to keep disabled content beyond ${inWords(ORDER_RULES.preserveMonths)} months. Whoever has the server records it with staff.js order-preserve-extend.`,
      scrutiny_decision: "The home authority's decision on a removal order from another Member State (Article 4). An admin acts on it on the order: reinstates, or leaves the order in force.",
      clarification: `A clarification after an Annex III, a withdrawal, an annulment, or an extension or end of a non-disclosure period. A clarification that restarts the clock is recorded on the order itself ("Clarification received"), and an extension of a removal order's non-disclosure period by an admin on the order itself ("Extension received"), at once: the database releases the author's notice by itself at the old end. Either closes this message. Close it here only for the others, and tell the operator the same day; for a later end that an authority gives for a DSA order's silence, only whoever has the server can record it (staff.js order-hold-until), so call them.`,
      not_an_order: "Anything else: a question, an advertisement, a user's mail sent to the wrong address.",

  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}
```

### Replace `apps/admin/src/router.ts` (whole file)

```ts
/**
 * The console's own router (3a design, section 9; 3c design, section 8): its fixed pages, a case by its id, an enrolment
 * link, and nothing else. The address bar is the only state it reads; the store pushes and replaces history entries
 * itself, so the page needs no routing library.
 */

/** The pages the console links to by name. Such a link is only ever one of these constants, never an address built from data. */
export type ConsolePath = "/" | "/audit" | "/signin" | "/queue" | "/appeals" | "/standing" | "/contact";

/** A uuid in the one spelling PostgreSQL writes: the only form an id takes in an address the console builds. */
const LOWER_UUID = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/;

/** Whether a text is a lower-case uuid, and nothing else. */
export const isLowerUuid = (text: string): boolean => LOWER_UUID.test(text);

declare const caseIdBrand: unique symbol;
/** A case's id that parseCaseId has checked: the only thing a case's address is ever built from. */
export type CaseId = string & { readonly [caseIdBrand]: true };

/** The case's id when the text is a lower-case uuid; null for anything else, which names no case. */
export function parseCaseId(text: string): CaseId | null {
  return isLowerUuid(text) ? (text as CaseId) : null;
}

/** A case's address in the console: the one address the console builds from a value, and only from a checked id. */
export const caseHref = (id: CaseId): string => `/cases/${id}`;

export type Route =
  | { name: "home" }
  | { name: "audit" }
  | { name: "signin" }
  | { name: "queue" }
  | { name: "appeals" }
  | { name: "standing" }
  // 3f: the authorities' contact point.
  | { name: "contact" }
  | { name: "case"; id: CaseId }
  | { name: "enroll"; token: string }
  | { name: "unknown" };

/**
 * The route an address names. A trailing slash names the same page. An enrolment link's token is kept exactly as written:
 * the enrolment page checks its shape before it sends it anywhere.
 */
export function parseRoute(pathname: string): Route {
  const path = pathname.length > 1 && pathname.endsWith("/") ? pathname.slice(0, -1) : pathname;
  if (path === "/") return { name: "home" };
  if (path === "/audit") return { name: "audit" };
  if (path === "/signin") return { name: "signin" };
  if (path === "/queue") return { name: "queue" };
  if (path === "/appeals") return { name: "appeals" };
  if (path === "/standing") return { name: "standing" };
  if (path === "/contact") return { name: "contact" };
  const found = /^\/cases\/([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/.exec(path);
  if (found) {
    const id = parseCaseId(found[1]!);
    if (id) return { name: "case", id };
  }
  const enroll = /^\/enroll\/([^/]+)$/.exec(path);
  if (enroll) return { name: "enroll", token: enroll[1]! };
  return { name: "unknown" };
}
```

```tsx
import { OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX, type AuditEntry, type StaffKey, type StaffMe, type StaffOverview, type StaffSession } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { StaffApi } from "../api";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, describeError, ORDER_WORDS, PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "../messages";
import { CaseLink, NavLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId, type ConsolePath } from "../router";
import { readSignInsAtOpening } from "../signins";
import { revokeSessionWithKey } from "../step-up";
import { bothTimes, clockTime, dateTime, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { counted, LANE_NAMES, waited } from "../words";

/**
 * One of the home screen's lists of the path for child sexual abuse material: each row with its time, its staff handle
 * as text, a link to its case built from a checked id, and the console's own words for what the row is. A list holds at
 * most OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX rows, and says how many there are when there are more.
 */
function StaffList<T extends { at: string; handle: string; caseId: string }>({ title, hint, empty, list, words, onOpenCase }: { title: string; hint: string; empty: string; list: { total: number; items: T[] }; words(item: T): ReactNode; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void }) {
  return (
    <>
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      <p className="hint">{hint}</p>
      {list.items.length === 0 ? (
        <p>{empty}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="reveals">
          {list.items.map((item, index) => {
            const id = parseCaseId(item.caseId);
            return (
              <li key={`${item.at} ${item.caseId} ${index}`}>
                <time dateTime={item.at}>{dateTime(item.at)}</time> <UserText>{item.handle}</UserText>{" "}
                {id ? (
                  <CaseLink id={id} onOpen={onOpenCase}>
                    the case
                  </CaseLink>
                ) : null}{" "}
                {words(item)}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}
      {list.total > list.items.length ? <p>{`Showing the newest ${OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX} of ${list.total}.`}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The runbook's sentence for a count of decisions not released, in the words of the runbook's own bullet (3c design,
 * section 13, Task 12(a)). It is a constant of its own so that the test of the README's runbook can hold the two to the
 * same words: what the home screen tells staff is what the runbook tells the operator.
 */
export const RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK =
  "A count of decisions not released means the daily release keeps failing: notifiers are not told and re-examination windows do not open, so read the API log for moderation-dispatch and fix it the same day.";

/** The home screen's line when decided items wait for the daily release longer than it ever takes: the count, then the runbook's sentence for it. */
export const releaseOverdue = (n: number): string => `Decisions not released after 26 hours: ${n}. ${RELEASE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`;

/**
 * The runbook's sentence for a count of late erasures, in the words of the runbook's own bullet (3c design, section 13,
 * Task 12(a)), a constant of its own for the same reason as the one above.
 */
export const ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK =
  "A count of late erasures names the due rule whose step keeps failing, so evidence, an intake record or a notifier's name and address outlives its published period: read the API log for moderation-retention and for auth janitor: purge failed, and check that API_MODERATION_RETENTION was not left off after a restore (the API logs it at every start).";

/** What each count of late erasures counts, in the order the retention job's steps run; the two last are the image rows and the auth janitor's. */
export const ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS: Record<keyof StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"], string> = {
  drafts: "unconfirmed drafts",
  caseEvidence: "closed cases whose evidence is due",
  intakeRecords: "records of reports and notices",
  redactions: "R4 erasures",
  statements: "statements of deleted accounts",
  accessLog: "access log rows",
  images: "image rows nothing retains",
  contacts: "notifiers' contacts and confirmations",
};

/**
 * The home screen's line for what retention is late with by more than a day: each count above zero under its own words,
 * then the runbook's sentence. Null when nothing is late, and then the screen says nothing.
 */
export function erasureOverdue(counts: StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"]): string | null {
  const late = (Object.keys(ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS) as (keyof StaffOverview["erasureOverdue"])[]).filter((key) => counts[key] > 0).map((key) => `${ERASURE_OVERDUE_WORDS[key]}: ${counts[key]}`);
  return late.length === 0 ? null : `Erasures more than a day late: ${late.join("; ")}. ${ERASURE_OVERDUE_RUNBOOK}`;
}

/**
 * What every staff member sees of the cases (3c design, section 8): the lanes with their open cases and how long the
 * oldest has waited, the appeals waiting (with those this person may review and those nobody may review now), every reveal of a source in the last 30 days with its staff handle and its
 * case, the decisions that lifted the protection of reported images, the recorded choices not to seal and the seals
 * taken while deciding that are in force, what each staff account viewed and opened today, the mails that wait or were
 * given up, and the emergency switch. Counts, times, handles and case links only.
 */
/**
 * The home screen's appeals line (3c design, section 8): how many wait, how many of them the reading person may review,
 * and how many no staff account may review now.
 */
export function appealsLine(overview: Pick<StaffOverview, "appealsWaiting" | "appealsYouMayReview" | "appealsWithoutReviewer">): string {
  const { appealsWaiting: waiting, appealsYouMayReview: yours, appealsWithoutReviewer: without } = overview;
  if (waiting === 0) return "No appeal waits.";
  const parts = [waiting === 1 ? "1 appeal waits" : `${waiting} appeals wait`, `you may review ${yours === 0 ? "none" : yours}`];
  if (without > 0) parts.push(`${without} ${without === 1 ? "has" : "have"} no possible reviewer now`);
  return `${parts.join("; ")}.`;
}

/**
 * 3e Task 4 (design, section 8.8): the home screen's two lines, each shown when above zero and each a link to its list:
 * the replies waiting, with the oldest one's age, and the accounts at the ladder's number of strikes. Without a way to
 * move between pages (a test's rendering), each is plain text.
 */
function StandingLines({ overview, now, onNavigate }: { overview: StaffOverview; now: number; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const { repliesWaiting, strikeAccounts } = overview;
  const line = (text: string, to: ConsolePath) => (onNavigate ? <NavLink to={to} onNavigate={onNavigate}>{text}</NavLink> : text);
  return (
    <>
      {repliesWaiting.count > 0 ? <p>{line(STANDING_WORDS.home.replies(repliesWaiting.count, repliesWaiting.oldestAt === null ? "" : waited(repliesWaiting.oldestAt, now)), "/queue")}</p> : null}
      {strikeAccounts > 0 ? <p>{line(STANDING_WORDS.home.strikes(strikeAccounts), "/standing")}</p> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * 3f (design, section 8.2): the block "Authorities" above the lanes, each line only while it applies, in the design's
 * order: mail at the contact point that nobody has handled, with a link to Contact point inside its sentence, and the
 * alert channel's state when it is not ok. Without a way to move between pages (a test's rendering), the link is text.
 */
export function AuthoritiesLines({ overview, onNavigate }: { overview: StaffOverview; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const W = ORDER_WORDS.home;
  const { contact, alerts } = overview;
  const since = alerts.since === null ? "" : bothTimes(alerts.since);
  const lines: ReactNode[] = [];
  if (contact.open > 0 && contact.oldestAt !== null) {
    const words = W.contact(bothTimes(contact.oldestAt), contact.open);
    lines.push(
      <p key="contact" className="error">
        {words.before}
        {onNavigate ? (
          <NavLink to="/contact" onNavigate={onNavigate}>
            {words.link}
          </NavLink>
        ) : (
          words.link
        )}
        {words.after}
      </p>,
    );
  }
  if (alerts.channel === "down") lines.push(<p key="channel" className="error">{W.channel(since)}</p>);
  if (alerts.channel === "mailbox") lines.push(<p key="mailbox" className="error">{W.mailbox(since)}</p>);
  if (alerts.channel === "off") lines.push(<p key="off" className="notice">{W.off}</p>);
  if (lines.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div role="status" className="authorities">
      <h3>{W.title}</h3>
      {lines}
    </div>
  );
}

/**

export interface HomeViewProps {

  sessions: Loadable<StaffSession[]>;

  /** The handle of the session whose revocation is under way. */

  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  onRevoke(handle: string): void;
}

              </li>

/** Runs one read and hands its outcome to `set`, unless the screen has gone meanwhile. */
function load<T>(alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<T>) => void, read: () => Promise<T>): void {
  read().then(
    (value) => alive.current && set({ state: "ready", value }),
    (err: unknown) => alive.current && set({ state: "failed", message: describeError(err) }),
  );
}

/** The person's staff sessions, marked: the screen reads them when it opens and after a revocation the person asked for. */
function readSessions(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: (value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>) => void): void {
  load(alive, set, async () => (await api.sessions({ activity: true })).sessions);
}

/** Where the screen's lists go as each read finishes. */
export interface HomeLists {
  overview(value: Loadable<StaffOverview>): void;
  signIns(value: Loadable<AuditEntry[]>): void;
  sessions(value: Loadable<StaffSession[]>): void;
  keys(value: Loadable<StaffKey[]>): void;
}

/**
 * What the screen reads when it opens, every read marked, since opening the screen is its person's action. It takes no
 * session: the sign-ins' 7 days are counted from a /me read now (readSignInsAtOpening), never from the session the page
 * holds, which can be hours old.
 */
export function openHome(api: StaffApi, alive: { current: boolean }, set: HomeLists): void {
  load(alive, set.signIns, () => readSignInsAtOpening(api));
  load(alive, set.overview, () => api.overview({ activity: true }));
  readSessions(api, alive, set.sessions);
  load(alive, set.keys, async () => (await api.keys({ activity: true })).keys);
}

export function Home({ me, api, credentials, onOpenCase, onNavigate }: { me: StaffMe; api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void; onNavigate?: (path: ConsolePath) => void }) {
  const [overview, setOverview] = useState<Loadable<StaffOverview>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());
  const [signIns, setSignIns] = useState<Loadable<AuditEntry[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState<Loadable<StaffSession[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<Loadable<StaffKey[]>>({ state: "loading" });
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    openHome(api, alive, {
      overview: (value) => {
        setNow(Date.now());
        setOverview(value);
      },
      signIns: setSignIns,
      sessions: setSessions,
      keys: setKeys,
    });
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
    // Read once per opening of the screen, never again when the idle timer's reads change `me`; the API client never
    // changes while the page lives.
  }, [api]);

  const revoke = async (handle: string) => {
    setRevoking(handle);
    setNotice(null);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const outcome = await revokeSessionWithKey({ api, credentials }, handle);
      if (!alive.current) return;
      setNotice(outcome === "revoked" ? "That session is signed out." : "That session had already ended.");
      readSessions(api, alive, setSessions);
    } catch (err) {
      if (alive.current) setError(describeError(err));
    } finally {
      if (alive.current) setRevoking(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <HomeView me={me} overview={overview} now={now} onOpenCase={onOpenCase} onNavigate={onNavigate} signIns={signIns} sessions={sessions} keys={keys} revoking={revoking} notice={notice} error={error} onRevoke={(handle) => void revoke(handle)} />
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

/**
 * Small pieces every screen uses. A string a person wrote (a handle, a key's name, a browser label) is only ever a text
 * child, which React escapes, inside a <bdi>: a direction override in it then cannot reorder the text around it.
 */
export function UserText({ children }: { children: string }) {
  return <bdi>{children}</bdi>;
}

/** A list a screen reads from the API: still loading, read, or failed with the console's words. */
export type Loadable<T> = { state: "loading" } | { state: "ready"; value: T } | { state: "failed"; message: string };

export function Loaded<T>({ value, render }: { value: Loadable<T>; render: (value: T) => ReactNode }) {
  if (value.state === "loading") return <p className="quiet">Loading</p>;
  if (value.state === "failed") return <p className="error">{value.message}</p>;
  return <>{render(value.value)}</>;
}

const two = (n: number): string => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

/** A time of day in the browser's zone, as the design writes it: "21:40". */
export function clockTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return `${two(d.getHours())}:${two(d.getMinutes())}`;
}

/** A date and time in the browser's zone: "2026-09-30 21:40". */
export function dateTime(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${two(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${two(d.getDate())} ${clockTime(iso)}`;
}

/** The same with seconds, for the audit log: "2026-09-30 21:40:05". */
export function dateTimeSeconds(iso: string): string {
  return `${dateTime(iso)}:${two(new Date(iso).getSeconds())}`;
}

/**
 * 3f (design, section 8.1): every time of authorities' orders is the database's instant, printed in UTC first and then in
 * the browser's own zone: "2026-10-16 02:00 UTC (04:00 your time)", the local day too when it is another.
 */
export function bothTimes(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const utcDay = `${d.getUTCFullYear()}-${two(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}-${two(d.getUTCDate())}`;
  const localDay = `${d.getFullYear()}-${two(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${two(d.getDate())}`;
  return `${utcDay} ${two(d.getUTCHours())}:${two(d.getUTCMinutes())} UTC (${localDay === utcDay ? "" : `${localDay} `}${clockTime(iso)} your time)`;
}
```

```js
// Bundles the API for the Docker image. esbuild is called directly: the whole configuration fits here.
import { rm } from "node:fs/promises";
import { build } from "esbuild";

await rm("dist", { recursive: true, force: true });
await build({
  // Each entry is a bundle of its own. The command lines check that they were run directly by comparing import.meta.url,
  // which in a bundle is the bundle's, so no entry may import another entry's file.
  // notify (3f) is the contact point's watcher, a service of its own on its own database role.
  entryPoints: { index: "src/index.ts", migrate: "src/migrate.ts", "grant-role": "src/cli/grant-role.ts", staff: "src/cli/staff.ts", notify: "src/notify/main.ts" },
  outdir: "dist",
  bundle: true,
  format: "esm",
  platform: "node",
  target: "node24",
  sourcemap: true,
  // Everything is bundled except @node-rs/argon2: it loads a platform-specific native binary at
  // runtime, so the Docker image ships it in node_modules next to the bundle.
  packages: "bundle",
  external: ["@node-rs/argon2", "@node-rs/argon2/*"],
  // Bundled CommonJS dependencies call require(); an ES module bundle has to provide it. The import is
  // aliased because esbuild cannot rename a banner's names, and a bundled ES module (fflate) imports
  // createRequire itself at top level: with the plain name the bundle declares it twice and Node refuses to load it.
  banner: { js: "import { createRequire as createRequireForBundle } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequireForBundle(import.meta.url);" },
  logLevel: "info",
});
console.log("Build success");
```

```ts
import { RETENTION, type AlertFacts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { MailRefused, type MailMessage, type NoticeUpdateLine } from "../../mail/mailer";
import type { DecisionMailSubject } from "../../mail/templates";
import type { AuthDeps } from "../context";
import { decrypt, encrypt, randomToken, safeEqual } from "../crypto";
import { emailHash } from "../identifiers";
import { HOUR } from "../limits";
import { noticeTime } from "./notify";

/**
 * The auth module's side of reports and notices (3c design, section 5): a signed-out notifier's name and address, which
 * live here, encrypted, where the API's role cannot reach them, and every mail of the moderation module, which never
 * sees an address or a mail token. The moderation module names a contact by an id it chose, names an account by its id,
 * and passes typed messages: no caller passes free text, and this module builds every link itself.
 */

const DAY = 24 * HOUR;

/** An address that is not confirmed gets at most one receipt in this long; further ones are folded into the next daily mail. */
export const RECEIPT_CAP_MS = DAY;

/** The receipt of a report or a notice: its reference, when it was received, and the korbat links it named, in the order named. */
export interface NoticeReceivedMessage {
  template: "notice_received";
  ref: string;
  receivedAt: Date;
  items: readonly string[];
}

/** The daily update of decisions on the reports an account sent: its lines, as the moderation module composed them. */
export interface AccountUpdateMessage {
  template: "notice_update";
  lines: readonly NoticeUpdateLine[];
}

/**
 * The statement of reasons to the author of what a decision restricts or lifts: the subject by its key, and the
 * statement's paragraphs exactly as they were rendered for the author's screen. 3e (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6):
 * a suspension or termination taken at once, and the lift of one (or its end when a reversal broke its basis), are
 * mailed under a subject and a lead of their own, with the same paragraphs; the moderation module picks the template
 * (mailTemplateOf). Times are instants, printed here as the notices print them.
 */
export type DecisionMessage =
  | { template: "moderation_decision"; subject: DecisionMailSubject; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: an announced measure, with its days (null for a termination), the reply window in hours and the earliest start.
  | { template: "suspension_announced"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; window: number; earliestStart: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_started_at_once"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; endsAt: string | null; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: the answer to the person's reply, which kept the measure in force or reversed it.
  | { template: "reply_answered"; outcome: "kept" | "reversed"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "lifted" | "basis"; period: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 4: a withdrawal signed `replaced`, with the withdrawn decision's time and whether the person had replied to it.
  | { template: "suspension_lifted"; measure: "suspend" | "terminate"; why: "replaced"; decidedAt: string; replied: boolean; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  // 3e Task 5: a warning about the account's reports; a restriction of them, with its days and its end.
  | { template: "reporting_warned"; paragraphs: readonly string[] }
  | { template: "reporting_restricted"; days: number; endsAt: string; paragraphs: readonly string[] };

/** The templates of a decision's statement mail: a stop of the address never holds one back. */
const DECISION_TEMPLATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "moderation_decision",
  "suspension_announced",
  "suspension_started_at_once",
  "reply_answered",
  "suspension_lifted",
  "reporting_warned",
  "reporting_restricted",
]);

/** Whether an account's message is a decision's statement. */
const isDecisionMessage = (message: { template: string }): message is DecisionMessage => DECISION_TEMPLATES.has(message.template);

/** What the statement's paragraphs are joined with in a mail's data: one paragraph per line. */
const LINE_BREAK = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** A decision's message as its template's flat data: one data value for the statement, one paragraph per line, exactly as it was rendered. */
function decisionData(message: DecisionMessage): Record<string, string> {
  const statement = message.paragraphs.join(LINE_BREAK);
  switch (message.template) {
    case "moderation_decision":
      return { subject: message.subject, statement };
    case "suspension_announced":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, window: String(message.window), earliestStart: noticeTime(new Date(message.earliestStart)), ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }) };
    case "suspension_started_at_once":
      return { measure: message.measure, statement, ...(message.days === null ? {} : { days: String(message.days) }), ...(message.endsAt === null ? {} : { endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) }) };
    case "reply_answered":
      return { outcome: message.outcome, statement };
    case "suspension_lifted":
      return message.why === "replaced"
        ? { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, decidedAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.decidedAt)), replied: String(message.replied), statement }
        : { measure: message.measure, why: message.why, period: message.period, statement };
    case "reporting_warned":
      return { statement };
    case "reporting_restricted":
      return { statement, days: String(message.days), endsAt: noticeTime(new Date(message.endsAt)) };
  }
}

/** What may be sent to a signed-out notifier's contact by itself: the receipt. Its updates go by address, through mailNotifierUpdates. */
export type NotifierMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage;
/** What may be sent to an account: the receipt and the daily update of its reports, and the statement of a decision about it. */
export type AccountMessage = NoticeReceivedMessage | AccountUpdateMessage | DecisionMessage;

/** One contact's share of the daily update: the lines of its notice, and its receipt when the 24-hour cap folded it. */
export interface NotifierUpdatePart {
  contactId: string;
  /** The reference of the contact's notice. */
  ref: string;
  lines: readonly NoticeUpdateLine[];
  receipt?: { ref: string; receivedAt: Date; items: readonly string[] };
}

/** What became of one contact's share: as a mail's result, or "unavailable" when the relay could not take that address's mail or the contact could not be read. */
export type NotifierUpdateResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused" | "unavailable";

/**
 * The staff alerts: counts, times and a staff account's public handle, never a link or content. The urgent lane's alert;
 * the cases that wait longer than their lane's response time, and those that hold a measure taken while deciding for
 * more than a day; the staff account that confirmed many decisions in a short time; the one that reached its daily case
 * limit; every reveal of who sent a report, with the day's count; and every decision that lifted the protection of
 * images reported as child sexual abuse material.
 */
export type StaffMessage =
  | StaffAlertMessage
  | { template: "moderation_urgent"; count: number; oldest: Date }
  | { template: "moderation_waiting"; lanes: readonly { lane: 0 | 1 | 2; count: number; oldest: Date }[]; interim: number; replies?: { count: number; oldest: Date } | null }
  | { template: "moderation_burst"; handle: string; count: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reads"; handle: string; limit: number }
  | { template: "moderation_reveal"; handle: string; at: Date; count: number; limit: number }
  | { template: "moderation_csam_lifted"; handle: string; at: Date; what: "unsealed" | "dismissed" };

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 7.2, 7.19 and 18, W.4): the staff alerts whose mail is their push's sentence, which the alert tick
 * mails from a row of alert_outbox: the row's facts, counts and times only, and nothing else. Later tasks of 3f add their
 * kinds here as they first write them.
 */
export type StaffAlertKind = "contact_mail" | "contact_mail_escalated" | "order_due" | "mailbox_unreachable" | "alert_channel_down";
export interface StaffAlertMessage {
  template: StaffAlertKind;
  facts: AlertFacts;
}

/**
 * A staff alert's template data: every member as the text the template prints. A 3f alert's facts go as they are, each
 * count as its digits, with the time it is sent: the template prints a time with its day only when that is not today's.
 */
function staffData(message: StaffMessage, now: Date): Record<string, string> {
  switch (message.template) {
    case "contact_mail":
    case "contact_mail_escalated":
    case "order_due":
    case "mailbox_unreachable":
    case "alert_channel_down":
      return { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(message.facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, String(value)])), now: now.toISOString() };
    case "moderation_urgent":
      return { count: String(message.count), oldest: noticeTime(message.oldest) };
    case "moderation_waiting": {
      // A lane's pair only for a lane with a case past its time, and the measures' count only when it is not 0.
      const data: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const lane of message.lanes) {
        if (lane.count <= 0) continue;
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Count`] = String(lane.count);
        data[`lane${lane.lane}Oldest`] = noticeTime(lane.oldest);
      }
      if (message.interim > 0) data.interimCount = String(message.interim);
      // 3e Task 4: the replies unanswered for longer than korbat's aim, only when there are any.
      if (message.replies && message.replies.count > 0) {
        data.replyCount = String(message.replies.count);
        data.replyOldest = noticeTime(message.replies.oldest);
      }
      return data;
    }
    case "moderation_burst":
      return { handle: message.handle, count: String(message.count) };
    case "moderation_csam_lifted":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), what: message.what };
    case "moderation_reads":
      return { handle: message.handle, limit: String(message.limit) };
    case "moderation_reveal":
      return { handle: message.handle, time: noticeTime(message.at), count: String(message.count), limit: String(message.limit) };
  }
}

export type NotifierMailResult = "sent" | "folded" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "forgotten" | "refused";
export type AccountMailResult = "sent" | "suppressed" | "no_address" | "refused";

/** What staff may know of a signed-out notifier without a reveal: never the name or the address themselves. */
export interface NotifierFacts {
  /** False for an id no contact has: it was never stored, or the janitor has forgotten it. Then the other four are false too. */
  found: boolean;
  named: boolean;
  contactGiven: boolean;
  confirmed: boolean;
  suppressed: boolean;
}

/** A contact's ciphertexts open under the key, or under a key it replaced. Nothing read is ever written back under the newer key. */
const open = (deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "config">, payload: string): string => decrypt(payload, [deps.config.notifierKey, ...deps.config.notifierPreviousKeys]).toString("utf8");
const seal = (deps: AuthDeps, plain: string): string => encrypt(Buffer.from(plain, "utf8"), deps.config.notifierKey);

/** The same day `months` calendar months later in UTC; a day the target month lacks becomes that month's last day. */
function monthsLater(at: Date, months: number): Date {
  const month = at.getUTCMonth() + months;
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
  return new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month, Math.min(at.getUTCDate(), lastDay), at.getUTCHours(), at.getUTCMinutes(), at.getUTCSeconds(), at.getUTCMilliseconds()));
}

/** The cap's marker for an address, by its keyed hash: set when a receipt goes to it unconfirmed, gone a day later. */
const receiptCapKey = (hash: string) => `notifier-receipt:${hash}`;

/** The receipt's template data. The page link is this module's: the status page's address with the contact's mail token in the fragment, which no server log sees. */
function receiptData(deps: AuthDeps, message: NoticeReceivedMessage, pageUrl?: string): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    ref: message.ref,
    time: noticeTime(message.receivedAt),
    items: message.items.join(", "),
    ...(pageUrl === undefined ? {} : { pageUrl }),
    termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms`,
  };
}

/** Sends one mail. "refused" when the relay refused the recipient for good; any other failure is thrown, for the caller to try again. */
async function deliver(deps: AuthDeps, message: MailMessage): Promise<"sent" | "refused"> {
  try {
    await deps.mailer.send(message);
    return "sent";
  } catch (err) {
    if (err instanceof MailRefused) return "refused";
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Stores a signed-out notifier's contact under the id the moderation module wrote on the notice: the name and the
 * address normalised and encrypted under the notifier key, the address's keyed hash for the cap and for stops, and, with
 * an address, a fresh mail token encrypted beside it. A disposable address is taken: a notifier may want one. The contact
 * is forgotten 13 months on unless the notice is still owed something by then.
 */
export async function storeNotifierContact(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, contact: { name?: string; email?: string }): Promise<void> {
  const name = contact.name?.trim() || null;
  const email = contact.email?.trim().toLowerCase() || null;
  await deps.repo.createNotifierContact({
    id: contactId,
    nameEnc: name === null ? null : seal(deps, name),
    emailEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, email),
    emailHash: email === null ? null : emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email),
    // The token of the mails' link: it alone confirms or stops the address, so whoever typed someone else's address cannot.
    mailTokenEnc: email === null ? null : seal(deps, randomToken()),
    forgetAfter: monthsLater(deps.now(), RETENTION.contactMaxMonths),
  });
}

/**
 * Sends a signed-out notifier's receipt, under three rules. A stopped address gets nothing ("suppressed"). An address
 * that is not confirmed gets one receipt in 24 hours, and a further one is "folded": it rides in the next daily mail, so
 * typing someone's address into the form many times sends them one mail. A confirmed address has no cap. "forgotten"
 * when no contact has the id, "no_address" when the contact left none. A failure of the relay that is not about the
 * address is thrown, and gives the day's one receipt back first, so the retry is sent rather than folded.
 */
export async function mailNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, message: NotifierMessage): Promise<NotifierMailResult> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact) return "forgotten";
  if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) return "no_address";
  const hash = contact.emailHash;
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  // Opened before the cap is taken: a ciphertext no configured key opens throws here and spends nothing.
  const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
  const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${message.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
  const confirmed = (await deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes([hash], deps.now())).has(hash);
  if (!confirmed && !(await deps.kv.setIfAbsent(receiptCapKey(hash), "1", RECEIPT_CAP_MS))) return "folded";
  try {
    return await deliver(deps, { to, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message, pageUrl) });
  } catch (err) {
    if (!confirmed) await deps.kv.del(receiptCapKey(hash)).catch((failure: unknown) => deps.log.warn({ err: failure }, "notifier receipt: the day's one receipt could not be given back after a failed send"));
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * Sends a mail to an account's own address, which its sign-in code confirmed: no cap and no confirmation. A stop of
 * that address applies to the two report mails, the receipt and the daily update, and never to a statement of reasons.
 * The update of an account is signed in: it carries its lines and neither a receipt nor a page link, since an account
 * follows its reports in the app. "no_address" for an account that is deleted or was never there.
 */
export async function mailAccount(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string, message: AccountMessage): Promise<AccountMailResult> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return "no_address";
  if (isDecisionMessage(message)) {
    // A statement is never held back by a stop of the address.
    return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: message.template, data: decisionData(message) });
  }
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash)) return "suppressed";
  if (message.template === "notice_update") return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [...message.lines], receipts: [], pages: [] } });
  return deliver(deps, { to: user.email, template: "notice_received", data: receiptData(deps, message) });
}

/**
 * The daily update to signed-out notifiers (3c design, sections 5 and 7.8): the parts are grouped by their contacts'
 * address, which only this module can see, and each address gets one notice_update with every part's lines, every
 * carried receipt with its page link, and the page link of each other notice it has a line for. A page link is the
 * status page's address with that contact's own mail token in the fragment, the same link its receipt carried.
 *
 * It applies a stop of the address, and neither the confirmation nor the 24-hour cap: nothing is withheld for want of a
 * confirmed address. It answers for each contact, and throws for none: an address whose mail the relay could not take is
 * "unavailable", so its lines stay pending while every other address's update is still sent. Each contact is read in a
 * try of its own: one that cannot be read (a ciphertext no configured key opens) is logged with its id, never an
 * address, and answered "unavailable" too.
 */
export async function mailNotifierUpdates(deps: AuthDeps, parts: readonly NotifierUpdatePart[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>> {
  const results = new Map<string, NotifierUpdateResult>();
  /** The readable parts, by their address's keyed hash, in the order given. */
  const byAddress = new Map<string, { to: string; parts: { part: NotifierUpdatePart; pageUrl: string }[] }>();
  for (const part of parts) {
    try {
      const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(part.contactId);
      if (!contact) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "forgotten");
        continue;
      }
      if (!contact.emailEnc || !contact.emailHash || !contact.mailTokenEnc) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "no_address");
        continue;
      }
      if ((await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([contact.emailHash])).has(contact.emailHash)) {
        results.set(part.contactId, "suppressed");
        continue;
      }
      const to = open(deps, contact.emailEnc);
      const pageUrl = `${deps.config.appOrigin}/notice/${part.ref}#t=${open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc)}`;
      const group = byAddress.get(contact.emailHash) ?? { to, parts: [] };
      group.parts.push({ part, pageUrl });
      byAddress.set(contact.emailHash, group);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, contactId: part.contactId }, "notifier update: the contact could not be read; its lines stay pending");
      results.set(part.contactId, "unavailable");
    }
  }
  for (const group of byAddress.values()) {
    const receipts = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt ? [{ ref: part.receipt.ref, time: noticeTime(part.receipt.receivedAt), items: part.receipt.items.join(", "), pageUrl }] : []));
    // A notice whose receipt rides in this update has its page with the receipt; every other notice with a line gets a page paragraph.
    const pages = group.parts.flatMap(({ part, pageUrl }) => (part.receipt || part.lines.length === 0 ? [] : [{ ref: part.ref, pageUrl }]));
    const lines = group.parts.flatMap(({ part }) => [...part.lines]);
    let result: NotifierUpdateResult;
    try {
      result = await deliver(deps, {
        to: group.to,
        template: "notice_update",
        data: { signedIn: false, lines, receipts, pages, ...(receipts.length > 0 ? { termsUrl: `${deps.config.appOrigin}/terms` } : {}) },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      // The relay could not take this address's mail: the other addresses' mails still go. The contacts' ids, never the address.
      deps.log.warn({ err, contactIds: group.parts.map(({ part }) => part.contactId) }, "notifier update: not sent; its lines stay pending for the next round");
      result = "unavailable";
    }
    for (const { part } of group.parts) results.set(part.contactId, result);
  }
  // In the order the parts were given, whatever order the addresses were mailed in.
  return new Map(parts.map((part) => [part.contactId, results.get(part.contactId) ?? "unavailable"]));
}

/**
 * Sends a staff alert to every live staff account's address, best effort: a failed send is logged and never thrown, and
 * the answer is the number of addresses the relay took, 0 when it took none or there is no live staff account. It
 * applies no throttle: the moderation module keeps every throttle, as a key in the shared limit store.
 */
export async function mailStaff(deps: AuthDeps, message: StaffMessage): Promise<number> {
  const data = staffData(message, deps.now());
  let addresses: string[];
  try {
    addresses = await deps.repo.liveStaffAddresses();
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert: the staff accounts could not be read");
    return 0;
  }
  let accepted = 0;
  for (const to of addresses) {
    try {
      await deps.mailer.send({ to, template: message.template, data });
      accepted++;
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err, template: message.template }, "staff alert email failed");
    }
  }
  return accepted;
}

/** For each id: whether a contact has it, whether a name and an address were given, and whether the address is confirmed or stopped now. */
export async function notifierFacts(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, NotifierFacts>> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactFacts(contactIds);
  const hashes = rows.flatMap((row) => (row.emailHash === null ? [] : [row.emailHash]));
  const [confirmed, suppressed] = await Promise.all([deps.repo.confirmedNotifierHashes(hashes, deps.now()), deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes(hashes)]);
  const byId = new Map(rows.map((row) => [row.id, row]));
  return new Map(
    contactIds.map((id): [string, NotifierFacts] => {
      const row = byId.get(id);
      if (!row) return [id, { found: false, named: false, contactGiven: false, confirmed: false, suppressed: false }];
      return [id, { found: true, named: row.named, contactGiven: row.contactGiven, confirmed: row.emailHash !== null && confirmed.has(row.emailHash), suppressed: row.emailHash !== null && suppressed.has(row.emailHash) }];
    }),
  );
}

/** The name a notifier gave, or null: for a confirmed reveal only. The address is never handed out. */
export async function notifierName(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  return contact?.nameEnc ? open(deps, contact.nameEnc) : null;
}

/** The contact's address hash when the token is its mail token, compared in constant time; null for anything else. */
async function addressOfToken(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const contact = await deps.repo.findNotifierContact(contactId);
  if (!contact?.mailTokenEnc || !contact.emailHash) return null;
  let mailToken: string;
  try {
    mailToken = open(deps, contact.mailTokenEnc);
  } catch (err) {
    // A contact no configured key opens matches nothing; the fault is the operator's to see, with the contact's id and no address.
    deps.log.error({ err, contactId }, "notifier contact: its mail token could not be decrypted");
    return null;
  }
  return safeEqual(mailToken, token) ? contact.emailHash : null;
}

/** Whether the token is the contact's mail token; false when the contact has none. */
export async function notifierMailTokenMatches(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return (await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token)) !== null;
}

/**
 * "I sent this": with the contact's mail token, records the address as confirmed for 30 days and lifts any stop of it.
 * False, and nothing done, for any other token: typing someone's address proves nothing about it.
 */
export async function confirmNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  const now = deps.now();
  await deps.repo.confirmNotifierAddress(hash, now, new Date(now.getTime() + RETENTION.confirmationDays * DAY));
  return true;
}

/** "Stop": with the contact's mail token, korbat sends this address no more mails about reports. Its notices are still processed. */
export async function stopNotifier(deps: AuthDeps, contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const hash = await addressOfToken(deps, contactId, token);
  if (hash === null) return false;
  await deps.repo.suppressNotifierAddress(hash);
  return true;
}

/** Whether the account's address asked korbat to stop its report mails. */
export async function accountReportMailStopped(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  const hash = emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email);
  return (await deps.repo.suppressedNotifierHashes([hash])).has(hash);
}

/** Lifts a stop of the account's address, for the account's own Settings: the session proves the address. True when there was one. */
export async function resumeAccountReportMail(deps: AuthDeps, userId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const user = await deps.repo.findUserById(userId);
  if (!user) return false;
  return deps.repo.liftNotifierSuppression(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, user.email));
}

/** Moves the day these contacts are forgotten. */
export function forgetNotifierAfter(deps: AuthDeps, contactIds: readonly string[], at: Date): Promise<void> {
  return deps.repo.setNotifierForgetAfter(contactIds, at);
}

/** The contacts that gave this address, with the names they gave: for an access request from a signed-out notifier, from the command line only. */
export async function findNotifierContacts(deps: Pick<AuthDeps, "repo" | "config">, email: string): Promise<{ id: string; name: string | null }[]> {
  const rows = await deps.repo.notifierContactsByEmailHash(emailHash(deps.config.authHmacKey, email));
  return rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, name: row.nameEnc ? open(deps, row.nameEnc) : null }));
}

/** How many contacts and confirmations the janitor should have removed more than a day ago: a count only, for the console's overview. */
export function overdueContacts(deps: AuthDeps): Promise<number> {
  return deps.repo.countNotifierRowsDue(new Date(deps.now().getTime() - DAY));
}
```

```ts
  confirmNotifier(contactId: string, token: string): Promise<boolean>;
```
